# 2022: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 5,324 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2022.sqlite](2022.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `1549548c5ff9851da635c444333a556e4abdbd806b341b6b96a7a661b91ec1da`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 6. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 4; partial: 2; without a full-event review: 5,318. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2022-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1111706294](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20January%201&oldid=1111706294>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-01-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Haitian Prime Minister Ariel Henry survives an assassination attempt when shooters opened fire at a ceremony celebrating the country's independence anniversary in a church in the city of Gonaïves.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-59863052>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-01-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 Boulder County fires.

**Archived source account.** At least three people are confirmed missing, and at least 988 homes are confirmed destroyed, after a wildfire struck Boulder County, Colorado, United States, since December 30.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/01/01/us/colorado-wildfires-saturday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-1-3"></a>

Context: Vaishno Devi Temple stampede.

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are killed and 13 others injured during a stampede at the Vaishno Devi Temple in Indian-administered Kashmir, triggered by many people who were at the temple to celebrate the New Year.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/1/12-dead-in-stampede-at-religious-shrine-in-india>); [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/vaishno-devi-stampede-live-updates-january-1/liveblog/88627999.cms>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom / COVID-19 pandemic in England.

**Archived source account.** England reports a record 162,572 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/health/covid-cases-england-today-latest-b1985376.html>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in France.

**Archived source account.** France surpasses 10 million cases of COVID-19, becoming the sixth country to reach the milestone.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-reports-over-200000-new-daily-covid-cases-fourth-day-running-2022-01-01/>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-8"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe / COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** The Republic of Ireland reports a record 23,281 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<https://www.independent.ie/news/record-23281-new-cases-of-covid-19-reported-as-officials-warn-true-number-of-cases-likely-to-be-higher-41200823.html>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-9"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Europe surpasses 100 million cases of COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/omicron-coronavirus-variant-sweeps-across-the-globe/6377972.html>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-12"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain, COVID-19 drug development.

**Archived source account.** Bahrain authorizes the emergency use of Pfizer's anti-viral oral drug Paxlovid for adults over the age of 18 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/1996396/middle-east>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-14"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates, Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates announces that unvaccinated citizens will be banned from travel and that vaccinated citizens will need to receive a booster dose of the COVID-19 vaccine beginning on January 10.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/uae/covid-19-uae-announces-travel-ban-on-unvaccinated-citizens-from-jan-10-1.1641042016457>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-16"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Argentina imposes a mandatory COVID-19 vaccination certificate for people over the age of 13 years to participate in many types of activities, both indoors and outdoors.

Source citations (as archived): [Buenos Aires Times](<https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/argentina/covid-cases-climb-to-record-high-in-argentina-surpassing-50000-in-24-hours.phtml>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-18"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Australia reports a record for the twelfth consecutive day of 35,326 new cases of COVID-19. New South Wales, Victoria and other states report record numbers of new cases.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2022/jan/01/australia-news-live-nyd-covid-omicron-nsw-victoria-queensland-scott-morrison-weather>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-20"></a>

Context: Birth control in France.

**Archived source account.** France begins to introduce free birth control to women aged 18 to 25 years to reduce the number of unwanted pregnancies. Up to three million women will receive enhanced access to contraceptive pills, intrauterine devices, patches and injectables.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/france-to-make-birth-control-free-for-women-aged-18-25/a-60304913>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-21"></a>

**Archived source account.** France officially bans the use of plastic packaging for large vegetables and fruits, such as cucumbers, carrots, and bananas. Spain plans to introduce a similar law in 2023.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/31/thats-a-wrap-french-plastic-packaging-ban-for-fruit-and-veg-begins>).

<a id="event-2022-01-01-2-22"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel reports the world's first case of "florona," which is believed to be a double infection of COVID-19 and influenza, in an unvaccinated pregnant woman who was admitted to the Rabin Medical Center to give birth.

Source citations (as archived): [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/what-is-florona-flu-plus-corona-first-detected-in-israel-all-you-need-to-know-101641027672824-amp.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-01-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Finland–Russia relations, Enlargement of NATO.

**Archived source account.** Finland rejects Russian demands that it never join the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, with President Sauli Niinistö saying that it is his country's right to join the military alliance if it wants to.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2022/01/01/finland-reiterates-right-join-nato-despite-russian-pressure/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Austria legalizes assisted suicide for people over the age of 18 years who are terminally ill or who suffer from a permanent, debilitating condition.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59847371>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-01-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protesters in Baghdad, Iraq, hold a rally to mark the second anniversary of the assassination of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps general Qasem Soleimani.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-iran-iraq-baghdad-qassim-soleimani-b9b28a97d363a041f11d024cee224865>).

### 2022-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1353854745](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20January%202&oldid=1353854745>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-01-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Russian military intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The rebel-held city of Idlib loses its supply of water after Russian Air Force jets bombed a nearby water station. Airstrikes have increased in the past 24 hours with attacks also reported on farms near the Bab al-Hawa Border Crossing, and on IDP camps near Jisr al-Shughur which killed three people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/russian-jets-bomb-rebel-held-idlib-syria-witnesses-say-2022-01-02/>).

<a id="event-2022-01-02-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swiss newspaper Neue Zürcher Zeitung reports that Mossad was responsible for three bombings of German and Swiss firms in 1981 to try to halt Iranian and Pakistani development of nuclear weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/international/article-691435>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-01-02-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Parliament of South Africa fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire breaks out in the South African parliament building in Cape Town, destroying its roof and the wing housing the National Council of Provinces. A man has been arrested in connection with the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20220102-fire-breaks-out-at-south-african-parliament-building-in-cape-town>).

<a id="event-2022-01-02-1-3"></a>

Context: February 13–17, 2021 North American winter storm, 2021 Texas power crisis.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a destructive winter storm that triggered statewide blackouts in Texas, U.S., last year is updated to 246.

Source citations (as archived): [The Texas Tribune](<https://www.texastribune.org/2022/01/02/texas-winter-storm-final-death-toll-246/amp/>).

<a id="event-2022-01-02-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and 19 injured after a heavy-duty tanker semi-trailer collided with a bus in Sichuan Province, China.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20220102/cefb270460064cc9953433abbf3053f0/c.html>).

<a id="event-2022-01-02-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 5.4 earthquake strikes on the border between Yunnan and Sichuan, China, injuring 22 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/2/twenty-two-people-injured-in-southwest-china-quake>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-01-02-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria.

**Archived source account.** Bulgaria reports its first 12 cases of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in five vaccinated people and seven unvaccinated people, most of whom had not travelled abroad.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<https://www.metro.us/bulgaria-detects-first-cases/>).

<a id="event-2022-01-02-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin announces that he has tested positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/amp/news/2022/01/02/pentagon-lloyd-austin-covid-526376>).

<a id="event-2022-01-02-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic on cruise ships.

**Archived source account.** AIDAnova, a cruise ship operated by German cruise line AIDA Cruises and carrying 4,197 people, has docked in Lisbon, Portugal, after 52 crew members tested positive for COVID-19 and isolated at various hotels.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2022/01/01/world/a-crew-outbreak-halts-a-german-new-years-cruise-in-lisbon.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-01-02-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** A South Korean citizen crosses the heavily fortified Korean Demilitarized Zone in a rare case of defection to North Korea from the South.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59851097>).

<a id="event-2022-01-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Ethiopia–United States relations, Guinea–United States relations, Mali–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States cuts off Ethiopia, Guinea and Mali from the African Growth and Opportunity Act trade preference program citing their human rights abuses and anti-democratic actions.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/2/us-removes-ethiopia-mali-and-guinea-from-agoa-trade-programme>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-01-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Azerbaijani State Border Service guard kills three fellow servicemen at his post and escapes. A manhunt is underway.

Source citations (as archived): [Trend News Agency](<https://en.trend.az/azerbaijan/society/3535967.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-01-02-5-2"></a>

Context: 2019–2024 Sudanese transition to democracy / 2019–2022 Sudanese protests.

**Archived source account.** Interim Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok resigns in response to security forces killing three anti-coup protestors in Omdurman earlier that day.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/01/02/world/sudan-protest-killed-anti-coup-security-forces/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-01-02-6-1"></a>

Context: COVID-19 misinformation.

**Archived source account.** Twitter announces that they have permanently suspended U.S. Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene for allegedly violating the company's policies about COVID-19 misinformation.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2022/01/02/technology/marjorie-taylor-greene-twitter.html>).

### 2022-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1123483778](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20January%203&oldid=1123483778>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-01-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict / 2022 Arauca clashes.

**Archived source account.** Clashes between the revolutionary far-left armed groups ELN and FARC dissidents in Arauca Department leave 23 people dead near Colombia’s border with Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/3/colombia-at-least-16-dead-in-clashes-between-armed-rebel-groups>).

<a id="event-2022-01-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Five soldiers are killed and 20 more are injured during an Islamic State rocket attack on a military transport bus in the Syrian Desert.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/1/3/five-syrian-soldiers-killed-20-injured-by-isil-state-media>).

<a id="event-2022-01-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Six men are killed by suspected al-Shabaab militants in a village in Lamu County, Kenya, near the border with Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/bodies-burnt-one-victim-beheaded-kenyan-village-near-somalia-police-2022-01-03/>).

<a id="event-2022-01-03-0-8"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces capture a United Arab Emirates-flagged cargo ship, the Rwabee, off Al Hudaydah, Yemen. The UAE government says that the vessel was carrying equipment from a closed coalition field hospital on Socotra while the Houthis say that the vessel was carrying military equipment.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/iran-backed-houthis-seize-uae-ship-on-anniversary-of-soleimani-assassination/ar-AASnZvR?ocid=BingNewsSearch>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-01-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Evergrande liquidity crisis.

**Archived source account.** Chinese property developer Evergrande Group suspends trading of its shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange ahead of a planned restructuring of the firm.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-59855881>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-01-03-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India, COVID-19 vaccination in India.

**Archived source account.** India begins administering COVID-19 vaccines for children between the ages of 15 and 18 years using the domestically produced Covaxin vaccine manufactured by Bharat Biotech.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-01-03-3-1"></a>

Context: Cyberwarfare and Iran.

**Archived source account.** The website of Israel's Jerusalem Post newspaper is hacked by suspected Iranian hackers. The website's content was replaced with a threat targeting the Shimon Peres Negev Nuclear Research Center and an apparent reference to Qasem Soleimani, who was assassinated exactly two years earlier in Baghdad, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israels-jerusalem-post-website-hacked-soleimani-assassination-anniversary-2022-01-03/>).

<a id="event-2022-01-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Ban of Twitter in Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** The Nigerian government lifts its Twitter ban, which was implemented in June 2021, after Twitter agreed to pay an "applicable tax" and also establish a legal entity within the country sometime in the first quarter of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian Nigeria](<https://editor.guardian.ng/news/twitter-to-pay-tax-establish-legal-entity-in-nigeria-after-suspension/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Fort Worth Star-Telegram](<https://www.star-telegram.com/news/local/crime/article257360862.html>); [Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-692626>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-01-15-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption and tsunami.

**Archived source account.** Tonga is hit by ashfall and a tsunami after the eruption of Hunga Tonga, destroying homes as locals struggle to find higher ground. Major flooding is reported in the capital Nukuʻalofa. Shock waves from the eruption are detected as far away as Alaska, United States. Other Pacific countries have also advised their citizens to seek higher ground. Internet access has reportedly been disrupted in Tonga.

Security forces were forced to flee the area, leaving the militants to burn down shops and kidnap women and children.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Business and economy

The new pass will ban unvaccinated people from entering most public venues and travelling on domestic flights and inter-regional trains. Additionally, the mandate to work from home for more than 3 days per week will be lifted on February 2 and children between the ages of 12 and 17 years will be eligible to receive a booster dose beginning on Monday.

Context: 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / Russia–NATO relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/horrific-destruction-casualties-if-russia-invades-ukraine-us-2022-01-28/>).

Context: 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / Belarus–NATO relations.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-02-17-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / War in Donbas.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian government accuses Russian separatists of shelling a kindergarten in Stanytsia Luhanska, Luhansk Oblast using artillery, injuring three civilians. The Luhansk People's Republic says that its forces were attacked by the Ukrainian military with mortars, grenade launchers and machine gun fire. At least 32 shells hit the city, causing power outages and damaging multiple structures.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/west-accuses-russia-of-trying-to-create-pretext-for-invasion-after-shelling-in-east-ukraine/ar-AATZcQu?ocid=uxbndlbing>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/feb/17/shelling-by-russian-backed-separatists-hits-school-in-east-ukraine>).

### 2022-02-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1303335707](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20February%2018&oldid=1303335707>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-02-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / War in Donbas.

**Archived source account.** The Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic order mandatory mass evacuations of civilians from their respective capital cities, Donetsk and Luhansk. Around 700,000 people are expected to be evacuated to Russia with the first buses carrying civilians to the Russian border already travelling to Rostov Oblast. Russian President Vladimir Putin orders lump-sum allowances of 10,000 rubles (130 US dollars) to be paid to refugees from Donbas.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/warning-siren-sounds-in-rebel-held-capital-in-east-ukraine-reuters-witness/ar-AAU29BV?ocid=entnewsntp>); [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1406247>).

<a id="event-2022-02-18-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / War in Donbas.

**Archived source account.** A UAZ-469 jeep is blown up outside of a building of the Donetsk People's Republic government in Donetsk city. No injuries are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/separatists-in-eastern-ukraine-say-vehicle-blown-up-near-their-hq/ar-AAU2wpB?ocid=entnewsntp>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/gas-pipeline-ukraines-breakaway-region-catches-fire-after-blast-reports-2022-02-18/>).

<a id="event-2022-02-18-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / War in Donbas.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-02-20-1-1"></a>

Context: Suisse secrets.

**Archived source account.** Leaked data from Credit Suisse exposes the identities of over 30,000 of the bank's clients whose anonymous numbered Swiss bank accounts, which collectively held over $100 billion, had allowed them to keep their identities secret. Its clients included heads of state (such as king Abdullah II of Jordan), human rights abusers, drug traffickers, intelligence officials, and individuals under sanctions or involved in financial crimes such as tax evasion or corruption, among others. The secret data from Switzerland's second largest bank was leaked about 1 year ago to the German newspaper Süddeutsche Zeitung and was analyzed by the non-profit Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project (OCCRP) and 46 other news organizations, including The New York Times, Le Monde and The Guardian.

Source citations (as archived): [Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project](<https://www.occrp.org/en/40-press-releases/presss-releases/15992-suisse-secrets-webinar-occrp-and-sueddeutsche-zeitung-journalists-discuss-credit-suisse-investigation>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/business-europe-switzerland-4bf06f6cbeb9cb53451bdb29585b49ac>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/news/2022/feb/20/credit-suisse-secrets-leak-unmasks-criminals-fraudsters-corrupt-politicians>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2022/02/20/business/credit-suisse-leak-swiss-bank.html>).

<a id="event-2022-02-20-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The controversial Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam begins producing electricity, with Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed attending the inauguration of the dam.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/2/20/ethiopia-electricity-production-gerd-blue-nile-mega-dam>).

### 2022-02-21

<a id="event-2022-02-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / International recognition of the Donetsk People's Republic and the Luhansk People's Republic.

**Archived source account.** The European Union says it is prepared to issue sanctions against Russia if the country recognizes the Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic, breakaway regions of Ukraine that declared independence in 2014. Ukraine considers the quasi-states terrorist organizations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/stop-playing-with-peoples-lives-eastern-ukraine-germany-tells-russia-2022-02-21/>).

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / International recognition of the Donetsk People's Republic and the Luhansk People's Republic.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin signs decrees recognising the independence of the Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic with immediate effect. He also asks the parliament to ratify the treaties on friendship and mutual aid with the breakaway territories.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60468237>); [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/putin-recognize-donetsk-luhansk-republics-ukraine-166bbe54-2d6a-446a-87bd-e9e63cf21ca9.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-news-02-21-22/h_7f9b0f59dd474075f052368e1ffa3180>).

He also reiterates his claim that Ukraine joining NATO would be a security risk to Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-vents-ukraine-grievances-justification-recognising-donbass-2022-02-21/>); [CNN International](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-news-02-21-22/h_d57bdb487b0fecee541e958dd1a6fc40>); [Sputnik](<https://sputniknews.com/amp/20220221/russian-president-putin-addresses-nation-following-security-councils-meeting-on-donbass-1093244132.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/russia-trying-to-seize-chernobyl-captures-parts-of-kherson-region>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/chernobyl-nuclear-russia-attack-ukraine-b2022444.html>); [Unian](<https://www.unian.net/war/rossiyskie-voyska-zahvatili-chernobylskuyu-aes-ofis-prezidenta-novosti-donbassa-11716741.html>).

<a id="event-2022-02-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Snake Island campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [IndiaTV](<https://www.indiatvnews.com/news/world/russia-ukraine-news-crisis-live-updates-vladimir-putin-orders-military-operation-invasion-ukraine-us-biden-nato-countries-markets-24th-february-2022-2022-02-24-761272>).

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Sumy.

Source citations (as archived): [Novoye Vremya](<https://nv.ua/ukraine/events/voyna-rossii-protiv-ukrainy-voyska-rf-v-sumah-idut-boi-v-ahtyrke-novosti-ukrainy-50219649.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/02/24/russia-attacks-ukraine-as-its-happening-a76553>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-helicopters-attack-military-airport-near-kyiv-ukrainian-officials-2022-02-24/>); [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3412045-ukraines-armed-forces-regain-control-of-hostomel-airport-arestovych.html>).

<a id="event-2022-02-24-0-10"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Antonov Airport.

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-news-02-23-22/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-europe-russia-moscow-kyiv-626a8c5ec22217bacb24ece60fac4fe1>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-news-02-23-22/h_18d0932fdfd8dfd966f2e70486436d26>); [The Business Standard](<https://www.tbsnews.net/world/ukraine-says-it-was-attacked-through-russian-belarus-and-crimea-borders-375241>).

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian ballistic and cruise missiles strike multiple Ukrainian cities and airfields, with eighteen people being killed in Odesa. A missile also strikes the Ministry of Defence intelligence headquarters in Kyiv.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-news-02-23-22/h_9ac518005a166a30706d817a9d6d2e04>); [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/18-people-killed-in-ukraines-odessa-in-missile-attack-regional-authorities-2786880>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/smoke-seen-over-defence-ministry-intelligence-hq-kyiv-witness-2022-02-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-02-24-0-18"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** An attack on a military unit in Podilsk kills six civilians and injures seven others.

<a id="event-2022-02-24-0-19"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine's military reports that at least 137 of its soldiers have been killed in Eastern Ukraine, with a senior Ukrainian government official estimating that hundreds of Ukrainian troops have been killed by airstrikes. Ukraine's military also says that 50 Russian soldiers have been killed in action.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/russia-attacks-ukraine-drawing-broad-condemnation-11645682406>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-news-02-24-22-intl/index.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/feb/24/russia-attacks-ukraine-news-vladimir-putin-zelenskiy-russian-invasion>).

<a id="event-2022-02-24-0-20"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy declares martial law across the country in response to the invasion. Zelenskyy also orders a general military mobilization of fit-to-serve Ukrainian citizens, with men between the ages of 18 and 60 years prohibited from leaving the country.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1409273>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-news-02-24-22-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-02-24-0-21"></a>

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-02-27-8-2"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** FIFA prohibits Russia from playing under its own flag, but will allow the country to compete under a neutral banner of "Football Union of Russia", which is similar to how the International Olympic Committee requires Russian athletes to compete at the Olympics under the name of the Russian Olympic Committee. International football matches that would have taken place in Russia may only be played without spectators in other, neutral countries. However, several teams, including all possible playoff opponents for the 2022 FIFA World Cup, refuse to compete against the Russian team.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian Air Force pilots begin arriving in Poland to begin taking control of fighter aircraft donated by European Union countries. The Ukrainian government says that the EU is handing over 70 fighter jets to its air force including 28 MiG-29s from Poland, 12 from Slovakia, 16 from Bulgaria, and 14 Sukhoi Su-25s from Bulgaria. Bulgarian Prime Minister Kiril Petkov said he had rejected the request. European Union security chief Josep Borrell later clarified that the donations were done "bilaterally" by individual EU member states and not from the EU itself.

<a id="event-2022-02-28-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Central Bank of Russia (CBR) raises the interest rate from 9.5% to 20%, the highest rate since 2003. The Russian ruble also loses more than a quarter of its value at the beginning of trading, with ranges of 100–120 rubles to the US dollar.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/feb/28/ukraine-war-sanctions-hit-russian-rouble-crashes-as-zelenskiy-speaks-of-crucial-24-hours>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/russia-hikes-key-rate-20-tells-companies-sell-fx-2022-02-28/>).

<a id="event-2022-02-28-3-25"></a>

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** An Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson says that efforts to revive the 2015 Iran deal could succeed if the U.S. and other Western powers take steps to solve three issues. Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/amp/News/middle-east/2022/02/28/Iran-says-three-key-issues-remain-unresolved-in-Vienna-nuclear-talks>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-03-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Kyiv / Kyiv offensive.

**Archived source account.** A Russian military convoy that is about 64 kilometers (40 miles) long continues to advance toward Kyiv, as the invasion enters its sixth day.

#### Business and economy

**Archived source account.** The National Football League and National Football League Players Association announce that they will eliminate COVID-19 testing and other protocols for the 2022 season following a revision to U.S. CDC guidelines and a decline in the number of COVID-19 cases.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/33413223/nfl-suspends-covid-19-protocols-cites-decreasing-spread>).

<a id="event-2022-03-03-8-4"></a>

Context: Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** UEFA announces that they have banned Belarus from hosting international games due to its role in the invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Bleacher Report](<https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10028559-uefa-bars-belarus-from-hosting-international-games-after-invasion-of-ukraine>).

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive.

<a id="event-2022-03-04-0-13"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Wales Online](<https://www.walesonline.co.uk/news/uk-news/sky-news-journalist-shot-wounded-23297141>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-0-15"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Ukrainian refugee crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Czech Republic introduces a state of emergency for 30 days as thousands of Ukrainian refugees arrive in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Novinky](<https://www.novinky.cz/domaci/clanek/v-cesku-opet-plati-nouzovy-stav-vlada-ho-vyhlasila-kvuli-pomoci-ukrajincum-40389166>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-0-18"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Reactions to the 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / Ukraine–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** NATO announces that they will not declare a no-fly zone over Ukrainian airspace, as such a declaration could create an avenue for further escalation by enabling NATO nations to potentially fire upon Russian aircraft in the area.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX News](<https://www.foxnews.com/politics/nato-rules-out-ukraine-no-fly-zone>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-0-19"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Reactions to the 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis / Ukraine–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** President Volodymyr Zelenskyy condemns NATO for rejecting his appeal for a no-fly zone over his country, saying "All the people who die starting today will also die because of you. Because of your weakness, because of your disconnection".

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-zelenskyy-condemns-nato-over-no-fly-zone-decision-as-it-happened/a-61007081>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-0-20"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Reactions to the 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Head of the Chechen Republic Ramzan Kadyrov calls on President Vladimir Putin to let his forces seize Ukraine's major cities, saying that it is the "only way to save the Russian people and our state".

Source citations (as archived): [WeForNews](<https://www.wefornews.com/chechen-leader-ramzan-kadyrov-makes-ukraine-plea-to-putin/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-0-21"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** By a unanimous vote, Ukraine becomes a contributor to NATO's Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/uncategorized/ukraine-joins-natos-cyber-defense-center-as-a-contributing-participant/>).

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Terrorism in Pakistan / 2022 Peshawar mosque attack.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State gunmen and a suicide bomber kill at least 61 people and injure 196 others during Friday prayers at a Shia mosque in Peshawar, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/03/04/asia/pakistan-peshawar-blast-intl/index.html>).

Context: Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic / Economy of Brazil.

**Archived source account.** The government announces that Brazil's economy has grown by 4.6%, the largest increase since 2011, after suffering a slump in 2020 due to the COVID-19 recession.

Source citations (as archived): [The Rio Times](<https://www.riotimesonline.com/brazil-news/brazil/brazils-economy-grows-by-4-6-in-2021-more-than-offsetting-the-slump-in-2020/amp/>).

**Archived source account.** The Moscow Stock Exchange will extend its closure until at least March 8.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-03-04/russia-keeps-stock-trading-closed-in-nation-s-longest-shutdown>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-1-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Russian financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** JPMorgan Chase warns that the current financial crisis in Russia might be similar or even greater in consequences than the 1998 crisis, when Russia defaulted on its obligations.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-03-04/jpmorgan-warns-russia-headed-for-1998-like-collapse-in-economy?srnd=premium-europe>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/03/04/tech/yandex-russia-internet-warning/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-1-8"></a>

Context: Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** Alphabet Inc., the parent company of Google, stops all sales of advertisements in Russia, following similar actions by Twitter and Snap Inc., as Russian regulators demand that the company stop showing "false political information" about Ukraine that they claim is misinforming the Russian public.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/google-pauses-all-ad-sales-russia-2022-03-04/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-03-04-4-2"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis, International reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–Ukraine relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Cotswold Journal](<https://www.cotswoldjournal.co.uk/news/national/19970746.vladimir-putin-says-backs-talks-ukraine-must-comply-russias-demands/>); [Guernsey Press](<https://guernseypress.com/news/world-news/2022/03/04/vladimir-putin-says-he-backs-talks-but-ukraine-must-comply-with-russias-demands/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-03-04-5-2"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Media freedom in Russia.

**Archived source account.** President Vladimir Putin signs amendments to the Criminal Code of Russia criminalising the spreading of falsehoods about Russian soldiers and the Russian Armed Forces, as well as calling for anti-Russian sanctions. According to the changes to the Criminal Code, spreading falsehoods about the Russian army will be punishable by 10–15 years of imprisonment, with the possibility of an additional fine of 700,000 to 1.5 million rubles (US$6,400–13,700) and up to three years of forced labour. The other two activities will carry a lesser punishment but all include possible imprisonment. The bill was previously accepted unanimously by the State Duma.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax Russia](<https://www.interfax.ru/russia/826193>); [TASS](<https://tass.ru/politika/13969809>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-5-4"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Protests against the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addresses anti-war protesters in cities across Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Guernsey Press](<https://guernseypress.com/news/world-news/2022/03/04/zelensky-addresses-protesters-across-europe/>); [Warrington Guardian](<https://www.warringtonguardian.co.uk/news/national/19971391.zelensky-addresses-protesters-across-europe/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-5-6"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Italian police seize the yacht of Russian oligarch Alexei Mordashov at the port of Imperia. Another yacht owned by Putin associate Gennady Timchenko is blocked at the port and is expected to be seized shortly. Both men have been sanctioned by the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/mar/04/italian-police-seize-yacht-owned-by-russias-richest-man>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-5-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Turkish citizen wanted for the assassination of journalist Hrant Dink is detained in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.

Source citations (as archived): [AKIpress](<https://akipress.com/news:668663:Turkish_citizen_wanted_for_assassination_of_journalist_Hrant_Dink_detained_in_Bishkek/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-04-6-1"></a>

Context: 2021 Australian Parliament House sexual misconduct allegations.

**Archived source account.** Minister for Education and Youth Alan Tudge, who temporarily stood down from his position last year after domestic abuse allegations were leveled against him by his former staffer and mistress, announces that he will be permanently resigning from the frontbench as a result of these allegations.

**Archived source account.** Arianespace and OneWeb suspend all future rocket launches from Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan, and the use of Russian Soyuz rockets for their spacecraft.

Source citations (as archived): [Spaceflight Insider](<https://www.spaceflightinsider.com/organizations/arianespace/arianespace-oneweb-suspend-soyuz-launches-indefinitely/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/uk-satellite-company-oneweb-suspends-baikonur-launches-2022-03-03/>).

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian space agency Roscosmos ceases all joint scientific experiments on the International Space Station.

Source citations (as archived): [WION](<https://www.wionews.com/science/russian-space-agency-roscosmos-ceases-joint-experiments-on-international-space-station-458941>).

Context: Internet censorship in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia blocks access to the websites of foreign government-sponsored corporations BBC News, Voice of America, Deutsche Welle and Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty for spreading so-called "false information" about the "special military operation" in Ukraine. Russia also blocks access to Facebook and Twitter for the same reason.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/russia-restricts-access-bbc-russian-service-radio-liberty-ria-2022-03-04/>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-bans-facebook/>); [Meduza](<https://meduza.io/news/2022/03/04/roskomnadzor-soobschil-o-blokirovke-facebook-v-rossii>).

### 2022-03-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358516790](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20March%205&oldid=1358516790>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-03-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive / Siege of Mariupol.

**Archived source account.** Russian and Ukrainian forces agree to open a humanitarian corridor for five hours for people who want to leave Mariupol and Volnovakha, expecting 200,000 people from Mariupol and 15,000 people from Volnovakha to use the corridor. However, the implementation of the corridor is postponed as the two parties accused each other of violating cease-fire agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/top-wrap-1-europes-largest-nuclear-power-plant-fire-after-russian-attack-mayor-2022-03-04/>); [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/ukraine-and-russia-agree-to-open-corridors-for-civilians-to-evacuate-mariupol-11646470358>).

<a id="event-2022-03-05-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive.

**Archived source account.** Head of the Donetsk People's Republic Denis Pushilin announces that Sparta Battalion Commander Volodymyr Zhoha has been killed in Volnovakha.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrayinska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2022/03/5/7328594/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-05-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Siege of Chernihiv.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Air Force warplane is shot down on the outskirts of Chernihiv, crashing into a residential area, according to Ukraine's State Emergency Service.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/ukraine-russia-putin-news-03-05-22/h_8b60ddc7f423cb0513671d180e4229c5>).

<a id="event-2022-03-05-0-8"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Siege of Chernihiv.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Sukhoi Su-34 is shot down in Chernihiv Oblast and one of its pilots is taken prisoner by Ukrainian forces. The other pilot died.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukranews](<https://ukranews.com/en/news/839005-ukrainian-military-shoot-down-another-enemy-plane-in-vicinity-of-chernihiv>); [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/world/russia-ukraine-war/video/russia-ukraine-war-crisis-ukrainian-forces-shot-russian-aircraft-pilot-1921128-2022-03-05>).

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kyiv offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian troops seize control of Borodianka in Kyiv Oblast after days of heavy shelling and airstrikes. Ukrainian authorities say that they were unable to evacuate a psychiatric hospital in the town which holds 670 patients. The hospital is now under Russian control.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-03-05-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian War / Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** South Korean electronics giant Samsung Electronics suspends all shipments to Russia due "to current geopolitical developments". Samsung is the largest supplier of smartphones in Russia with a 30% market share.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/samsung-elec-says-shipments-russia-suspended-donating-6-mln-aid-2022-03-04/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-05-1-3"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian War / Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** PayPal suspends its services in Russia, citing "violent military aggression in Ukraine". Inditex also announces that it is closing all of its 502 stores in Russia, which employ about 9,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-60631835>).

<a id="event-2022-03-05-1-4"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian War / Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** Visa and Mastercard suspend operations in Russia following "Russia's unprovoked invasion of Ukraine". Visa says that it would cut off transactions "over the coming days", and that once a full ban is in place, bank cards issued in Russia will no longer work abroad.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/business/visa-mastercard-russia-ban-b2029501.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-05-1-6"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** President Putin signs a decree authorising settlement of sovereign and corporate debts whose creditors come from "unfriendly countries" (whose list is to be determined within two days' time) to be made in rubles instead of foreign currencies, according to the exchange rate set by the Central Bank of Russia (CBR).

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-03-05/putin-seeks-to-avert-defaults-with-ruble-payments-to-creditors>); [TASS](<https://tass.ru/politika/13983203>).

<a id="event-2022-03-05-1-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Aeroflot, Russia's flag carrier airline, announces that all flights to foreign destinations will be suspended as of March 8.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<https://ria.ru/20220305/aeroflot-1776743454.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-03-07-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 global energy crisis.

**Archived source account.** The price of Brent crude oil increases to $139.13 per barrel, the highest value since July 2008, amid supply disruptions and the threat of a Russian oil ban.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/oil-spikes-2008-highs-us-europe-mull-russian-oil-import-ban-iran-delay-2022-03-07/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-07-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Metal markets register new highs. Aluminium and nickel register a record price on the London stock exchange, at about $4,000 and $55,000 per tonne, respectively; nickel prices rose 90% on intraday trading. Copper also recorded new highs, at $10,845 per tonne, while palladium reached $3,440 per ounce. Russia is a substantial producer of all of these metals, and the market expects shortages of these commodities as the country is hit by further sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russia-disruptions-fuel-nickels-30-spike-15-year-high-2022-03-07/>); [Reuters 2](<https://www.reuters.com/business/palladium-propelled-record-highs-by-russia-supply-concerns-2022-03-07/>); [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/aluminium-copper-prices-hit-record-highs-on-ukraine-01646639706>).

**Archived source account.** U.S. bank Goldman Sachs announces that it is closing its operations in Russia, becoming the first major Wall Street bank to leave the country following the invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/goldman-sachs-exit-russia-bloomberg-news-2022-03-10/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-5"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war / 2022 Russian financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov says that the Russian economy is experiencing a "shock" following an "absolutely unprecedented" economic war being waged against the country. Peskov also says that "the economic war that has started against our country has never taken place before. So it is very hard to forecast anything".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/asia/russian-economy-shock-unprecedented-economic-war-kremlin-2022-03-10/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-6"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war / 2022 Russian financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** The International Monetary Fund no longer considers Russian default "improbable", and the World Bank also considers Russia's and Belarus's default likely.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/imf-chief-georgieva-says-ukraine-war-lower-global-growth-forecast-2022-03-10/>); [Reuters 2](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/russia-belarus-squarely-default-territory-billions-debt-world-bank-2022-03-09/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-7"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war / 2022 Russian financial crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Central Bank of Russia limits withdrawals of US dollars, euros, British pounds and Japanese yen for Russian firms to the equivalent of $5,000, with the withdrawal of larger sums only possible with the Central Bank's permission. The withdrawn funds may only be used for covering overseas work trips.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-central-bank-restricts-firms-access-cash-hard-currency-2022-03-10/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-9"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war / International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin admits that the sanctions have created problems for Russia. However, he also called the sanctions illegitimate and warned the West that Russia will emerge stronger and solve the problems.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/putin-says-russia-will-solve-its-problems-calls-sanctions-illegitimate-2022-03-10/>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-russia-war-latest-news-lavrov-turkey-peace-talks-putin-nuclear-live-updates-12541713>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-10"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian parliament begins to debate a new law which would allow the forced seizure of all assets belonging to Russians citizens as well as Ukrainians deemed by the courts or the National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine to be Russian collaborators. Last week, a bill was approved that allowed forced seizure of assets owned by the Russian government and Russian companies.

Source citations (as archived): [Ekonomichna Pravda](<https://www.epravda.com.ua/news/2022/03/10/683684/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-11"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Russia's Ministry of Transport prepares a draft regulation which would allow airlines to not have to honour the request of the lessor to return leased aircraft unless a special government commission orders them to do so and would also allow companies to pay the lessor in rubles. The law comes amid EU sanctions which forces all lease contracts for Russian aircraft to be voided by late March and also forbids E.U. companies from insuring Russian aircraft.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax Russia](<https://www.interfax.ru/russia/827278>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-12"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Russia introduces retaliatory sanctions against most foreign countries, with the exception of members of the Russian-led Eurasian Economic Union. The export of more than 200 items, mostly of technical and agricultural appliances, will also be banned until the end of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax Russia](<https://www.interfax.ru/business/827393>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-13"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** The Russian government abolishes penalties for theft of patents if they are held by natural or legal persons from countries considered by the Russian government as "unfriendly". The decriminalisation of the piracy of software from "unfriendly" countries is also being considered.

Source citations (as archived): [Euractiv](<https://www.euractiv.com/section/global-europe/news/russia-legalises-intellectual-property-piracy/>); [The Register](<https://www.theregister.com/2022/03/08/russia_software_piracy/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-1-14"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

**Archived source account.** Facebook and Instagram starts to allow users in Eastern Europe, the Baltics, and the Caucasus to promote violence against Russians and Russian soldiers in the context of the war in Ukraine, which is normally restricted, according to internal emails. A Meta spokesperson states that "As a result of the Russian invasion of Ukraine we have temporarily made allowances for forms of political expression that would normally violate our rules like violent speech such as 'death to the Russian invaders.'" However, calls for violence against Russian prisoners of war and "credible calls for violence against Russian civilians" will remain prohibited. Death threats against Russian President Vladimir Putin and Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko will also be permitted. Meta's spokesperson adds that they are, "for the time being, making a narrow exception for praise of the Azov Regiment strictly in the context of defending Ukraine, or in their role as part of the Ukraine National Guard," which was previously forbidden.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/exclusive-facebook-instagram-temporarily-allow-calls-violence-against-russians-2022-03-10/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-03-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 250 people are evacuated after Mount Merapi on Java, Indonesia erupts overnight.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/indonesias-merapi-volcano-unleashes-lava-hundreds-evacuate/2022/03/09/ff2ef490-a00e-11ec-9438-255709b6cddc_story.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-2-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Zagreb Tu-141 crash.

**Archived source account.** A Tupolev Tu-141 reconnaissance drone crashes on the outskirts of Zagreb, Croatia, triggering a loud blast and forming a large crater, but causing no injuries. The unmanned aircraft flew through Hungarian airspace before crashing in Croatia and is likely to have severely malfunctioned. The aircraft, which travelled 560km, went undetected by both countries' air defences.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/mar/11/ukraine-military-drone-crashes-into-croatian-capital-zagreb>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/flying-object-crashes-croatian-capital-triggers-blast-83383858>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-03-10-5-1"></a>

Context: Judiciary of Poland, Polish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Tribunal, the highest court in Poland, declares that the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) may not control the validity of the appointment of any judges in Poland. The Tribunal also wrote in its opinion that Poland is not obliged to implement four ECHR court rulings which found that the parties were denied a right to fair trial, as the relevant provision violates the Constitution of Poland when applied to control the judges' appointment.

Source citations (as archived): [Rzeczpospolita](<https://www.rp.pl/sady-i-trybunaly/art35839361-jest-wyrok-trybunalu-ws-wniosku-ziobry>); [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2022/03/10/polish-court-finds-european-human-rights-convention-incompatible-with-constitution>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Knesset votes 45–15 to bar Palestinian spouses of Israelis from obtaining citizenship if they came from the West Bank or the Gaza Strip, and blocks family reunification of Israelis and their spouses if they came from "enemy countries" such as Lebanon, Syria, and Iran. This replaces a similar emergency order that was in place from 2003 to last year, when it failed to receive enough votes to be annually renewed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israels-knesset-passes-law-barring-palestinian-spouses-2022-03-10/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-10-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Electoral Board of Ethiopia condemns the arrest of the chairman of the Oromo Liberation Front, Dawud Ibsa Ayana, as illegal. The National Electoral Board also said it would investigate the reported arrest of opposition politicians from several other regions including Benishangul Gumuz, South Ethiopia, South West Ethiopia, Sidama, Oromia, and Addis Ababa.

Source citations (as archived): [AfricaNews](<https://www.africanews.com/2022/03/10/ethiopia-opposition-figure-under-house-arrest-electoral-board-demands-his-release//>).

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

The sanctions mean that Premier League club Chelsea will not be able to sell any more tickets for games, its merchandise store will be closed, and it will be unable to buy or sell players on the transfer market until the club is sold.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-03-11-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine offensive / Battle of Melitopol.

**Archived source account.** Russian troops capture the mayor of Melitopol Ivan Fedorov, and take him to an unknown location after he refused to cooperate with Russian occupation forces. Fedorov's capture is confirmed by Ukrainian Internal Affairs Ministry official Anton Herashchenko.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-60685883>).

<a id="event-2022-03-11-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Kyiv offensive.

**Archived source account.** A large convoy of Russian military vehicles, including tanks and self-propelled artillery, begins "fanning out" to forests and towns near Kyiv as it prepares to advance on the capital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-60702464>).

<a id="event-2022-03-11-0-8"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Siege of Chernihiv.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian Ground Forces launch a counter-offensive in Chernihiv Oblast, regaining control of five settlements from Russian forces, and seizing two Russian armoured personnel carriers and ammunition.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3426502-ukraine-army-regains-control-of-five-settlements-in-chernihiv-region-in-countrys-north.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-11-0-11"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Northeastern Ukraine offensive / Battle of Sumy.

**Archived source account.** Around 104 Russian soldiers are taken as prisoners of war in Sumy.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3427167-more-than-100-russian-servicemen-taken-prisoner-in-sumy-region.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-11-0-12"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia allows foreign volunteers to join its armed forces to fight the war against Ukraine. Russian defense minister Sergei Shoigu says that he has received around 16,000 applications, mostly from people in the Middle East.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-kyiv-business-forests-war-crimes-be25927bc5eef0f90cf466a86fcc6e3f>).

<a id="event-2022-03-11-0-13"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches "high-precision" airstrikes on airfields in Lutsk and Ivano-Frankivsk in Western Ukraine, killing four Ukrainian service members and injuring six others. Russian Air Force jets also bomb the city of Dnipro for the first time, destroying a shoe factory and killing one person.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-kyiv-business-forests-war-crimes-be25927bc5eef0f90cf466a86fcc6e3f>).

<a id="event-2022-03-11-0-15"></a>

Context: Indo-Pakistani wars and conflicts.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistani military says that a surface-to-surface missile hit near Mian Channu, Punjab. India later admits to accidentally firing a missile into Pakistani territory. No casualties were reported by either side.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-60711653>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/india-says-it-accidentally-fired-missile-into-pakistan-2022-03-11/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/military-says-unarmed-missile-from-india-ends-up-in-pakistan/2022/03/10/3bbbfd5e-a0a0-11ec-9438-255709b6cddc_story.html/>).

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-03-11-4-3"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War / Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. president Joe Biden announces that he will revoke Russia's most favoured nation trade status in coordination with the European Union and the Group of Seven. The U.S. will also ban all imports of Russian seafood, alcohol, and diamonds; forbid new investment in Russia by American citizens; and criminalise the export of U.S. banknotes to Russia.
