**Archived source account.** Illia Kyva, a politician for the pro-Russian Opposition Platform — For Life, is deprived of his MP status in the Verkhovna Rada, Ukraine's parliament. A further four MPs quit the party.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax Ukraine](<https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/813750.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-15-6-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Northeastern U.S. serial shooter.

**Archived source account.** The DC Police Department arrest a suspected serial killer involved in the murders of two homeless men, and the attempted murder of three others in Washington, D.C. and New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2022/03/15/suspect-in-deadly-shooting-spree-of-dc-nyc-homeless-people-arrested/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-03-15-7-2"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate unanimously passes a bipartisan resolution declaring Russian President Vladimir Putin a war criminal, and calls for his investigation by the International Criminal Court.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-senate-unanimously-condemns-putin-war-criminal-2022-03-15/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-15-7-4"></a>

Context: 2022 Turkmenistan presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Serdar Berdimuhamedow is elected President of Turkmenistan, succeeding his father Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedow.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/central-asia-asia-turkmenistan-presidential-elections-elections-3d13e95fe055bf53525141c351708488>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-03-15-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Intel pledges €33 billion in investments in the European Union factories and research facilities, including €17 billion for building a chip-making plant in Magdeburg, Germany and €12 billion for upgrading the Irish plant; the company promises €80 billion over the next decade for the EU.

Source citations (as archived): [ZDNet](<https://www.zdnet.com/article/intel-to-spend-eur33-billion-on-new-eu-fabs-r-d-expansions/>).

### 2022-03-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1223162869](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20March%2016&oldid=1223162869>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-03-16-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive / Siege of Mariupol / Mariupol theatre airstrike.

**Archived source account.** The Donetsk Regional Drama Theatre in Mariupol, which is currently being used as an air raid shelter holding up to 1,200 civilians, is largely destroyed by bombing. Ukraine accuses Russia of conducting an airstrike targeting the theatre, while Russian authorities deny responsibility, instead accusing the Azov Battalion of having planned and carried out the bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-60772331>); [RadioFreeEurope/RadioLiberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-mariupol-thearer-destroyed-strike/31756641.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-0-8"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Northeastern Ukraine offensive / Siege of Chernihiv.

**Archived source account.** Russian troops reportedly shoot dead ten people queuing for food in Chernihiv. The Russian Defence Ministry denies Russian forces were behind the killings.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/ukraine-war-kyiv-exploiting-russian-forces-lack-of-manoeuvre-and-inflicting-heavy-losses-mod-says-12567393>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us-embassy-kyiv-without-citing-evidence-says-russian-forces-shot-dead-10-people-2022-03-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-0-11"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine offensive / Battle of Melitopol.

**Archived source account.** Captured Melitopol mayor Ivan Fedorov is freed in exchange for nine Russian POWs.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3431846-melitopol-mayor-exchanged-for-nine-russian-pows.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-0-13"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** British Defence Secretary Ben Wallace says that the UK has begun supplying Starstreak anti-aircraft missiles to the Ukrainian military.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/uk-supplying-starstreak-anti-aircraft-missiles-ukraine-defence-minister-wallace-2022-03-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-0-14"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden announces a further $800 million in "security assistance" to Ukraine, including 800 anti-aircraft systems, and thousands of anti-tank missiles and armed combat drones to counter Russia's invasion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/biden-says-us-give-ukraine-drones-anti-aircraft-systems-2022-03-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-0-15"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin addresses his ministers on the ongoing situation in Ukraine and the Russian economy, saying that Russian "traitors" and "scum" would be "spat out like a midge that accidentally flew into their mouths", and also accuses a so-called "fifth column" of attempting to destroy the country from within.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/putin-warns-russia-against-pro-western-traitors-scum-2022-03-16/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-03-16-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Fukushima earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A 7.3 magnitude earthquake strikes off Fukushima, Japan, triggering tsunami warnings and causing power outages for millions of people in Tokyo. At least four people are killed and 94 others are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/3/16/7-3-magnitude-quake-shakes-east-japan-triggers-tsunami-advisory>); [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/earthquake-in-japan-earthquake-near-tokyo-japan-today-with-magnitude-7-1-2826975>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-03-16-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korea reports a record 400,741 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Korea Herald](<http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20220316000191>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 vaccine.

**Archived source account.** A compromise is reached regarding a COVID-19 vaccine intellectual property waiver for developing countries. According to the compromise, developing countries which have exported less than 10% of the world's COVID-19 vaccine doses in 2021 do not need to seek consent from the owner of the patent before authorising the vaccine. The patent waiver does not apply to other COVID-19-related pharmaceutical products.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/compromise-reached-on-covid-19-vaccine-intellectual-property-rights-waiver/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-2"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov says that there is hope of reaching a compromise aimed at a ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico.eu](<https://www.politico.eu/article/zelenskyy-peace-talks-russia-realistic-accept-compromise-nato/amp/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-3"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** In a report from the Financial Times, a peace plan is drafted by Ukraine and Russia. The conditions include a ceasefire and Russian withdrawal if Ukraine abandons all attempts of joining NATO and accepts limits on its armed forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Naharnet](<https://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/288568-report-ukraine-and-russia-draw-up-neutrality-plan-to-end-war>); [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/7b341e46-d375-4817-be67-802b7fa77ef1>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-5"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Japan–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Japan announces that it will revoke Russia's most favoured nation trade status as part of further sanctions on Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japan-revoke-russias-most-favoured-nation-trade-status-sources-2022-03-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-7"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Belarus–Canada relations.

**Archived source account.** Canada bans Belarusian aircraft from its airspace due to Belarus's support of Russia in the invasion.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/transportation/598476-belarusian-aircraft-banned-from-canadian-airspace>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-9"></a>

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia in the Council of Europe.

**Archived source account.** Russia is expelled from the Council of Europe due to the invasion of Ukraine, although the Russian Foreign Ministry had previously announced that it would be quitting the organisation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-europe-93fbcec1badeb3a33ed1c0b3a0fbab9e>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-11"></a>

Context: Iran–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Iranian-British dual citizens Nazanin Zaghari-Ratcliffe and Anoosheh Ashoori are released from prison in Iran and return to the United Kingdom after spending 5 years and 11 months, and 2 years and 7 months, respectively, in prison for suspected espionage.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-60756870>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-12"></a>

Context: Iran–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The British government releases US$500 million of sanctioned Iranian assets after Iran releases the prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-60756870>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-14"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean military says that North Korea launched a suspected ballistic missile from Pyongyang International Airport, which exploded prematurely in mid-air.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/north-korea-fires-what-could-be-missile-nhk-citing-defmin-source-2022-03-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-16"></a>

Context: Iranian nuclear program.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps announces a new independent branch called the Nuclear Command Corps.

Source citations (as archived): [Asriran](<https://www.asriran.com/fa/news/831149/%D8%B3%D9%BE%D8%A7%D9%87-%D8%AD%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B8%D8%AA-%D9%88-%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%86%DB%8C%D8%AA-%D9%87%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87-%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%A8%D9%87-%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%AE%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B3%D9%BE%D8%A7%D9%87-%D8%A7%D8%B6%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%87-%D8%B4%D8%AF>).

<a id="event-2022-03-16-3-18"></a>

Context: China–United States relations, Chinese espionage in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors for the U.S. Justice Department accuse five people working on behalf of the Chinese Ministry of State Security of conspiring to spy on and intimidate several dissidents living in the United States, such as the father of Olympic figure skater Alysa Liu, and Tiananmen Square protest leader and current congressional candidate Xiong Yan. The department says it is the first time that federal elections in the country have been interfered with in this manner. Three have been arrested while two remain at large.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/mar/16/china-smear-democratic-candidate-us-congress>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/60773595>).

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The International Court of Justice orders Russia to immediately halt its invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/world-court-rule-emergency-measures-ukraine-vs-russia-case-2022-03-16/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-03-16-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of Kazakhstan Kassym-Jomart Tokayev proposes a series of reforms to the national parliament, including re-establishing the Constitutional Court, reducing the membership requirement for establishing political parties from 20,000 to 5,000, reducing the number of parliament deputies appointed by the president, and restoring three regions that were merged during the 1990s. He says that the purpose of these reforms is to move the current political system from "superpresidential" rule to a presidential republic with a strong parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kazakh-president-tokayev-lays-out-constitutional-reform-plan-2022-03-16/>).

Context: Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/crtc-russia-today-broadcasting-decision-1.6386929>).

### 2022-03-17

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** British Defence Secretary Ben Wallace announces that the UK is deploying a Sky Sabre air defence system to Poland, and 100 troops to operate it as part of NATO's response to Russian military aggression.

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-03-17-1-2"></a>

Context: Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian War / Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** Steam announces that they will stop payments to Belarus, Russia, and Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [PCMag](<https://www.pcmag.com/news/steam-stops-all-payments-to-russia-belarus-and-ukraine?amp=true>).

<a id="event-2022-03-17-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives votes 424–8 to suspend trade relations with Russia and Belarus following the invasion.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna20508>).

<a id="event-2022-03-17-1-5"></a>

Context: P&amp;O sacking of 800 staff.

**Archived source account.** DP World-owned shipping company P&amp;O Ferries fires all 800 crew members across its entire fleet of ferries and replaces them with cheaper agency workers who were bussed in by the company in advance. Many crew members refuse to leave their ships after being made redundant and are forcibly removed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-60779001>).

<a id="event-2022-03-17-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amazon agrees to purchase American film studio Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer for US$8.5 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Variety](<https://variety.com/2022/tv/news/amazon-mgm-merger-close-1235207852/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-03-26-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 65 terabytes of data belonging to the Federal Air Transport Agency (Rosaviation), the Russian airspace regulator, gets lost indefinitely in a hacker attack, which is said to be one of the largest ever. The data lost includes all official documents, files on its servers, the public procurement system of Rosaviation, as well as all emails for the last one and a half years; no backups are available. As a result, the agency is forced to switch to paper-based workflow.

Source citations (as archived): [Kommersant](<https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/5281896>); [Aviation24.be](<https://www.aviation24.be/miscellaneous/russo-ukrainian-war/powerful-cyber-attack-on-russias-civil-aviation-authority-servers-no-more-data-nor-back-up/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-28-0-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** Militants belonging to the March 23 Movement attack military bases near Goma in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Congolese authorities say that two Rwandan soldiers were participating in the attack. The movement have regrouped and retaken strategic areas for the first time since their defeat in 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/m23-rebels-attack-military-positions-eastern-congo-2022-03-28/>).

It is the second P&amp;O Ferries ship to be detained by UK authorities since the firm fired all 800 British crew members and replaced them with cheaper agency workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/another-p-o-ferry-pride-of-kent-being-detained-amid-sackings-scandal-12577050>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-60895833>).

### 2022-03-29

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine offensive / Battle of Mykolaiv / Mykolaiv government building airstrike.

**Archived source account.** A missile strike hits the regional administration's headquarters in Mykolaiv, killing twelve people and injuring 22 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-rocket-blasts-hole-mykolaiv-administration-building-southern-ukraine-2022-03-29/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine offensive / Kyiv offensive, Northeastern Ukraine offensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian troops begin retreating from positions in Kyiv Oblast and Chernihiv Oblast, according to Ukrainian and American officials. The United States European Command confirms the Russian withdrawal, observing a "major strategy shift".

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world-report/articles/2022-03-29/russia-begins-retreat-from-kyiv-in-major-strategy-shift-u-s-general>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/moscow-says-it-will-curb-assault-on-kyiv-chernihiv-russian-troops-seen-withdrawing/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-9"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine offensive / Snake Island campaign.

**Archived source account.** Roman Hrybov, the border guard who told the Russian warship command over the radio "Russian warship, go fuck yourself" in defiance of its order to surrender Snake Island, is freed in a prisoner swap. Initial reports erroneously suggested that 13 border guards on the island had died.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/mar/29/ukrainian-soldier-russian-warship-medal-snake-island>).

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-12"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. deploys 200 marines from the Marine Air Control Group 28, 10 F/A-18 Hornet fighter jets, and an unspecified number of C-130s to Lithuania as part of NATO's response to Russian military aggression in Eastern Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [USNI](<https://news.usni.org/2022/03/29/u-s-sends-200-marines-10-f-18-hornets-sent-to-eastern-europe-for-russian-deterrence>).

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-14"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian and Russian delegations hold face-to-face peace talks in Turkey for the first time in two weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-zelenskyy-ap-top-news-europe-istanbul-4625afe04bd10a05c14914bb9f4ef0b0>).

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-15"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Peace negotiations in the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Russian officials agree to "fundamentally cut back military activity in the direction of Kyiv and Chernihiv" during the negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/mar/29/russia-ukraine-war-latest-news-live-updates-putin-moscow-kremlin-zelenskiy-kyiv-russian-invasion?page=with:block-6242f5d78f08eff3d4ebea24#block-6242f5d78f08eff3d4ebea24>).

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-16"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A shell strikes a temporary Russian military camp near the city of Belgorod, 25 km from the Russia–Ukraine border. Russian authorities report at least four injuries, and say that the shell was fired from Ukrainian territory. Ukraine denies firing the missile, instead attributing the strike to an error on Russia's part.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/explosions-heard-outside-russian-city-close-ukraine-border-governor-2022-03-29/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-29-0-19"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / 2022 Bnei Brak shootings.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and another is injured during a series of drive-by shootings in Bnei Brak, Tel Aviv District, Israel. The attacker, a Fatah sympathizer, is shot dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-702649>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/4-killed-1-critically-hurt-in-bnei-brak-shooting/>).

**Archived source account.** Bandits attack villages in the Bakura and Talata Mafura local government areas of Nigeria. Many people are killed.

**Archived source account.** Six Pakistani crew members and a Russian and a Serbian soldier are killed as a MONUSCO helicopter crashes in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The rebel March 23 Movement group is accused of being behind the crash. The group has denied their involvement.

<a id="event-2022-03-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Cyberwarfare by Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia announces that it will ban all usage of software from other countries in government agencies beginning in 2025. Additionally, beginning on March 31, all foreign software purchases for government agencies must be pre-approved by the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/ukraine-crisis-russia-software/russia-to-monitor-foreign-software-purchases-for-state-institutions-decree-idUSS8N2VH098>); [TASS](<https://tass.com/economy/1429887>).

<a id="event-2022-03-30-4-2"></a>

Context: Cyberwarfare by Russia.

**Archived source account.** It is reported that Russian government hackers have attacked and compromised the servers of Hungary's Ministry of Foreign Affairs since late 2021.

Source citations (as archived): [Direkt36](<https://www.direkt36.hu/en/putyin-hekkerei-is-latjak-a-magyar-kulugy-titkait-az-orban-kormany-evek-ota-nem-birja-elharitani-oket/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-30-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hubble Space Telescope observes the most distant single star ever. The star, named Earendel by astronomers, is 28 billion light-years away. It is the farthest detection of a star, dating back 900 million years after the Big Bang. This discovery surpasses Hubble's record from 2018, when it discovered a star that existed when the universe was roughly four billion years old.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/30/world/hubble-distant-star-image-scn/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-03-30-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021–22 UEFA Women's Champions League knockout phase.

**Archived source account.** A crowd of 91,553 attends the second leg of the quarterfinal between archrivals FC Barcelona and Real Madrid at Camp Nou in Barcelona. This surpasses the 90,185 at the 1999 FIFA Women's World Cup Final and is reportedly the largest attendance for a women's football match since Mexico–Denmark (110,000) in 1971. Barça won 5–2 on the day and 8–3 on aggregate.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/soccer/barcelona-barcelona_women/story/4628542/barcelona-real-madrid-womens-champions-league-clash-breaks-attendance-world-record>).

### 2022-03-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355491769](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20March%2031&oldid=1355491769>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-03-31-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Chernobyl.

**Archived source account.** Energoatom confirms that the Russian forces who occupied the former nuclear power plant in Chernobyl have left the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3444941-russian-invaders-leaving-chornobyl-npp-energoatom.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Chernobyl.

**Archived source account.** The International Atomic Energy Agency confirms that Russian forces have handed over control of the former nuclear power plant back to Ukraine. Russian troops also withdraw from the city of Slavutych, returning to Belarus.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2022/03/31/russians-hand-control-of-chernobyl-nuclear-plant-back-to-ukraine-iaea-says.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Siege of Mariupol.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian Deputy Prime Minister Iryna Vereshchuk says that Ukraine has sent buses to Mariupol in an effort to evacuate citizens from the city.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60938429>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-0-8"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict, 2022 Bnei Brak shootings.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 14 more injured as the Israeli Defense Forces raid the city of Jenin in the West Bank in order to capture a suspect linked to Tuesday's shooting in Bnei Brak.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-kills-at-least-2-palestinians-in-jenin-gunbattle-israeli-injured-in-stabbing/>); [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/three-palestinians-wounded-in-gunfire-exchange-with-israeli-army-in-jenin-1.10710447>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict, 2022 Bnei Brak shootings.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian militant uses a screwdriver to stab and seriously injure an Israeli civilian on a bus in Neve Daniel, before being shot dead by another passenger.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israeli-moderately-wounded-after-stabbing-attack-on-west-bank-bus-1.10710569>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-0-10"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict, 2022 Bnei Brak shootings.

**Archived source account.** Rock throwing causes a bus to crash into a car in Halhul, West Bank, injuring two people.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/rock-attack-causes-car-crash-in-west-bank-wounding-2/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2022-03-31-1-1"></a>

Context: Expo 2020.

**Archived source account.** The world expo in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, which was delayed to October 1, 2021, closes after six months.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/covid-entertainment-business-health-middle-east-bfb77f420f3f6429b37bdebf0f6bc024>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-03-31-2-2"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Boycott of Russia and Belarus.

**Archived source account.** Australia revokes the most favoured nation status for Russia and Belarus, and will impose 35% tariffs on produce coming from these countries beginning on April 25.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2022/mar/31/australia-news-live-updates-rain-weather-floods-nsw-qld-scott-morrison-election-budget-zelenskiy-covid-coronavirus>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-2-4"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 global energy crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden orders the release of up to one million barrels of crude oil per day from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve for the next six months in an attempt to contain inflation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/mar/31/us-release-oil-strategic-reserve-gas-price>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-03-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Wildfires in 2022.

**Archived source account.** Evacuations and school closures are issued in Sevier County, Tennessee, United States, after a wildfire, known as the Hatcher Mountain Road/Indigo Lane Fire, breaks out near the Great Smoky Mountains National Park and grows to 1,000 acres.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/31/weather/tennessee-brush-fire-evacuations/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A chartered helicopter travelling to Ulupna Island, Victoria, Australia, crashes into Mount Disappointment, killing all five people onboard.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-03-31/helicopter-crash-mount-disappointment-north-of-melbourne/100954600>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-03-31-4-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan disbands ll the National Command and Operations Center (NCOC), which was overseeing the COVID-19 response in the country, as the infection’s numbers were at the lowest since the start of the outbreak early in 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-disbands-covid-19-response-body-infections-lowest-2022-03-31/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-03-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Georgia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Georgia says plans by the breakaway state of South Ossetia, which is internationally recognized as occupied Georgian territory, to hold a referendum on becoming a part of Russia are "unacceptable".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/breakaway-georgian-region-abkhazia-says-it-has-no-plans-join-russia-2022-03-31/>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Micronesian president David Panuelo urges Solomon Islands to not sign a security pact with China, citing "grave security concerns" and arguing that the Pacific islands would be "the epicenter of major confrontation" between major powers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/micronesia-urges-solomons-islands-not-sign-china-security-pact-2022-03-31/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-03-31-6-1"></a>

Context: Russia investigation origins counter-narrative.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Federal Election Commission fines the Democratic National Committee (DNC) and Hillary Clinton's 2016 campaign for violating rules by funding the Steele dossier, a dossier which made accusations of collusion between the Trump campaign and Russia. Both the DNC and Clinton's campaign have agreed not to contest the fines and to pay civil penalties of US$105,000 and US$8,000 respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2022/03/30/fec-dnc-clinton-campaign/>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/fec-fines-clinton-campaign-dnc-over-spending-trump-russia-dossier-2022-3>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-6-3"></a>

Context: Sri Lankan economic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka Police impose an indefinite curfew in the city of Colombo after protesters attempted to storm president Gotabaya Rajapaksa's private residence amid anger over worsening economic conditions and power outages in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/3/31/tear-gas-as-sri-lanka-protesters-try-to-storm-presidents-house>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-03-31-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The acting Australian Information Commissioner orders the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) to comply with a request by The Guardian under the Freedom of Information Act 1982, which the PMO had previously rejected, and search the mobile phone of Prime Minister Scott Morrison for correspondence with Morrison's friend and QAnon conspiracy theorist Tim Stewart. The Australian Broadcasting Corporation has alleged that Stewart influenced Morrison's use of the term "ritual abuse" in a speech to survivors of child sexual abuse in 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/mar/31/scott-morrison-australian-pm-prime-minister-must-reveal-any-text-messages-from-qanon-friend-tim-stewart-burnedspy34-information-watchdog-orders>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-03-31-8-1"></a>

Context: Censorship of Wikipedia, Media freedom in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian media censorship agency Roskomnadzor threatens to fine Wikipedia up to 4 million rubles (about US$49,000) if it does not delete information that contradicts the Kremlin's official narrative on the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/dereksaul/2022/03/31/russia-demands-wikipedia-take-down-information-about-ukraine-war/?sh=4e48a7b966f2>).

<a id="event-2022-03-31-8-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists sequence the complete human genome for the first time, more than three decades after the Human Genome Project was first commenced.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/31/health/first-complete-human-genome-sequence/index.html>).

### 2022-04-01

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Russia / COVID-19 vaccination in Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.com/world/1431285>).

<a id="event-2022-04-01-2-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/italy-ends-covid-19-state-emergency-curbs-be-lifted-gradually-2022-04-01/>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Malaysia begins its transition from pandemic to endemic phase that shift the management of the pandemic from reliance on government-imposed standard operating procedures and existing laws to individual responsibility, and community solidarity.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2022/04/01/malaysia-only-in-transition-to-endemic-phase-keep-following-sop-says-health-dg>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. CDC announces that the Biden administration will end the usage of Title 42, a series of COVID-19 restrictions imposed by the Trump administration in order to prevent migrants from entering the United States. The measure will take effect on May 23.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2022/04/01/cdc-will-end-title-42-used-to-expel-migrants-during-covid.html>).

Metsola becomes the first EU official to visit Ukraine since the Russian invasion began.

Context: Sri Lankan economic crisis / 2022 Sri Lankan protests.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-04-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Argentinian farmers protest against President Alberto Fernández's new export taxes on farm goods, which protesters say is a "rope that is being used to choke us". The farmers used tractors to block the road leading to the Casa Rosada in Buenos Aires.

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-04-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Major League Baseball season.

**Archived source account.** In baseball, the Chicago Cubs defeat the Pittsburgh Pirates, 21–0, the largest defeat in Pirates history and the largest victory in Cubs history since 1901.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/pittsburgh/news/pirates-surrender-21-runs-to-cubs-in-worst-loss-in-franchise-history/>); [Chicago Sun Times](<https://chicago.suntimes.com/cubs/2022/4/23/23038891/cubs-make-history-in-21-0-rout-of-pirates-alfonso-rivas-seiya-suzuki>).

<a id="event-2022-04-23-4-3"></a>

Context: Tyson Fury vs. Dillian Whyte.

**Archived source account.** Tyson Fury retains the WBC world heavyweight title after defeating Dillian Whyte via technical knockout in round 6 in front of 94,000 spectators at Wembley Stadium, London, a post-war British record. Post-match, Fury suggests that he may now retire from professional boxing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/61188235>).

Macron becomes the first incumbent President to win re-election since Jacques Chirac's victory in the 2002 French presidential election against Jean-Marie Le Pen, Marine Le Pen's father.

Context: Russia in the European energy sector / 2022 Russia–European Union gas dispute.

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–United Kingdom relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/russias-chilling-threat-launch-strike-26809824>); [iNews](<https://inews.co.uk/news/ukraine-war-russian-provinces-explosions-kremlin-uk-provoking-ukrainian-attacks-1597182>).

<a id="event-2022-04-27-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russia–United Kingdom relations.

<a id="event-2022-04-27-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

### 2022-05-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185869561](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20May%201&oldid=1185869561>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-05-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive / Siege of Mariupol.

**Archived source account.** Some civilian evacuations begin from the Azovstal iron and steel works in Mariupol. Officials believe that up to 1,000 people have sought refuge at the plant, which has been the target of Russian airstrikes for days. However, evacuations are suspended until 8 a.m. tomorrow due to "security concerns".

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2022/04/30/ukraine-russia-azovstal/>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-05-01-22/h_be33798404aab0c960b4368d8c1ea7d0>).

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / April 2022 Belgorod and Bryansk attacks.

<a id="event-2022-05-03-4-1"></a>

Context: European Parliament constituency.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament votes in favour of an election law overhaul, to be confirmed and possibly amended by the European Council, that will create a 28-seat pan-EU constituency and introduce elections of the President of the European Commission by popular vote. The reform will also create the European Electoral Authority, introduce postal voting for all EU residents, lower the minimum age of candidates to 18 and fix elections on Europe Day, May 9.

Source citations (as archived): [Euractiv](<https://www.euractiv.com/section/elections/news/european-parliament-agrees-position-on-eu-election-law-overhaul/>).

**Archived source account.** The United States Federal Reserve announces that it is raising interest rates by 0.5%, which is the largest interest rate hike since 2000, in order to combat growing inflation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/04/economy/federal-reserve-interest-rate-hike/index.html>).

Context: 2022 Pulitzer Prizes.

**Archived source account.** The Washington Post wins the Pulitzer Prize for Public Service for its coverage of the 2021 United States Capitol attack. The New York Times wins the Pulitzer Prize for International Reporting on the war on terror's failed bombing campaigns and the most awards overall.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2022/05/09/business/media/pulitzer-prizes-new-york-times-washington-post.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/05/09/1097668290/2022-pulitzer-prize-news-winners>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-05-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nigeria's airlines say that they have cancelled a plan to suspend domestic flights, a decision they had previously made due to an increase in the cost of aviation fuel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-61374718>).

<a id="event-2022-05-09-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Royal Thai Army announces it will ban all army personnel from using the Singaporean e-commerce site Lazada for allegedly insulting the royal family in a Facebook video ad. Digital Economy Minister Chaiwut Thanakamanusorn in a separate statement said the government is considering legal action against both Lazada and the advertising agency responsible for the ad.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/thai-army-boycotts-online-retailer-lazada-after-video-enrages-royalists-2022-05-09/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-05-09-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person dies and eleven others are missing after a fishing boat sinks off the coast of Ghana.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_live&amp;ns_linkname=627935cf9f4dc855020389d8%26Eleven%20missing%20after%20Ghana%20fishing%20boat%20sinks%262022-05-09T15%3A58%3A37.827Z&amp;ns_fee=0&amp;pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:d5a325ef-95ea-4150-a2a3-aad4d89385f2&amp;pinned_post_asset_id=627935cf9f4dc855020389d8&amp;pinned_post_type=share>).

<a id="event-2022-05-09-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and fifty others are injured after a tear gas grenade is set off causing a human stampede at a public university in Potosí, Bolivia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/caribbean-bolivia-la-paz-df09e2e92cbb55665e197d709963b0fc>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-05-09-4-1"></a>

Context: Enlargement of NATO.

**Archived source account.** The Swedish Social Democratic Party announces that it will decide on May 15 whether to pursue a course of action to join NATO. Finnish President Sauli Niinistö is expected to also announce Finland's intention to join NATO on May 12.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/5/9/swedens-ruling-party-to-decide-on-nato-membership-on-may-15>).

<a id="event-2022-05-09-4-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Iran, Foreign relations of Transnistria.

**Archived source account.** Iranians in Moldova are urged to leave the country due to rising tensions in pro-Russian Transnistria and spillover effects from the war in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Tasnim](<https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2022/05/09/2707559/iranians-urged-to-leave-moldova>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-05-09-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Ecuador prison riots.

**Archived source account.** A prison riot in Santo Domingo, Ecuador, kills 44 inmates.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ecuador-prison-clash-leaves-43-inmates-dead-84598447>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-05-09-6-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Philippine general election.

**Archived source account.** Filipinos head to the polls to elect officials in the Presidential, Senate, House of Representatives, Gubernatorial, and other local elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/may/09/philippines-presidential-election-2022-voting-begins-leni-robredo-ferdinand-bongbong-marcos-jr-polls-open-president>).

<a id="event-2022-05-09-6-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Philippine general election.

**Archived source account.** Bongbong Marcos, the son of late Philippine dictator Ferdinand Marcos, is leading in the preliminary and unofficial results to become the next President.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/09/asia/philippines-election-results-marcos-robredo-intl-hnk/index.html>).

### 2022-05-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090097197](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20May%2010&oldid=1090097197>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-05-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Ituri conflict, 2021–2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen people are killed during an attack by suspected CODECO militants at a refugee camp in Fataki, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-14-dead-east-congo-refugee-camp-attack-2022-05-10/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-10-0-3"></a>

Context: 2022 Sri Lankan protests.

**Archived source account.** The Sri Lankan Defense Ministry authorizes the Army and police force to shoot looters and assailants and to arrest protesters without warrants in response to yesterday's violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/5/10/sri-lanka-gives-emergency-powers-to-army-police-after-violence>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-05-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Apple announces it will discontinue sales of the iPod Touch, officially ending the iPod line of portable media players after more than 20 years.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2022/5/10/23065412/apple-ipod-touch-canceled-discontinued>).

<a id="event-2022-05-10-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The operator of Ukraine's natural gas system GTSOU announces that it will stop shipments of Russian gas through the Sokhranivka route on Wednesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/ukraine-gas-system-operator-declares-force-majeure-sokhranivka-entry-point-2022-05-10/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-05-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Lithuania–Russia relations, Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Seimas of Lithuania unanimously votes to designate Russia as a terrorist state and to classify Russia's actions in Ukraine as genocide.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/05/10/1097911440/lithuania-russia-terrorism-genocide-ukraine>).

<a id="event-2022-05-10-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a rare public rebuke, World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus criticizes China's "Zero-COVID" policy as "unsustainable", advising the Chinese government to change its strategy.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/5/10/who-says-chinas-zero-covid-strategy-unsustainable>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-05-10-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Philippine presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Former Senator of the Philippines Bongbong Marcos, son of dictator Ferdinand Marcos, is expected to become the next President of the Philippines, based on partial and unofficial counts. Marcos has more than twice as many votes as the next closest candidate Leni Robredo, the current Vice President of the Philippines. The victory will be officially ratified by the Congress of the Philippines in late May.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-61381594>).

<a id="event-2022-05-10-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Crown Prince of Kuwait Mishal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah accepts the resignation of the Government of Kuwait, after the request had been submitted more than a month ago. No timeline is given for when the next election will occur.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/kuwaiti-emiri-decree-accepts-government-resignation-2022-05-10/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-10-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yoon Suk-yeol is sworn in as the 13th President of South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/10/asia/yoon-suk-yeol-south-korea-president-inauguration-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-05-10-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Katalin Novák takes office as the first female President of Hungary.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/3/10/hungary-elects-katalin-novak-first-ever-woman-president>).

### 2022-05-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1297689122](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20May%2011&oldid=1297689122>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 bombing of Odesa.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces continue to fire missiles at the Ukrainian port city of Odesa in an apparent attempt to cut supplies to the city.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-putin-business-nato-moscow-c8e00f7bbc4f24aa40d70a4ac2d97adb>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-4"></a>

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Kharkiv.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian military forces recapture several settlements north of Kharkiv, driving Russian troops to less than a dozen miles from the Russian border.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/ukraine-retakes-territory-in-the-east-amid-more-russian-attacks/ar-AAX9il1?>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-7"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Killing of Shireen Abu Akleh.

**Archived source account.** Al Jazeera journalist Shireen Abu Akleh is killed while covering a raid in Jenin. Palestinian sources say that Abu Akleh was shot by Israeli soldiers, while Israeli sources say that she was likely killed by indiscriminate fire by Palestinian militants. Israel eventually admitted and apologized for the murder after initial denials. Another journalist and two other Palestinians are injured in the shooting.

Source citations (as archived): ['IDF apologizes for death of Al Jazeera’s Shireen Abu Akleh'](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/11/middleeast/idf-apology-shireen-abu-akleh-intl/index.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/05/11/1098157067/al-jazeera-shireen-abu-akleh-killed-israel>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-8"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian is shot dead after charging at police officers in Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-shot-after-lunging-at-police-officers-in-jerusalems-old-city/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-10"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb.

**Archived source account.** Eight soldiers are killed and 13 others are injured during an ambush by Al-Qaeda-linked militants in Kpendjal Prefecture, Togo. The attack is believed to be connected to the current insurgency in Burkina Faso, making it the first Islamic extremist attack in Togo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/eight-soldiers-killed-attack-north-togo-government-says-state-tv-2022-05-11/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-12"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed by a suicide bomber at a checkpoint in Mogadishu, Somalia. Al-Shabaab claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/police-africa-somalia-mogadishu-c4354fd8d7393ef96b896d51ef48304d>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-14"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Seven soldiers are killed and two others are missing after gunmen ambush them in Taraba State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kill-seven-nigerian-soldiers-ambush-army-patrol-sources-2022-05-11/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-0-16"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Five soldiers are killed and four others are injured during a shooting at a security post in North Sinai, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/five-egyptian-troops-killed-attack-north-sinai-peninsula-sources-2022-05-11/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-05-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A small plane crashes in Cameroon with eleven people on board. It is unknown if any casualties occurred.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/chad-forests-transportation-west-africa-7a386801f2312bc6d9d021f2c479289d>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-05-11-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern announces that New Zealand will fully reopen its borders on July 31, two months before the government lifts all remaining pandemic restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/5/11/new-zealand-to-fully-reopen-borders-from-july-31>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / European Union response to the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) and the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) announce in a joint statement that, starting next week, masks are no longer required for flights or in airports. However, the EASA asks passengers to "behave responsibly and respect the choices of others around them," while the ECDC recommends that passengers continue to practice social distancing if it can be done in a non-disruptive manner.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/travel/2022/05/11/face-masks-to-be-scrapped-on-flights-in-europe-this-is-when-the-rule-comes-into-force>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-2-6"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States.

**Archived source account.** COVID-19 passes a threshold of 1 million confirmed deaths in the United States, according to a Reuters tally. Some news outlets declared that the 1 million mark was reached a week earlier.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/investigates/special-report/health-coronavirus-usa-casualties/>); [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/covids-toll-us-reaches-1-million-deaths-unfathomable-number-rcna22105>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-05-11-3-1"></a>

Context: Finland–United Kingdom relations, Sweden–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Boris Johnson signs security agreements with Finland and Sweden, pledging British military assistance to both Nordic countries should they come under attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/uk-strikes-new-security-agreement-with-sweden-finland-2022-05-11/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-05-11-4-1"></a>

Context: American Indian boarding schools.

**Archived source account.** A report by the US Department of the Interior identifies 53 burial sites of Native American children near boarding schools, where children were forcibly sent to according to the 19th and 20th century federal government's policy of assimilation. Preliminary results suggest that more than 500 children were found to have died while in school custody.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/interior-dept-investigation-finds-burial-sites-53-indian-boarding-schools-2022-05-11/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-4-3"></a>

Context: Surfside condominium collapse.

**Archived source account.** A tentative settlement of $997 million is reached with the families of victims and survivors of the condo collapse in Surfside, Florida, United States. However, the settlement is still subject to final approval.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/ivanka-trump-miami-lawsuits-florida-surfside-building-collapse-5620fbf1af2c36bfb67d605eb1a3ae3b>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-4-5"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Greece.

**Archived source account.** Greece bans the practice of conversion therapy for minors as well as all advertisements promoting it.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greece-bans-lgbtq-conversion-therapy-2022-05-11/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong's national security police arrest four people, including Cardinal Joseph Zen, Cantopop singer Denise Ho, and former legislative councilwoman Margaret Ng, in connection with a fund that provided aid to protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/may/11/hong-kong-national-security-police-arrest-cardinal-joseph-zen>).

<a id="event-2022-05-11-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Iranian Ministry of Intelligence says that it has arrested two European nationals for allegedly attempting to destabilize the nation in connection with foreign intelligence services.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2022/05/11/Two-European-nationals-arrested-in-Iran-Report>).

### 2022-05-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355490772](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20May%2012&oldid=1355490772>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-05-12-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian forces repel an attempted Russian military crossing of the Donets river, west of Sievierodonetsk, in Luhansk Oblast. At least one Russian battalion tactical group is reportedly destroyed, as well as the pontoon bridge deployed in the crossing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-forces-prevented-attempted-russian-river-crossing-donbas-britain-says-2022-05-13/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Air Force launches around a dozen missiles at the city of Kremenchuk, including four at the Kremenchuk Oil Refinery, in Poltava Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3481727-eight-to-twelve-russian-missiles-hit-poltava-regions-kremenchuk.html>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-0-6"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

**Archived source account.** Turkey says that five people were injured by Kurdish nationalists launching a missile attack into the country from Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/five-wounded-turkey-hit-by-rockets-fired-syria-ministry-2022-05-12/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and thirteen others injured by a roadside bombing targeting a van in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-bombings-karachi-45d299b6982481b73236b12888b62666>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-05-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The cryptocurrency market loses US$200 billion following stablecoin TerraUSD's collapse in value. Bitcoin and Ether fall to their lowest value in 16 and 11 months, respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/12/bitcoin-btc-price-falls-below-27000-as-crypto-sell-off-intensifies.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-05-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Tibet Airlines Flight 9833.

**Archived source account.** An A319-100 aircraft operated by Tibet Airlines veers off the runway and catches fire at Chongqing Jiangbei International Airport in Yubei District, Chongqing, China, injuring forty people, with some being hospitalized.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2308894/chinese-plane-catches-fire-at-airport-all-passengers-evacuated>); [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/chinas-tibet-airlines-plane-with-122-people-veers-off-runway-catches-fire-over-40-injured/article65406496.ece>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are feared dead and twenty others are injured in a chemical plant explosion and fire in Kočevje, Slovenia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/explosions-slovenia-ljubljana-68f368fe7ff5030ed8a4a37782e75c67>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people die and thirty-one others are rescued after a boat capsizes off the coast of Puerto Rico near Desecheo Island.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/immigration-puerto-rico-0e1f67149a9fbce830a5a5860cbbe48e>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-05-12-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea.

**Archived source account.** North Korea announces its first COVID-19 outbreak.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/covid-health-pandemics-south-korea-north-0e0cb1be7a3878a771124dcdcbdba06c>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-3-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North Korea.

**Archived source account.** Supreme Leader Kim Jong-un orders a national lockdown.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/41dec58c-3860-4ae3-86c4-716ffe85dbdd>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-3-5"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romania announces that starting on May 16, the fourth dose of Comirnaty – the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine – can be administered in vaccination centers and in family medicine offices for all adults.

Source citations (as archived): [Romania Insider](<https://www.romania-insider.com/romania-fourth-covid-dose-may-2022>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-05-12-4-2"></a>

Context: Enlargement of NATO / Finland–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** Finland's leaders declare that the country should apply for membership of NATO "without delay," with the Parliament set to vote next week on whether to apply.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2022/05/12/finland-announces-bid-to-join-nato-in-historic-move.html>); [President of the Republic of Finland](<https://www.presidentti.fi/en/press-release/joint-statement-by-the-president-of-the-republic-and-prime-minister-of-finland-on-finlands-nato-membership/>).

Context: Enlargement of NATO / Finland–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Foreign Affairs threatens to take retaliatory steps against Finland, including of a "military-technical" nature, if the country joins NATO.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-61420185>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-4-6"></a>

Context: France–Iran relations.

**Archived source account.** France summons the Iranian ambassador in response to the detainment of two French nationals.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/2-french-citizens-detained-in-iran-paris-calls-for-their-immediate-release/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-05-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of scientists at the Event Horizon Telescope release the first ever image of Sagittarius A\*, the supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way galaxy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-61412463>).

<a id="event-2022-05-12-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers from the University of Florida announce that plants have been grown on lunar soil, collected by Apollo missions, for the first time ever.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/space-exploration-science-technology-florida-46313ab85b13f33ff6767f75b98e9c47>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-05-12-6-1"></a>

Context: Boycott of Russia and Belarus, 2022 French Open.

**Archived source account.** Tennis players from Russia and Belarus will be allowed to compete at the upcoming French Open as neutral athletes. However, players who speak in support for Russian President Vladimir Putin will face sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [Tennis Majors](<https://www.tennismajors.com/roland-garros-news/mauresmo-says-russian-players-welcome-at-roland-garros-but-warns-of-sanctions-in-case-of-pro-putin-statements-598826.html>).

### 2022-05-13

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-05-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian state media says that a missile attack from Israel hit Masyaf, Hama Governorate, killing five people and injuring seven others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-air-defenses-confront-israeli-aggression-over-hama-countryside-syrian-2022-05-13/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-05-18-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around 200 anti-government militants block a road in Gorno-Badakhshan, Tajikistan, which links the country to China. Some of the militants, armed with firearms and petrol bombs, later ambush a security convoy on the same road. Eight militants and one officer are killed, while 13 officers are injured and more than 70 militants are arrested. The Tajik interior ministry later say the attack was an attempt to "destabilise the social and political situation" in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/tajikistan-starts-anti-terror-operation-near-china-afghan-borders-ria-2022-05-18/>).

The Access to Baby Formula Act passes with a 414–9 vote, and the Infant Formula Supplemental Appropriations Act passes with a 231–192.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna29497>); [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/full-list-house-republicans-voted-against-fda-baby-formula-bill-1708036?amp=1>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-05-20-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An unusually strong and early heat wave increases temperatures above 40 C in Spain. Seville records a temperature of 41.0 C, beating its all-time high for May, while the hottest settlement, Andújar, ties the record with 42.3 C. Several settlements in France, Switzerland, Liechtenstein and western Austria beat all-time high records for the month.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2022/05/23/world/asia/biden-taiwan-china.html>).

<a id="event-2022-05-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War, Turkish occupation of northern Syria.

**Archived source account.** Turkish president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan threatens to launch a new military incursion into northern Syria, targeting US-backed Kurdish Syrian Democratic Forces and expanding its occupation zone along Syria's northern border with Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Monitor](<https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2022/05/turkey-threatens-new-syria-incursion-amid-nato-debate>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-05-23-4-1"></a>

Context: War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** In the first trial for war crimes during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, 21-year-old Vadim Shishimarin, a Russian soldier, is sentenced to life in prison for fatally shooting a 62-year-old civilian.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/05/23/europe/ukraine-russian-soldier-war-crimes-trial-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-05-23-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A security guard is killed at the Qatari embassy in Paris, France.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/one-person-killed-qatar-embassy-paris-le-parisien-2022-05-23/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian authorities say that about 200 dead people are found in the rubble of an apartment building in Mariupol, Donetsk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/eu-oil-embargo-in-days-ukraine-isolation-drives-russia-closer-china-2022-05-23/>).

Context: Kashmir conflict / Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Operation Claw-Lock.

<a id="event-2022-05-24-0-21"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** An independent investigation by CNN, aided by a newly released video by fellow Al Jazeera correspondent, points to late journalist Shireen Abu Akleh having been deliberately targeted by IDF soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/05/24/middleeast/shireen-abu-akleh-jenin-killing-investigation-cmd-intl/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-05-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2019–present Sri Lankan economic crisis, Economy of Sri Lanka.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka increases fuel prices in order to help public finances and combat a debilitating economic crisis. Acting Prime Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe warns that "there is a possibility that inflation will increase further".

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/sri-lanka-increases-fuel-prices-combat-economic-crisis-2703361>).

<a id="event-2022-05-24-1-3"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Treasury announces that it will not renew the sanctions exemption which permits Russia to service its sovereign debt to American investors. Allowing the exemption to expire increases the likelihood that Russia will default on that debt this summer.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/treasury-to-block-u-s-investors-from-receiving-russian-debt-payments-11653420533>).

<a id="event-2022-05-24-1-5"></a>

Context: Collective action in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The National Union of Rail, Maritime and Transport Workers votes to go on a national strike in the United Kingdom for the first time since 1994 after demanding a "decent pay rise, job security and no compulsory redundancies".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-61573206>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India / COVID-19 pandemic in Gujarat.

**Archived source account.** Gujarat reports its first case of the Omicron BA.5 variant in a person who traveled to South Africa.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-05-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Robb Elementary School shooting.

**Archived source account.** Nineteen children and two teachers are killed in a mass shooting at an elementary school in Uvalde, Texas, United States. The gunman, a local 18-year-old high school student, is subsequently killed by police. The gunman had also shot and critically wounded his grandmother earlier in the day.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/texas-elementary-school-reports-active-shooter-campus/story?id=84940951>).

<a id="event-2022-05-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Media freedom in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The Russian State Duma passes a bill that will allow state prosecutors to close Russian bureaus of media outlets from countries that Russia deems "unfriendly". The bill will now need to be passed by the upper house and receive President Putin's signature.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/russian-parliament-passes-bill-allowing-moscow-close-western-news-bureaus-2022-05-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-24-4-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Pakistani protests.

**Archived source account.** A policeman is shot dead by a Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf official, leading to a police crackdown on pro-Imran Khan demonstrators.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-bans-ousted-pm-khans-protest-march-after-policeman-killed-2022-05-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-24-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ugandan police arrest veteran opposition politician Kizza Besigye for "inciting violence" and also disperse a crowd protesting against the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-arrests-oppositions-besigye-again-breaks-up-price-protests-2022-05-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-24-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anglo-Swiss commodity trading company Glencore pleads guilty to fraud charges related to bribery and price manipulation when pursuing preferential access to oil contracts. The company expects to pay total fines of $1.5 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Swissinfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/bloomberg/glencore-pleads-guilty-to-settle-sprawling-graft-probes/47620300>).

<a id="event-2022-05-24-4-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President of Moldova Igor Dodon is arrested on charges including corruption and treason.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2022/05/24/igor-dodon-former-moldovan-president-arrested-on-suspicion-of-corruption>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-05-24-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Premier League approves the sale of Chelsea F.C. to a U.S. consortium led by Los Angeles Dodgers co-owner Todd Boehly. Chelsea owner Roman Abramovich decided to sell the club after he was sanctioned over his connections to the Russian government.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive / Donbas offensive.

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine offensive.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrinform](<https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3491607-one-killed-three-injured-in-russian-missile-strike-on-zaporizhzhia.html>).

**Archived source account.** Rebel forces say a Ukrainian shelling attack in Donetsk has killed five civilians (including a teenager) and left 13 injured.

<a id="event-2022-05-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Donbas.

**Archived source account.** A French journalist is killed by Russian shelling in Luhansk Oblast, according to the region's governor Serhiy Haidai.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/french-journalist-killed-shelling-ukraines-luhansk-region-governor-2022-05-30/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb is detonated in Russian-occupied Melitopol, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, injuring at least three people. Russian authorities blame pro-Ukrainian residents for the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bomb-hits-russian-occupied-ukraine-city-melitopol-russian-ukraine-officials-2022-05-30/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-0-9"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency; 2021–2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed in a suspected Islamist attack by the Allied Democratic Forces in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-islamist-militants-kill-15-east-congo-village-2022-05-30/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-0-11"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Nigerian police say that unknown militants have kidnapped a prelate in Abia State.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-west-africa-religion-kidnapping-665cf8afc75556c07b4f7d305dbaeb5e>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-0-13"></a>

Context: Nigerian bandit conflict.

**Archived source account.** Bandits kill up to 30 vigilantes in Zamfara State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/bandits-shoot-tens-vigilantes-nigerias-northwestern-zamfara-state-2022-05-31/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-05-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Russian occupation of Kherson, 2022 food crises.

**Archived source account.** Russia begins exporting grain from the occupied Kherson Oblast in Southern Ukraine to Russia. Russian-occupying administration official Kirill Stremousov says that the administration was also "working on the supplies of sunflower seeds to local and Russian processing plants". Ukraine accuses Russia of stealing its grain.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/pro-moscow-kherson-region-starts-grain-exports-russia-tass-2022-05-30/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-1-3"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** After weeks of deliberations, all of the European Union member states agree to impose an oil embargo on most oil imports from Russia (with the exception of that brought by pipelines), to be fully implemented by the end of the year, and cut off Sberbank from SWIFT.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/05/30/1102083611/eu-agree-partial-russian-oil-embargo?t=1653996760170>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A report by the Blue Marine Foundation found that fishing vessels from the European Union were illegally harvesting fish in the exclusive economic zones off the coasts of India, Somalia and Mozambique even as the stocks of yellowfin tuna were on the verge of collapse.

Source citations (as archived): [OCCRP](<https://www.occrp.org/en/daily/16391-report-eu-vessels-linked-to-illegal-fishing-in-the-indian-ocean>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-05-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Agatha.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed in Tapachula, Chiapas, as Hurricane Agatha approaches Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Diario Presente](<https://www.diariopresente.mx/mexico/agatha-cobra-su-primera-victima-en-chiapas-turista-no-respeto-las-advertencias/334129>).
