**Archived source account.** Five people are injured after a school bus crashes into a ditch and rolls over in Roztoka, Tarnów County, Poland.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/poland-46564d4903b6e4aeae5dc564a8738787>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The wreckage of the Cessna 182 that disappeared from radar the previous day is found near Broćanac, Croatia. All four people on board were killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/small-plane-crashes-in-croatia-killing-all-4-on-board/2022/05/30/dfbe9326-e006-11ec-ae64-6b23e5155b62_story.html>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 20 others are injured after a car crashes into a crowd in Lincoln, Nebraska, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nebraska-lincoln-323f0c0dc21a3b4680573ec9693fa529>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-05-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 monkeypox outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Thailand reports its first case of monkeypox.

Source citations (as archived): [ThaiPBS](<https://www.thaipbsworld.com/thailand-reports-first-case-of-monkeypox-in-transit-passenger-to-australia/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-05-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Status of Jerusalem, Foreign relations of Israel, Foreign relations of Suriname.

**Archived source account.** Surinamese Foreign Minister Albert Ramdin says that Suriname will open an embassy in Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/suriname-to-open-an-embassy-in-jerusalem-in-the-near-future/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Transnistria.

**Archived source account.** Aleksandr Rozenberg is sworn as new Prime Minister of Transnistria.

Source citations (as archived): [novostipmr.com](<https://novostipmr.com/en/news/22-05-30/president-held-working-meeting-leadership-state-authorities-and>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-5-4"></a>

Context: 2022 Australian federal election / 2022 Liberal Party of Australia leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Former Minister for Defence Peter Dutton is elected unopposed as Leader of the Liberal Party of Australia and, by extension, Leader of the Opposition following former Prime Minister Scott Morrison's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/may/30/peter-dutton-elected-unopposed-as-liberal-party-leader-with-sussan-ley-as-deputy>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-5-6"></a>

Context: 2022 Australian federal election / 2022 National Party of Australia leadership spill.

**Archived source account.** Former Deputy Prime Minister Barnaby Joyce is removed as Leader of the National Party of Australia in a leadership spill and replaced by his former Deputy and former Minister for Agriculture and Northern Australia David Littleproud.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/may/30/david-littleproud-elected-new-nationals-leader-with-perin-davey-as-deputy>).

<a id="event-2022-05-30-5-7"></a>

Context: 2022 Australian federal election.

**Archived source account.** As vote counting continues, the Australian Labor Party achieves a majority in the House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/may/30/labor-secures-majority-government-despite-record-non-major-party-vote-and-crossbench>).

### 2022-05-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1337419075](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20May%2031&oldid=1337419075>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-05-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive / Battle of Sievierodonetsk.

**Archived source account.** An airstrike hits a tank filled with nitric acid in Sievierodonetsk, Luhansk Oblast, prompting the region's governor to ask residents to remain inside bomb shelters due to the risk of exposure to toxic fumes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-airstrike-hits-acid-tank-ukraines-sievierodonetsk-governor-says-2022-05-31/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive / Battle of Sievierodonetsk.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine says that Russian forces have taken control of most of Sievierodonetsk after launching a full-scale assault on the city. Luhansk governor Serhiy Haidai says that 60% of structures in the city have been destroyed in the fighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-forces-face-stiff-resistance-ukraines-donbas-2022-05-31/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive.

**Archived source account.** A Russian missile hits an apartment in Sloviansk, Donetsk Oblast, killing three people and injuring six others.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-donetsk-moscow-7f1f15b9328ca8a606cfc4ef57ae1c32>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-0-8"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** A bombing kills one person and injures nine others near the Sule Pagoda in Yangon, Myanmar. State media accuses the People's Defence Force of responsibility, which the PDF denies.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/education-myanmar-yangon-bombings-aung-san-suu-kyi-924a199c207a78d620b9fb7fa1ec1421>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-0-9"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are injured after military forces shell a monastery in Natmyaung, Sagaing Region.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Asia](<https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/monastery-shelling-06012022082312.html>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-0-11"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations says that the Eritrean Defence Forces shelled the Ethiopian border town of Sheraro over the weekend, killing a 14-year-old girl and injuring 18 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/eritrean-troops-shell-town-north-ethiopia-un-2022-05-31/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-05-31-1-1"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom and the European Union agree to implement a ban on insuring Russian oil tankers, which will be phased in beginning in 6 months. This will effectively render the vast majority of oil tankers uninsurable as most institutions conducting insurance are located in Western Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/10372dd3-be3c-42b9-982b-241a38efcc88>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six African countries, on Zimbabwe's initiative, agree to restart trade in ivory as the population of elephants soars beyond sustainable levels.

Source citations (as archived): [OCCRP](<https://www.occrp.org/en/daily/16393-six-african-nations-agreed-to-push-for-restarting-ivory-trade>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-05-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An AIDC AT-3 crashes in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, killing the pilot. In response, the Taiwanese Air Force suspends training operations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taiwan-air-force-suffers-second-fatal-accident-2022-2022-05-31/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-05-31-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 monkeypox outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Hungary and Norway report their first cases of monkeypox.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/hungary-reports-first-case-monkeypox-2022-05-31/>); [Reuters 2](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/norway-reports-its-first-case-monkeypox-2022-05-31/>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-3-3"></a>

Context: Regulation of electronic cigarettes.

**Archived source account.** Mexico bans the sale of electronic cigarettes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/mexico-totally-bans-sales-of-e-cigarettes/2022/05/31/87096864-e114-11ec-ae64-6b23e5155b62_story.html>).

<a id="event-2022-05-31-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A major cyberattack hits the Costa Rican Social Security Fund, forcing the ministry to shut down its digital database and endangering the country's healthcare system.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/latest-cyberattack-costa-rica-targets-hospital-system-2022-05-31/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-05-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Workers of the Polish Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) announce that they will go on a general strike beginning on June 27 amid disciplinary dismissal of the leader of the trade union representing ZUS and general poor conditions of employment.

Source citations (as archived): [Rzeczpospolita](<https://www.rp.pl/urzednicy/art36412181-strajk-generalny-w-zus-wyplaty-swiadczen-zagrozone>).

**Archived source account.** The Tau Herculids meteor shower, caused by debris from the 1995 breakup of comet 73P/Schwassmann–Wachmann, peaks.

Source citations (as archived): [Space](<https://www.space.com/tau-herculids-meteor-shower-2022-stargazers-photos>).


## June

### 2022-06-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1179318168](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20June%201&oldid=1179318168>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine offensive.

**Archived source account.** Three civilians are killed after Russian forces shell the Sviatohirsk Lavra monastery.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrayinska Pravda](<https://news.yahoo.com/russian-troops-kill-7-civilians-185159435.html>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Germany says that it will send the IRIS-T air defence missile system to Ukraine following a request from Ukraine for heavy weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/germany-send-iris-t-air-defence-system-ukraine-scholz-2022-06-01/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden agrees to provide Ukraine with long-range rocket artillery systems after Ukraine reportedly gave "assurances" that they will not use the missile systems to strike Russian cities. The weapons systems are a part of a new $700 million weapons package to Ukraine that will also include ammunition, counter-fire radars, a number of air surveillance radars, and additional Javelin anti-tank missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/biden-closing-new-weapons-package-ukraine-2022-05-31/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Russia says the U.S. decision to supply advanced long-range rocket systems and munitions to Ukraine could "widen the conflict", and also risks "direct confrontation" with Russia, accusing the United States of "purposefully and diligently adding fuel to the fire".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-scolds-us-over-advanced-arms-shipments-ukraine-2022-06-01/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Turkish intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Turkey announces a planned military operation to seize control of the Syrian cities of Tal Rifaat and Manbij from the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/1/turkey-expands-military-operation-in-northern-syria>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and several others are injured by a rocket attack in Tell Abyad, Raqqa Governorate, Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/politics-middle-east-syria-b979f9ce0d473b9aa92c9933af1f609b>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-14"></a>

Context: Kashmir conflict / Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Local authorities say that yesterday's attack in Kulgam has caused over 100 Kashmiri Hindu families to flee Kashmir.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/hindu-families-flee-kashmir-after-targeted-killings-2022-06-01/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-16"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian man is killed and two others are injured after the IDF raided the town of Ya'bad to demolish the house of the perpetrator of the Bnei Brak shootings, following a confrontation by residents. A woman holding a knife is also shot and killed near the Al-Arroub refugee camp in the occupied West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-troops-shoot-knife-wielding-palestinian-woman-west-bank-army-says-2022-06-01/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-18"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Two Red Cross workers are killed in an attack by unknown militants in Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/two-red-cross-workers-killed-attack-western-mali-2022-06-02/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-0-19"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** A Jordanian member of the MINUSMA peacekeeping force is killed and three others are injured in Kidal Region, Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20220601-un-peacekeeper-killed-in-terrorist-attack-in-northern-mali>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-06-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Comair, a South African franchisee for British Airways, suspends all flights after the company announced that it has run out of funds. Budget airline Kulula.com, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Comair, has also suspended all flights.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/1/south-african-carrier-grounds-flight-after-running-out-of-funds>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-06-01-2-2"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2022 / 2022 Ya'an earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 41 others injured by a 5.9 magnitude earthquake in Sichuan, China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/earthquake-shakes-chinas-sichuan-province-damages-houses/2022/06/01/54d59742-e19f-11ec-ae64-6b23e5155b62_story.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-06-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Denmark and the European Union, 2022 Danish European Union opt-out referendum.

**Archived source account.** Exit polls show that around two-thirds of Danes voted to have Denmark join the European Union's Common Security and Defence Policy, ending Denmark's 30-year policy of opting out.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/1/exit-polls-danish-voters-want-back-joining-eus-defence-policy>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-3-3"></a>

Context: Greece–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan cancels high-level talks with Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis, accusing Mitsotakis of consistently using Greek jets to violate Turkey's airspace. Turkish Foreign Affairs Minister Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu had also accused Greece of violating the airspace of demilitarized zones in the Aegean Sea yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/1/dont-try-to-dance-with-turkey-erdogan-halts-talks-with-greece>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-3-5"></a>

Context: Russia–Taiwan relations, International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Taiwan imposes an export ban of all modern computer chips to Russia and Belarus, as well as any technology and equipment used to manufacture them.

Source citations (as archived): [Taiwan News](<https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4557937>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-06-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Warren Clinic shooting.

**Archived source account.** At least five people, including the perpetrator, are killed in a mass shooting at a clinic in Tulsa, Oklahoma, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/06/01/us/tulsa-police-incident-active-shooter/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Depp v. Heard.

**Archived source account.** Actor Johnny Depp wins a defamation lawsuit against his ex-wife, actress Amber Heard.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-us-canada-61633236>).

<a id="event-2022-06-01-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Canada announces that it will temporarily decriminalize possession of less than 2.5 grams total of MDMA, opioids, cocaine, and methamphetamine in the province of British Columbia, in order to allow for the province to launch a three-year trial of drug decriminalization and treatments.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-61657095>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-06-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Next Generation EU.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission formally approves, by a majority vote, Poland's plan for the usage of the EU's Recovery and Resilience Facility funds. Although the money will not be immediately available for use, the plan must go through approval in the European Council, and any future funding requests in that mechanism will also be subject to the approval of other member states. The acceptance was previously withheld due to the Commission's concerns about the rule of law in the country, and in particular Poland's non-compliance with the ruling of the European Court of Justice that ordered the Disciplinary Chamber of the Supreme Court disbanded.

Source citations (as archived): [Rzeczpospolita](<https://www.rp.pl/polityka/art36433231-komisarze-podzieleni-w-sprawie-kpo>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-vows-deal-to-unlock-poland-pandemic-cash-hinges-recovery-fund-covid-19-on-reforms/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-06-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists from the University of Western Australia announce that a seagrass meadow of the species Posidonia australis covering 200 sqkm, approximately three times the size of Manhattan, found off of Western Australia's Shark Bay, actually belongs to one plant, making it the largest known plant on Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-61655327>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-06-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 9th Summit of the Americas.

**Archived source account.** The Biden administration bans the presidents of Cuba, Venezuela, and Nicaragua from attending this year's Summit of the Americas in Los Angeles, United States. Mexican President Andrés Manuel López Obrador announces that he will personally boycott the meeting in response to the ban, sending Foreign Secretary Marcelo Ebrard to represent him at the summit.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-excludes-cuba-venezuela-nicaragua-americas-summit-sources-2022-06-06/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-06-06-3-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2021 United States Capitol attack / Criminal charges in the 2021 United States Capitol attack.

**Archived source account.** Five members of the far-right group Proud Boys, including leader Enrique Tarrio, are charged with seditious conspiracy for their involvement in the January 6 attack at the United States Capitol, becoming the second group to be charged with seditious conspiracy in connection to the attack.

<a id="event-2022-06-06-3-4"></a>

Context: Mass media in Latvia, Latvia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Latvia bans all Russia-based TV media outlets that threaten "the territorial integrity and independence of another country", referring to the Russo-Ukrainian War. The measure will last until Russia de-occupies Crimea and ends its warfare against Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [LRT](<https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/1712832/latvia-bans-all-russia-based-tv-channels>).

<a id="event-2022-06-06-3-6"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

<a id="event-2022-06-06-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Orlando Jorge Mera, the Environmental Minister for the Dominican Republic and son of former President Salvador Jorge Blanco, is shot dead in his office. The perpetrator was identified by a presidential spokesman as Miguel Cruz, a childhood friend of the minister. He was later taken into custody.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/dominican-environment-minister-shot-dead-his-office-2022-06-06/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-61712872>).

<a id="event-2022-06-06-3-9"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/aydin-coban-trial-begins-1.6477680>).

<a id="event-2022-06-06-4-2"></a>

Context: Partygate.

**Archived source account.** Boris Johnson survives the confidence vote by a margin of 211–148 and the party will not conduct a leadership election with 58.8% of Conservative MPs voting in favour of Johnson.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times](<https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/politics-live-boris-johnson-set-to-face-confidence-vote-nkkvrj2ww>).

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220606-mali-junta-sets-two-year-delay-until-civilian-rule>).

<a id="event-2022-06-08-2-1"></a>

Original source account: So called Whisky War, a pseudo confrontation between Canada and Denmark ends with the Hans Island divided.

**Archived source account.** Spain removes all COVID-19 entry requirements for anyone arriving into the country from the European Union or the Schengen Area. However, travellers from outside the EU will still need to be fully vaccinated or provide proof of a negative PCR test within 72 hours before departure in order to enter Spain.

<a id="event-2022-06-21-1-2"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge / 2022 United Kingdom national rail strike.

**Archived source account.** Railway transport workers go on a nationwide general strike in the United Kingdom after talks on a 7% pay increase for workers collapses. The RMT says that industry executives have only offered a 2% increase in pay, which is well below rising inflation levels.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-61861040>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-1-4"></a>

Context: Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia becomes China's biggest supplier of oil, surpassing Saudi Arabia and making up over half of China's oil imports.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/6/20/china-oil-imports-from-sanctioned-russia-skyrocket-surpass-saudi>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-06-21-2-2"></a>

Context: Wildfires in 2022 / 2022 California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** The Edgewood Fire breaks out near San Mateo County, California, prompting evacuations and power outages. A firefighter is injured while fighting the fires.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/video/raw-chopper-5-video-of-the-edgewood-fire-burning-in-san-mateo-county/>); [KNTV](<https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/peninsula/crews-respond-to-fire-in-emerald-hills-area-in-san-mateo-county/2925224/?amp>); [KGO-TV](<https://abc7news.com/amp/redwood-city-fire-edgewood-park-san-mateo-county-emerald-hills/11985220/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-06-21-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Macau.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Macau place a casino and hotel with more than 700 people inside under lockdown due to an outbreak of COVID-19 in the territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/macau-hotel-locked-down-after-covid-19-case-700-people-to-be-quarantined-media>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-06-21-4-2"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War / Lithuania–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian Security Council Secretary Nikolai Patrushev warns Lithuania that its citizens will "feel pain" over the ban on the transit of Russian goods to Kaliningrad through Lithuania, saying that Russia's response in the near future could have "a serious negative impact on the population of Lithuania".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/amid-row-with-west-putin-ally-arrives-russias-kaliningrad-ria-2022-06-21/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-4-4"></a>

Context: Estonia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Estonia reports that a Russian Border Service Mi-8 helicopter violated its airspace over the weekend. The Russian ambassador to Estonia was summoned in response to the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/06/21/Russian-border-guard-helicopter-violates-Estonia-s-airspace>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-4-6"></a>

Context: Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on international relations.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations announces that the conference of the parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity initially scheduled to take place in Kunming, China, later this year will be moved to Montreal, Canada, due to logistical complications caused by China's Zero-COVID policy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/chinas-covid-19-controls-force-u-n-biodiversity-conference-to-move-to-canada-11655810917>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-4-8"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 global energy crisis.

**Archived source account.** Lebanon, Egypt and Syria sign an agreement to supply Egyptian gas to a power plant in northern Lebanon through Syria. However, the World Bank, which is financing the deal, must validate the agreement before it can take effect.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/lebanon-ap-syria-egypt-world-bank-b2105896.html>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-4-10"></a>

Context: Cross-Strait relations.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-nine Chinese military aircraft enter the Taiwanese air defence zone, prompting the Taiwanese Air Force to send their own aircraft in response.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taiwan-scrambles-29-jets-warn-away-chinese-planes-its-air-defence-zone-2022-06-21/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-06-21-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are injured, including one in critical condition, after a stabbing attack in Västerås, Sweden.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/stockholm-sweden-cb189498630d06ffd7ce9f6ae4f08265>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rioters attack an International Day of Yoga celebration in Malé, the Maldives, proclaiming that yoga is against the tenets of Islam.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/protesters-attack-yoga-day-event-maldives-2022-06-21/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The South Dakota Senate, in the United States, votes to convict Attorney General Jason Ravnsborg over his role in a 2020 car accident in which his car struck 55-year old Joseph Boever, removing him from office immediately.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/jason-ravnsborg-south-dakota-impeachments-e5d62c76eedecf4c9290fecd821496aa>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-06-21-6-1"></a>

Context: 2022 food crises.

**Archived source account.** Egypt rejects two World Trade Organization (WTO) agreements which would have forced it to export domestically needed food to alleviate the global food crisis, citing proposals that it considers harmful to developing countries and also noting that 30 other WTO member states restrict food exports.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Monitor](<https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2022/06/egypt-rejects-world-trade-organization-agreements-global-food-crisis>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The armed forces of Ecuador say that they will "not allow ongoing protests" to "damage the country's democracy", as road blockades and demonstrations against the economic policies of president Guillermo Lasso continue.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuadors-military-vows-stop-protests-damaging-democracy-2022-06-21/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-06-21-7-1"></a>

Context: Internet censorship in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russia blocks access to The Daily Telegraph's website on the orders of the Prosecutor-General, after accusing the newspaper of "disseminating false information" about the Russian war in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/russia-blocks-the-telegraph-s-website-for-war-coverage/ar-AAYH13f?ocid=msedgdhp&amp;pc=U531&amp;cvid=cf6fbd4012d84bac8414a0d91d31ab6c>).

<a id="event-2022-06-21-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nuri, South Korea's first locally-developed orbital launch vehicle, launches for a second time from the Naro Space Center in Goheung County, South Jeolla, with a satellite payload of 1500 kg. The launch was successful, with all of the satellites being put onto the 700 km Sun-synchronous orbit.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1614085/south-korea-launches-domestically-developed-space-rocket>).

### 2022-06-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-06-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 Western Russia attacks.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian Air Force launches drone strikes on an oil refinery in Novoshakhtinsk, Rostov Oblast, Russia, causing a large explosion and fire. Operations at the refinery have been suspended. Footage on social media appears to show at least one armed drone striking the facility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-broke-out-russias-novoshakhtinsk-oil-refinery-2022-06-22/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Reporters Without Borders releases a report claiming that a Ukrainian photojournalist was summarily executed while injured on the ground by Russian soldiers during the early stages of the conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/22/ukrainian-journalist-maks-levin-executed-russian-forces-report>).

<a id="event-2022-06-22-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine offensive.

**Archived source account.** Seven Russian missiles strike the city of Mykolaiv, killing at least one person and damaging a number of residential and commercial buildings, according to Mykolaiv governor Vitaliy Kim.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2022/06/22/russia-ukraine-war-news-latest-updates-putin-missile-lithuania/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-22-0-8"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian military says that it has inflicted "significant losses" on Russian forces after launching airstrikes on Snake Island in the Black Sea, destroying a Pantsir missile system, a radar station and numerous vehicles on the occupied island.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2022/06/22/ukraine-claims-significant-snake-island-victory-over-russian-forces>).

<a id="event-2022-06-22-0-11"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Five Southern Transitional Council soldiers and three Al-Qaeda militants are killed during a shootout in Ataq, Shabwah Governorate.

<a id="event-2022-06-22-0-13"></a>

Context: 2022 Ecuadorian protests.

**Archived source account.** Ecuadorian indigenous groups attack a police station in Puyo, Pastaza, amid ongoing protests in the country. One protestor is shot dead by police. Eighteen police officers are missing, while another six are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2332333/ecuador-police-officers-missing-after-protest-attack>).

<a id="event-2022-06-22-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen says that Denmark will begin administering fourth doses of the COVID-19 vaccine for people over the age of 50 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/denmark-offer-fourth-covid-vaccine-dose-people-over-50-years-2022-06-22/>).

<a id="event-2022-06-22-3-3"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-06-23-5-1"></a>

Context: Gun politics in the United States.

**Archived source account.** In a 65–33 vote, the U.S. Senate passes gun control legislation for the first time in decades. The bill calls for tougher background checks on gun purchasers younger than 21, blocks gun sales to individuals with a history of domestic abuse against unmarried partners, and provides funding to encourage the adoption of a red flag law, among others. It is sent to the U.S. House of Representatives for a vote.

Sturgeon will try to bypass Prime Minister Boris Johnson's unlikely permission to conduct the referendum by referring the bill to the Supreme Court of the United Kingdom.

Context: Phase-out of fossil fuel vehicles.

**Archived source account.** The European Council broadly agrees on several measures to combat climate change. Among them is a ban on combustion engines for new cars beginning in 2035, setting aside €59 billion for a special fund to reduce the cost of transition for the poorest populations, to be paid out from 2027 to 2032, reduction of carbon dioxide emissions by 55% from the 1990 reference level, and a carbon market reform. Negotiations on the final version of these reforms is underway.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/29/eu-countries-approve-climate-laws-2035-fossil-fuel-car-ban>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-07-06-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 United Kingdom government crisis.

**Archived source account.** Multiple senior ministers of the United Kingdom's Cabinet, including newly appointed Chancellor of the Exchequer Nadhim Zahawi, Home Secretary Priti Patel, Secretary of State for Transport Grant Shapps, and Secretary of State for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities Michael Gove tell Prime Minister Boris Johnson to resign. Five additional ministers resign after dozens of others leave throughout the day, bringing the total of government departures to 38.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/jul/06/michael-gove-boris-johnson-more-ministers-resign>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/boris-johnson-cabinet-resignation-b2117239.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-politics-62048657>).

<a id="event-2022-07-06-5-2"></a>

Context: 2022 United Kingdom government crisis.

**Archived source account.** Boris Johnson fires Michael Gove after Gove called on Johnson to resign earlier in the day. A 10 Downing Street official says that "you can’t have a snake who is not with you on any of the big arguments who then gleefully tells the press the leader has to go".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/boris-johnson-sacks-michael-gove-b2117505.html>).

<a id="event-2022-07-06-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kiribati announces its withdrawal from the Pacific Islands Forum, effective immediately, after President Taneti Maamau publishes a letter where he expresses four reasons for doing so, mainly due to the Secretary-General of the Forum never having been from the Micronesian region of the Pacific islands.

Source citations (as archived): [1news](<https://www.1news.co.nz/2022/07/10/exclusive-pacific-islands-forum-crisis-as-kiribati-withdraws/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-07-10-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Soweto shooting; 2022 Pietermaritzburg shooting.

**Archived source account.** In South Africa, 15 people are killed in a mass shooting at a bar in Soweto, Gauteng. Four more are killed at a tavern in Pietermaritzburg, KwaZulu-Natal. Many others are wounded in both attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62111893>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-07-10-6-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Japanese House of Councillors election.

**Archived source account.** Japanese citizens go to the polls to elect members of the upper house of the National Diet.

Source citations (as archived): [Nikkei](<https://asia.nikkei.com/Politics/Japan-election/Japan-election-voting-begins-in-shadow-of-Abe-assassination>).

<a id="event-2022-07-10-6-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Japanese House of Councillors election.

**Archived source account.** An exit poll by NHK projects that the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP)-led coalition will retain its majority in the upper house, winning 76 of the chamber's 125 contested seats. The LDP is the party of former prime minister Shinzo Abe, who was assassinated two days prior while campaigning for the party's candidate for Nara, Kei Satō.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/10/japan-ruling-coalition-set-to-win-election-marred-by-abe-killing>).

<a id="event-2022-07-10-6-4"></a>

Context: 2022 Israeli legislative election.

**Archived source account.** Israeli politicians Benny Gantz and Gideon Saar form a political alliance to compete against Yair Lapid and Benjamin Netanyahu.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2022-07-10/ty-article/.premium/gantz-saar-on-verge-of-joining-forces-in-upcoming-israeli-election/00000181-e7db-dc8d-a7c9-f7db0f8b0000>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-07-10-7-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Wimbledon Championships.

**Archived source account.** Novak Djokovic of Serbia wins his seventh Wimbledon and overall 21st Grand Slam title after defeating Nick Kyrgios of Australia in the men's singles final, 4–6, 6–3, 6–4, 7–6 (7–3).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/62109725>).

Source citations (as archived): [SwissInfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/russian-bombardment-kills-3-in-ukraine-s-second-city-kharkiv/47742224>).

<a id="event-2022-07-11-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian occupation of Kharkiv Oblast.

**Archived source account.** The Russian-appointed military-civilian administration leader of Velykyi Burluk in Kharkiv Oblast, Yevgeny Yunakov, is assassinated in a car bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/leader-russian-occupied-ukrainian-town-killed-by-car-bomb-tass-2022-07-11/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-11-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 Ukrainian summer counteroffensive.

<a id="event-2022-07-11-0-8"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Colombian Army launches an airstrike on a FARC dissidents' camp in the Caquetá Department, killing ten people. Iván Mordisco, one of the group's leaders, was at the scene during the strike; his fate is unknown.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2022-07-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New South Wales premier Dominic Perrottet announces that the Australian Aboriginal Flag will be flown permanently above the Sydney Harbour Bridge, which is widely regarded as an iconic Australian landmark. The flag will be flown on top of the bridge's arches alongside the national flag, replacing the flag of New South Wales, after the state government decided against accommodating all three flags.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/style/article/aboriginal-flag-sydney-harbour-bridge-australia/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-07-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Russian court lifts the suspension for the CPC pipeline and instead fines its operators 200,000 rubles ($3,300) for oil spills. The oil pipeline, one of the world's largest, is the route for nearly all of Kazakhstan's oil exports, which represents about 1% of global oil supply.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/oil-majors-face-output-slump-deep-losses-if-russia-stops-kazakh-pipeline-2022-07-11/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-11-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nord Stream 1 natural gas pipeline from Russia to Germany is suspended for the first of ten days of scheduled annual maintenance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/europe-edge-nord-stream-russian-gas-link-set-planned-shut-down-2022-07-10/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-07-11-3-1"></a>

Context: July 2022 European heat wave.

**Archived source account.** French authorities issue a warning as temperatures reach as high as \{\{convert\|40\|°C\|°F\}\} amid ongoing wildfires.

<a id="event-2022-07-11-4-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in the United States / COVID-19 vaccination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Macau closes all of its casinos in order to contain an outbreak of COVID-19 in the city.

Context: Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Lithuania–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Lithuania expands sanctions on the Russian exclave of Kaliningrad to include cement, concrete, wood, alcohol and alcohol-based industrial chemicals.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/lithuania-expands-restrictions-kaliningrad-trade-2022-07-11/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/7/11/pacific-islands-summit-begins-amid-us-china-battle-for-influence>).

<a id="event-2022-07-11-6-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Lawmakers in Russia propose to extend the anti-"gay propaganda" bill to all people regardless of their age.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-07-11-7-1"></a>

Context: 2022 vote of no confidence in the government of Élisabeth Borne.

**Archived source account.** The French government survives a no confidence vote tabled by the left-wing NUPES coalition. The no confidence vote received only 146 yes votes out of the 289 needed.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<https://www.lemonde.fr/politique/live/2022/07/11/l-assemblee-nationale-en-direct-la-motion-de-censure-de-la-nupes-rejetee-le-gouvernement-se-dit-au-travail_6134252_823448.html>).

<a id="event-2022-07-11-7-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-decree-gives-all-ukrainians-path-russian-citizenship-2022-07-11/>).

### 2022-07-12

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-07-12-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 Ukrainian summer counteroffensive / Nova Kakhovka airstrike.

**Archived source account.** A massive explosion occurs in the city of Nova Kakhovka after Ukrainian forces destroy a Russian arms depot. Russian state news agency TASS claims that a market, hospital, and civilian housing were also damaged, and that multiple civilians were killed. Russian 22nd Army Corps general Artem Nasbulin is allegedly among the dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrayinska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/news/2022/07/11/7357612/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-prepares-fresh-russian-assault-west-braces-worsening-energy-crisis-2022-07-12/>); [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2022/07/12/ukraine-russia-war-kherson-attack-general-killed/8551657623145/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-12-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan claims that Iran will provide Russia with hundreds of drones along with the necessary training for their use.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2022/07/11/iran-drones-russia-ukraine/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-12-0-8"></a>

<a id="event-2022-07-12-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States confirms that it has killed the leader of the Islamic State's Syrian branch, Maher al-Agal, in a drone strike in northwestern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/isis-leader-syria-killed-us-strike-us-officials-say-2022-07-12/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-12-0-12"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed when suspected Islamists attack the city of Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-islamists-kill-seven-east-congo-city-beni-2022-07-13/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-07-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Enlargement of the eurozone.

**Archived source account.** The European Union formally accepts Croatia as the 20th member of the Eurozone. Croatia will adopt the bloc's currency on January 1, 2023.

<a id="event-2022-07-12-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ukraine says that despite the Russian blockade of many of its Black Sea ports, in the last four days, 16 ships carrying grain have passed through the Bystre rivermouth, an important mouth of the Danube river.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-ministry-ships-passing-through-danube-bystre-rivermouth-2022-07-12/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

Context: 2022 monkeypox outbreak / 2022 monkeypox outbreak in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Russia reports its first case of monkeypox in a man who travelled from Europe.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-07-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Telford child sexual exploitation scandal.

**Archived source account.** A three-year-long independent inquiry into child sexual exploitation finds that over 1,000 children in Telford, Shropshire, England, were sexually exploited beginning in the 1980s. Teachers and youth workers were discouraged from reporting child sexual abuse and police were nervous that investigating the abusers would inflame racial tensions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/over-1000-children-english-town-were-sexually-exploited-inquiry-finds-2022-07-12/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/society/2022/jul/12/over-1000-children-telford-sexually-exploited-inquiry-finds>).

<a id="event-2022-07-12-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protesters in Panama continue blocking streets and railways, mainly in Chiriquí and Veraguas Provinces, rejecting the concession by president Laurentino Cortizo of freezing fuel prices.

Source citations (as archived): [TeleMetro](<https://www.telemetro.com/nacionales/continuan-los-cierres-vias-diferentes-puntos-chiriqui-y-veraguas-n5737938>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-07-12-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Sri Lankan political crisis.

**Archived source account.** President Gotabaya Rajapaksa and his wife are prevented from fleeing the country to Dubai by airport staff at Bandaranaike International Airport amid nationwide protests. G. Rajapaksa has not given his official resignation yet.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/07/12/asia/sri-lanka-crisis-gotabaya-rajapaksa-airport-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-07-12-5-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Sri Lankan political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Rajapaksa subsequently flees the country on a military aircraft to the Maldives, formally ending his rule of Sri Lanka. His brother, former finance minister Basil Rajapaksa, also flees the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-62132271>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Donbas.

**Archived source account.** Heavy Russian shelling is reported in Bakhmut, Donetsk Oblast, with at least one person killed and five others injured in the largely evacuated town.

<a id="event-2022-07-13-1-1"></a>

<a id="event-2022-07-13-1-2"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/euro-clings-parity-traders-wait-us-inflation-2022-07-13/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-13-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2022-07-13-3-2"></a>

Context: 2022 monkeypox outbreak / 2022 monkeypox outbreak in Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Dnevni Avaz](<https://avaz.ba/vijesti/bih/757590/potvrdena-zaraza-majmunskim-boginjama-u-bih>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/13/number-of-uk-covid-deaths-passes-200000-ons-data>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-07-13-4-2"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War / Lithuania–Russia relations, Russia–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission allows Russia to resume shipping embargoed goods by rail to its exclave of Kaliningrad, following Russian threats against Lithuania. However, the transit of military equipment through Lithuanian territory remains prohibited.

Context: International recognition of the Donetsk People's Republic and the Luhansk People's Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/north-korea-recognises-breakaway-russias-proxies-east-ukraine-2022-07-13/>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/ukraine-breaks-diplomacy-north-korea-donetsk-luhansk-regions-russia-war-2022-7>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-07-13-5-2"></a>

Context: Global surveillance disclosures / Vault 7.

**Archived source account.** A jury in New York convicts ex-Central Intelligence Agency engineer Joshua Schulte on all nine charges relating to the Vault 7 leak detailing the activities and capabilities of the CIA to perform electronic surveillance and cyber warfare. The leak is the largest leak in Central Intelligence Agency history.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2022/7/13/23208635/cia-wikileaks-vault-7-joshua-schulte-conviction>).

<a id="event-2022-07-13-5-4"></a>

Context: 2022 Sri Lankan protests.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe confirms that former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa has fled the country to the Maldives and declares a state of emergency and a curfew as the military fires tear gas at the protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/13/sri-lanka-crisis-live-news-updates>); [ANINews](<https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/sri-lanka-pm-declares-emergency-as-president-rajapaksa-flees-to-maldives20220713122645/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-13-5-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Sri Lankan protests.

**Archived source account.** Protesters storm the Prime Minister's office in Colombo, demanding Wickremesinghe's immediate resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/sri-lankans-storm-prime-ministers-office-demanding-he-quit-well-2022-07-13/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-13-5-7"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Sudan.

**Archived source account.** A 20-year-old woman who is a campaigner for women's rights in Sudan appeals to the High Court to overturn her death sentence by stoning for adultery, the first time that such an appeal has been filed in nearly a decade.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2022/jul/13/sudan-woman-faces-death-by-stoning-for-adultery-in-first-case-for-a-decade>).

Context: 2022 United Kingdom government crisis / 2022 Conservative Party leadership election.

<a id="event-2022-07-14-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 Vinnytsia attacks / July 2022 Vinnytsia missile strike.

**Archived source account.** At least 23 civilians are killed and more than 100 others are injured by three Russian missile strikes in Vinnytsia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62163071>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-0-6"></a>

Context: Spillover of the insurgency in the Sahel.

**Archived source account.** At least 12 civilians are killed by Islamic extremist gunmen during an attack against two villages in northern Togo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-12-killed-raids-northern-togo-villages-2022-07-15/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-0-8"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Three civilians and three security forces are killed in an attack by militants at a checkpoint near Bamako, Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/six-killed-rare-attack-near-malian-capital-2022-07-16>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-07-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Social media site Twitter experiences a global outage lasting for 45 minutes, making it the site's longest outage since 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2022/jul/14/twitter-experiences-longest-global-outage-in-years>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia enacts a law that requires all companies to comply with the armed forces' orders to provide goods or services and provide overtime or additional work days if necessary. The requirement for a public procurement procedure for this type of request is abolished.

Source citations (as archived): [Rzeczpospolita](<https://www.rp.pl/gospodarka/art36701001-kreml-wprowadza-specustawe-podporzadkowujaca-gospodarke-wojnie>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-07-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over 40 people are missing after a series of floods in Virginia, United States. All are later accounted for.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Express](<https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/1640245/us-weather-state-of-emergency-virginia-floods-ont>); [BBC News](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/07/14/weather/buchanan-county-virginia-floods-thursday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed by a magnitude 5.7 earthquake in Ecuador.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/earthquake-shakes-ecuadors-coast-teen-killed-power-line-86860611>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and two are injured by a mudslide that hit a school in Antioquia, Colombia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mountains-colombia-caribbean-pablo-lopez-medellin-93f590f3b553b7449491c0001e1f99a9>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pinhão, district of Vila Real, sets the highest July temperature ever in Portugal, reaching 47.0 C.

Source citations (as archived): [The Age](<https://www.theage.com.au/world/europe/fires-evacuations-and-health-warnings-as-european-temperatures-hit-47-degrees-20220716-p5b21p.html>); [IPMA](<https://www.ipma.pt/pt/media/noticias/news.detail.jsp?f=/pt/media/noticias/textos/Tempo_muito_quente_julho_2022.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-07-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 30 green sea turtles are found dead off a beach in Kumejima, Japan, with many having been stabbed in the neck. The green sea turtle is an endangered species.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62202902>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-07-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** In South Korea, the Constitutional Court begins deliberations on abolishing the death penalty upon an appeal by the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Korea. South Korea currently has a moratorium on the issue, having not hanged a death row inmate in the past 25 years.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/week-asia/article/3185189/why-south-koreas-catholic-bishops-want-dormant-death-penalty-be-fully>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-4-3"></a>

Context: Media freedom in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin signs a law expanding the definition of "foreign agents" to all organisations deemed by the government to have fallen under "foreign influence", beginning on December 1. The law permits Roskomnadzor to block any websites related to a designated entity without a court order, and restricts these entities from receiving state funds and working with children or at state universities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Moscow Times](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/07/14/putin-signs-expanded-foreign-agents-law-a78298>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 89 people, including 42 civilians, are killed after gang warfare over the control of the Cité Soleil neighbourhood began a week ago between the G9 and G-Pèp gangs in Port-au-Prince, Haiti.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-62162390>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bolivian justice minister Iván Lima announces that the government will seek more charges against former president Jeanine Áñez for her alleged role in massacres perpetrated in Senkata and Sacaba in 2019. Añez is already serving a 10-year sentence on other charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Página/12](<https://www.pagina12.com.ar/437031-bolivia-justicia-ampliara-denuncia-contra-la-expresidenta-je>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ripudaman Singh Malik, one of the men acquitted in the Air India Flight 182 terrorist bombing, is shot to death in Surrey, British Columbia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-62175291>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire inside a nightclub in Tegucigalpa, Honduras, killing four people including Said Lobo, son of former President Porfirio Lobo Sosa.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/honduras-caribbean-biden-cabinet-tegucigalpa-6716a9103cb93c3320b5914a76ab3833>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-07-14-5-2"></a>

Context: 2022 United Kingdom government crisis / 2022 Conservative Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Suella Braverman is eliminated from the leadership race in the second round of voting.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/jul/14/suella-braverman-out-of-tory-leadership-race-after-second-round-of-voting>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-5-4"></a>

Context: 2022 Sri Lankan protests.

**Archived source account.** Gotabaya Rajapaksa resigns as President of Sri Lanka after fleeing to Singapore.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62160227>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-5-6"></a>

Context: 2022 Italian government crisis.

**Archived source account.** Mario Draghi offers his resignation as Prime Minister of Italy after coalition partner Five Star withdraws its support. However, President Sergio Mattarella refuses to accept the resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62171284>).

<a id="event-2022-07-14-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Estonia Kaja Kallas resigns to form a new coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2022/07/14/estonian-pm-resigns-to-form-new-government>).

### 2022-07-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099945418](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20July%2015&oldid=1099945418>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-07-15-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** At least three civilians are killed and 15 others are injured in Russian cruise missile strikes on the city of Dnipro.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-killed-15-injured-missile-strikes-ukraine-city-dnipro-official-says-2022-07-15/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Sahel / Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Three civilians, two gendarmes and one policeman are killed as gunmen attack a checkpoint in Koulikoro, Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/six-people-killed-in-rare-attack-near-malian-capital-bamako>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-0-7"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** Nine Balochistan Liberation Army separatist insurgents are killed during a gunfight with the Pakistan Army in Balochistan, after the group kidnapped and killed a colonel.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-crime-islamabad-1888405d4b941ab5a672a0ea82b4c8b7>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-0-9"></a>

Context: Sudanese nomadic conflicts.

**Archived source account.** 65 people are killed and 150 are wounded in tribal clashes in Blue Nile, Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/17/sudan-blue-nile-state-death-toll-tribal-clashes-soars>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-07-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Transport in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Spain introduces free tickets for suburban and medium-distance services for Renfe, the state-owned railway operator, starting from September 1 and until the end of the year. Other modes of public transport already have a 30% discount.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/money/2022/jul/15/spain-announces-free-rail-journeys-from-september-until-the-end-of-the-year>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-07-15-2-1"></a>

Context: July 2022 European heat wave; 2022 European wildfires.

**Archived source account.** A national emergency is declared in the United Kingdom, with the first ever red alert for extreme heat being issued by the Met Office, ahead of a heat wave which is now expected to break temperature records in the British Isles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-62177458>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-2-2"></a>

Context: July 2022 European heat wave; 2022 European wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Portugal reports 238 deaths related to the ongoing heat wave as it battles more than 30 active wildfires. In France, more than 10,000 people have fled wildfires in Gironde and in Spain, firefighters continue to battle forest fires near the town of Monsagro.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62175758>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-2-4"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Fourteen people are killed and another is injured when a helicopter involved in the search and arrest of drug lord Rafael Caro Quintero crashes in Los Mochis, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/helicopter-crash-after-arrest-of-mexico-drug-lord-kills-many>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed in a multiple vehicle collision in Montana, United States, during a major dust storm.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/hardin-montana-crash-dust-storm-pileup-acd3df7a1edaec8e2fec045c41e6f9e5>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-07-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden meets with Saudi Arabian Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman in Jeddah despite previously vowing to make him a "pariah".

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-07-15/biden-closes-saudi-prince-s-pariah-era-with-a-fist-bump>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** EU adopts 7th package of Russia sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [EU Sanctions](<https://www.europeansanctions.com/2022/07/eu-adopts-7th-package-of-russia-sanctions/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-07-15-4-2"></a>

Context: Judiciary of Poland / Polish Supreme Court Disciplinary Chamber law.

**Archived source account.** The controversial Disciplinary Chamber of the Supreme Court is abolished. However, Didier Reynders, the European Commissioner for Justice, says that the European Court of Justice's ruling ordering the abolishment has not been fully respected and therefore Poland will continue to pay a fine of €1 million per day for contempt of court.

Source citations (as archived): [Rzeczpospolita](<https://www.rp.pl/sady-i-trybunaly/art36707531-ue-vs-pis-w-sprawie-sadownictwa-ke-nie-rezygnuje-z-kar-za-izbe-dyscyplinarna>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-4-4"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Ex-leader of the Guadalajara Cartel Rafael Caro Quintero is captured by the Mexican Navy in Choix, Sinaloa, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/drug-lord-rafael-caro-quintero-captured-mexico-dea-7ff3005d4c848697458d73c669a72e6f>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-62187714>).

<a id="event-2022-07-15-4-6"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany.

**Archived source account.** A 33-year-old former German Army officer is sentenced to five-and-a-half years in prison for plotting a terrorist attack on senior politicians while posing as a Syrian refugee.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/07/15/europe/german-soldier-franco-a-sentenced-intl-grm/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-07-15-5-1"></a>

Context: International Space Station programme.

**Archived source account.** NASA and Roscosmos sign an agreement to integrate future flights to the International Space Station. The agreement will allow Russian cosmonauts to fly on U.S. spacecraft in return for allowing American astronauts to use Russia's Soyuz spacecraft.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/nasa-russian-space-agency-sign-deal-share-space-station-flights-roscosmos-2022-07-15/>).

### 2022-07-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1120129139](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20July%2016&oldid=1120129139>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-07-16-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian missiles strike the city of Chuhuiv in Kharkiv Oblast, killing three civilians and injuring three others, while more than 50 Grad rockets hit the city of Nikopol in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, killing two people. The missile strikes come after Russian defence minister Sergei Shoigu ordered the military to expand operations in Ukraine in order to "protect the Donbas".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/warning-sirens-sound-ukraines-capital-russia-steps-up-bombardment-2022-07-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The president of Energoatom, the Ukrainian nuclear energy authority, accuses Russian forces of using the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant to store weapons and shell the surrounding area.

Source citations (as archived): [The Journal.ie](<https://www.thejournal.ie/russia-shelling-from-ukraine-nuclear-plant-5818580-Jul2022/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israel launches more than a dozen missiles against two Hamas targets in the Gaza Strip, following a number of rockets fired overnight from Gaza into Israel, causing severe damage. No casualties were reported and no civilian structures were targeted or hit.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/israel-launches-attack-on-gaza/6661350.html>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/israel-launches-air-raid-on-gaza-after-rocket-launches>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-0-9"></a>

Context: Papua conflict / Nogolait shooting.

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed and two others are injured when gunmen attack civilians in Nduga Regency, Highland Papua, Indonesia. The separatist West Papua National Liberation Army is blamed for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-8557eab22bda1e03bd3004d2703f31b9>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-07-16-1-2"></a>

Context: July 2022 European heat wave / 2022 European and MENA wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Wildfires break out in southwestern France and Spain amidst a heat wave in Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/wildfires-rage-france-spain-heatwaves-sweep-europe-2022-07-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-1-3"></a>

Context: July 2022 European heat wave / 2022 European and MENA wildfires.

**Archived source account.** In Portugal, a waterbombing plane crashes in Vila Nova de Foz Côa while fighting wildfires in the region, killing the pilot, and in Spain, around 2,300 people are evacuated from the Costa del Sol due to wildfires in the Mijas hills.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62189272>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-1-4"></a>

Context: July 2022 European heat wave.

**Archived source account.** A report shows that at least 360 people have died in a week during the heat wave in Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/sociedad/2022-07-16/la-ola-de-calor-deja-360-muertes-entre-el-10-y-el-15-de-julio.html>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-1-6"></a>

Context: Meridian Flight 3032.

**Archived source account.** An Antonov An-12 cargo plane, operated by a Ukrainian airline, crashes near the city of Kavala, Greece, killing all eight people on board. The aircraft was carrying weapons from Serbia to Bangladesh, and crashed before a planned stop in Jordan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62195005>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-07-16-2-2"></a>

Context: Accession of North Macedonia to the European Union / Bulgaria–North Macedonia relations.

**Archived source account.** The Assembly of North Macedonia passes a motion to amend North Macedonia’s Constitution to recognise its Bulgarian minority, while pledging to discuss remaining issues with the Bulgarian government. In exchange, Bulgaria will allow membership talks with the European Union to begin.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/north-macedonia-votes-to-resolve-dispute-with-bulgaria>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-2-5"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations / Economic sanctions against the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran imposes sanctions on 61 Americans for their association with exiled Iranian dissident group People's Mojahedin Organization of Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/iran-imposes-sanctions-61-americans-nuclear-talks-hit-impasse-2022-07-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** G20 finance leaders end a meeting in Bali without a joint communique, as consensus could not be reached on multiple issues due to tensions caused by ongoing conflicts between the countries.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2022/07/17/g20-no-full-consensus-food-security-inflation-ukraine-war-top-agenda.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-07-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and two injured in a mass shooting in the Gauteng province of South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/nine-killed-separate-shootings-south-africa-police-2022-07-17/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests continue in Panama with road and railways blockades, after protesters rejected president Laurentino Cortizo's concessions.

Source citations (as archived): [La Prensa](<https://www.prensa.com/provincias/siguen-los-cierres-de-vias-en-chiriqui-veraguas-y-panama-oeste/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-16-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Haiti.

**Archived source account.** The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights documents 934 killings, 684 injuries and 680 kidnappings in Port-au-Prince since the start of 2022, in a sharp increase of violence in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/16/un-decries-rising-death-toll-rights-violations-in-haiti>).

Context: Crime in Haiti.

**Archived source account.** The UN Security Council passes a resolution extending the mandate of the UN Integrated Office in Haiti for a further year.

<a id="event-2022-07-17-1-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Asia / COVID-19 pandemic in India.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-07-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Croatia–Serbia relations.

**Archived source account.** Croatia refuses to allow a private visit from the President of Serbia Aleksandar Vučić to the site of the Jasenovac concentration camp due to the Government of Croatia not being formally notified of the visit.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/diplomatic-spat-erupts-between-balkan-rivals-serbia-croatia/2022/07/17/cb1d9268-05cd-11ed-80b6-43f2bfcc6662_story.html>).

Context: Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** Former Minister of Foreign Affairs and senior adviser to Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, Kamal Kharazi, confirms that Iran now has the capabilities to develop and build a nuclear weapon but says that "there has been no decision by Iran to build one". Kharazi also warns that Iran will "directly respond" to Israel if it is attacked.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/adviser-to-iran-leader-khamenei-says-teheran-capable-of-building-nuclear-bomb>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/middle-east-news/iran-news/article-712327>).
