<a id="event-2022-07-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Greenwood Park Mall shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three people and the gunman are killed and two others injured in a mass shooting at the food court of Greenwood Park Mall in Greenwood, Indiana, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Indianapolis Star](<https://www.indystar.com/story/news/crime/2022/07/17/greenwood-park-mall-shooting-indianapolis/65375408007/>).

### 2022-07-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1117260340](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20July%2018&oldid=1117260340>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-07-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Donbas.

**Archived source account.** Russian shelling kills six civilians in Toretsk, Donetsk Oblast, as Ukraine says that Russia appears to be preparing for a new ground offensive near Sloviansk.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62207922>).

<a id="event-2022-07-18-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

**Archived source account.** Russia announces Anton Koltsov, former Prime Minister of Vologda Oblast, as the new Prime Minister in Zaporizhzhia Military-Civilian Administration. His appointment probably took place some days earlier.

Source citations (as archived): [Euromaidan Press](<https://euromaidanpress.com/2022/07/19/russia-appoints-ex-first-deputy-of-vologda-region-anton-koltsov-as-sham-council-head-of-zaporizhzhia-oblast/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-07-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Russia in the European energy sector.

**Archived source account.** Russia's Gazprom says that it "cannot guarantee" gas supplies to Europe due to "extraordinary circumstances" as it declares force majeure on gas supplies dating from June 14.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russias-gazprom-declares-force-majeure-gas-supplies-europe-2022-07-18/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-07-18-2-2"></a>

Context: 2022 European heat waves / 2022 United Kingdom heat wave.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom issues a "red extreme heat warning" as temperatures are predicted to reach a record 41 C in parts of England. Wales reports a record temperature of 37.1 C near the town of Hawarden, Flintshire, and the island of Jersey reports a record temperature of 37.9 C.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-62201793>); [BBC News 2](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-62184978>); [ITV Channel Islands](<https://www.itv.com/news/channel/2022-07-18/temperatures-break-jerseys-all-time-record>).

<a id="event-2022-07-18-2-3"></a>

Context: 2022 European heat waves / 2022 United Kingdom heat wave.

**Archived source account.** The Royal Air Force suspends all flights to and from RAF Brize Norton in Oxfordshire after the runway suffers damage due to the extreme heat.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/raf-runway-brize-norton-heatwave-b2125735.html>).

<a id="event-2022-07-18-2-4"></a>

Context: 2022 European heat waves.

**Archived source account.** Dublin, Ireland, reports a record temperature of 33.1 C. Parts of France also report record temperatures.

Source citations (as archived): [Met Éireann](<https://www.met.ie/temperature-records-broken-as-met-eireann-establish-new-climate-services-division>); [Le Progrès](<https://www.leprogres.fr/environnement/2022/07/18/apocalypse-de-chaleur-ce-lundi-dans-une-france-rouge-canicule>).

<a id="event-2022-07-18-2-6"></a>

Context: Sadiqabad boat sinking.

**Archived source account.** Twenty people are killed and 30 others are missing after a boat capsizes in Sadiqabad, Punjab, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/18/several-killed-after-boat-capsizes-in-pakistan>).

<a id="event-2022-07-18-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirty-one people are injured and several homes are destroyed after a magnitude 5.1 earthquake hits Paktika Province, Afghanistan. It is an aftershock of the June 22 quake.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-taliban-earthquakes-194ab2cda6f41a4c632ff654389c335f>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China / COVID-19 pandemic in Shanghai.

**Archived source account.** Residents in nine of Shanghai's districts will be required to undergo COVID-19 testing until July 21 as part of an effort to reduce the community spread of COVID-19.

<a id="event-2022-07-18-5-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy dismisses Ukraine's prosecutor general Iryna Venediktova and the top security official of the Security Service of Ukraine, Ivan Bakanov. More than 60 officials from the agencies are alleged to be working with Russia. Additionally, 651 cases of alleged treason and collaboration are initiated against prosecutorial and law enforcement officials.

Context: 2022 United Kingdom government crisis / 2022 vote of confidence in the Johnson ministry.

**Archived source account.** A motion of confidence in the Johnson government is passed by 347 votes to 238.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/jul/18/boris-johnson-defends-record-as-government-faces-confidence-vote>).

### 2022-07-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1117260372](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20July%2020&oldid=1117260372>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-07-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Operation Claw-Lock / Zakho resort attack.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi government and regional authorities claim that Turkish Armed Forces fired four missiles at a resort in the Zakho District of Kurdistan Region in Iraq, killing eight Iraqi tourists and injuring 23 others.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-turkey-iraq-baghdad-7488a761ef3fc1115a2307701d4be50c>).

<a id="event-2022-07-20-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov says that his country's military goals are no longer limited to the Donbas region and have expanded to also include "the Kherson region, the Zaporizhzhia region and a number of other territories".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/20/lavrov-says-russia-military-goals-not-focused-only-on-donbas>).

<a id="event-2022-07-20-0-8"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab raids Yeed and Aato in Bakool, Somalia, near the Ethiopian border. Fourteen Ethiopian police officers and three civilians are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/somalias-al-shabaab-group-rare-attack-near-ethiopia-border-2022-07-21/>); [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/al-shabab-attacks-somali-towns-close-to-ethiopian-border-/6667670.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-07-20-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge.

**Archived source account.** Inflation in the United Kingdom increased to 9.4% last month, breaking a 40-year record, as food and fuel prices continue to increase.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2022/jul/20/uk-inflation-rise-new-peak-fuel-food-prices-business-live>).

<a id="event-2022-07-20-1-3"></a>

Context: Russia in the European energy sector.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission tells EU member states to reduce gas usage by 15% until March 2023 as part of an emergency plan after President Vladimir Putin warns that Russian supplies of natural gas could be reduced further.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/europe-races-cut-russian-gas-usage-amid-new-putin-warning-2022-07-20/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-20-1-5"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The European Union bans imports of gold from Russia and freezes Sberbank's assets.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2022/07/20/eu-bans-imports-of-russian-gold-and-freezes-sberbanks-assets>).

<a id="event-2022-07-20-1-7"></a>

Context: Economy of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine's government, facing an estimated 35% to 45% decrease in GDP, asks its international creditors to freeze its debt payments for two years, including a $1.2 billion debt payment due at the beginning of September. The proposal is backed by major Western governments and other major lenders.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-intends-postpone-debt-payments-24-months-government-resolution-2022-07-20/>).

**Archived source account.** A man attempts to stab Lee Zeldin, a U.S. Representative and the Republican Party nominee in the upcoming New York gubernatorial election, during a campaign event in Perinton, New York, United States. Zeldin is not hurt during the incident, and the man is taken into custody.

Source citations (as archived): [WIVB-TV](<https://www.wivb.com/news/witnesses-gov-candidate-lee-zeldin-attacked-at-perinton-campaign-stop/>).

<a id="event-2022-07-21-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Justice of Russia opens a court case to close the Jewish Agency for Israel, the main agency allowing the aliyah of Jews to Israel. Israel condemns the court case, claiming it is a response to Israel's stance on the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62254595>).

Ukraine also claims to have destroyed a Russian ammunition depot, artillery and other military equipment in the region, killing 51 Russian troops.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/ukraine-says-russian-strikes-hit-areas-along-black-sea/6673997.html>).

<a id="event-2022-07-26-0-7"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / Anti-MONUSCO protests.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed and 50 others are injured as UN peacekeepers open fire at an anti-United Nations protest in Goma, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/26/un-peacekeepers-troops-shoot-two-protesters-dead-in-goma-drc>).

<a id="event-2022-07-26-0-8"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / Anti-MONUSCO protests.

**Archived source account.** Three UN peacekeepers and seven civilians are killed during an attack on a MONUSCO base by protesters in Butembo, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

<a id="event-2022-08-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / 2022 Mogadishu hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** The siege at a hotel seized by al-Shabaab fighters in Mogadishu ends with the deaths of all of the attackers. Twenty-one other people were killed, and 117 others were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/8/21/somali-forces-end-al-shabab-siege-at-mogadishu-hotel-report>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-62621205>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-08-21-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Afghanistan floods.

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed by heavy flooding in Khoshi District, Logar, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-floods-kabul-climate-and-environment-c7577d1b081114ed288f290816c415e5>).

<a id="event-2022-08-21-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed and three others are injured when a truck collides with a minibus in Ulyanovsk Oblast, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-14-dead-after-minibus-collides-with-lorry-russia-police-2022-08-21/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-21-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 50 people are killed by flooding caused by heavy rains in Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand, India.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/floods-landslides-kill-dozens-monsoon-rains-lash-northern-eastern-india-2022-08-21/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-21-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine soldiers are killed and four others are injured when their truck plunges into a ravine in Azad Kashmir, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/nine-soldiers-die-truck-plunges-into-ravine-pakistani-kashmir-2022-08-21/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-08-21-2-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Fumio Kishida tests positive for COVID-19.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2022/08/004f649fe2f2-breaking-news-japan-pm-kishida-tests-positive-for-covid-19-govt.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-08-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United Arab Emirates relations.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates announces the reinstallation of its ambassador to Iran, which will take effect "in the coming days", more than six years after it cut off diplomatic relations with the Islamic republic.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/uae-upgrading-ties-iran-says-envoy-return-tehran-within-days-2891581>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-08-21-4-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong says that Singapore will decriminalize sex between men, which is illegal under a colonial-era law, while also amending the Constitution to define marriage as a heterosexual union.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/section-377a-repeal-law-sex-gay-men-marriage-constitution-pm-lee-ndr2022-2891381>).

<a id="event-2022-08-21-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Oleksandr Nakonechny, regional head of the Security Service of Ukraine in Kirovohrad Oblast, is found dead in his apartment in an apparent suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax Ukraine](<https://interfax.com.ua/news/general/853616.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-08-21-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Western &amp; Southern Open.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, world number 156 Borna Ćorić of Croatia becomes the lowest-ranked champion in the ATP Tour Masters 1000 after defeating Stefanos Tsitsipas of Greece in the men's singles final of the 2022 Cincinnati Masters.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://sports.inquirer.net/474410/coric-upsets-tsitsipas-to-win-cincinnati-masters-title>).

<a id="event-2022-08-21-5-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Western &amp; Southern Open.

**Archived source account.** World number 17 Caroline Garcia of France becomes the first qualifier to win a WTA 1000 tournament after defeating Petra Kvitová of the Czech Republic in the women's singles final of the 2022 Cincinnati Masters.

Source citations (as archived): [Sportstar](<https://sportstar.thehindu.com/tennis/caroline-garcia-beats-petra-kvitova-wins-2022-cincinnati-masters/article65795445.ece>).

<a id="event-2022-08-22-2-4"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in North America / COVID-19 pandemic in Canada / COVID-19 vaccination in Canada.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-08-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Donbas.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian forces reportedly shell the administration headquarters of the Donetsk People's Republic in separatist-held Donetsk, killing three people, according to pro-Russian officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-strikes-administration-headquarters-donetsk-russia-installed-separatists-2022-08-23/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-23-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** Slovakia announces that it will send an additional 30 BMP-1 infantry fighting vehicles and ammunition to Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/slovakia-donate-30-infantry-fighting-vehicles-ukraine-minister-2022-08-23/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Libyan Crisis.

**Archived source account.** According to the Libyan National Army, a United States-manufactured MQ-9 Reaper drone was shot down with a surface-to-air missile, crashing near Benina International Airport in Benghazi, Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [Eurasian Times](<https://eurasiantimes.com/mq-9-reaper-drone-shot-down-near-benghazi-video/>); [Mehr News Agency](<https://en.mehrnews.com/news/190589/US-General-Atomics-MQ9-Reaper-drone-shot-down-in-Libya>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-08-23-1-1"></a>

Context: Holocene extinction.

**Archived source account.** The dugong is declared extinct in China after scientists report no verified sightings of the large marine mammal since 2000. However, dugongs still exist in the wild in parts of Southeast Asia and Australasia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-62638485>).

<a id="event-2022-08-23-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea registers a population decrease for the second consecutive year, due to having the world's lowest birth rate.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20220823/e8fa512b157045198f621ca51f58bcff/c.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-08-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Court of Malaysia upholds the corruption conviction and 12-year prison term of former prime minister Najib Razak in connection with the embezzlement of sovereign wealth funds from 1Malaysia Development Berhad. Najib is the first former Malaysian prime minister to be imprisoned.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/08/23/1118960767/malaysia-top-court-upholds-ex-prime-minister-najibs-graft-conviction>).

<a id="event-2022-08-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot.

**Archived source account.** Two men are found guilty of conspiring to obtain a weapon of mass destruction for use in the foiled plot to kidnap Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer. One of the men is also convicted of an explosives charge.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/elections-presidential-michigan-gretchen-whitmer-grand-rapids-9ad8f100d32e7d5883b1be9d6c4cb8d5>).

<a id="event-2022-08-23-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian police conduct eight raids on pro-Bolsonaro businessmen accused of discussing the possibility of a coup d'état if incumbent President Jair Bolsonaro loses the upcoming presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-police-raid-pro-bolsonaro-businessmen-accused-coup-talk-sources-say-2022-08-23/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-08-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Scott Morrison ministerial positions controversy.

**Archived source account.** Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announces an official inquiry into his predecessor Scott Morrison's secret swearing of himself into various ministerial positions during his second ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2022/aug/23/anthony-albanese-scott-morrison-australia-politics-solicitor-general>).

<a id="event-2022-08-23-3-3"></a>

Context: 2022 Samoan o le Ao o le Malo election.

**Archived source account.** Tuimalealiʻifano Vaʻaletoʻa Sualauvi II is re-elected by the Parliament for a second term as O le Ao o le Malo, the Samoan head of state.

Source citations (as archived): [RNZ](<https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/473339/samoan-parliament-re-elects-head-of-state>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [Euro Weekly News](<https://euroweeklynews.com/2022/08/24/russian-appointed-head-of-zaporizhzhia-ivan-sushko-killed-in-car-bomb-explosion/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Chaplyne railway station attack.

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed and more than 50 others are injured in a Russian rocket attack on a passenger train in Chaplyne, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/aug/24/at-least-15-killed-in-russian-strike-on-rail-station-on-ukraines-independence-day>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-15-died-russian-attack-ukraine-station-zelenskiy-2022-08-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-24-0-7"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces a security package of nearly US$3 billion from the Ukraine Security Assistance Initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ukraine-aid-3-billion-biden-administration-announcement/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-24-0-9"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian civil war, Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden orders airstrikes against claimed Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and Russia-linked groups in Syria in response to a August 15 rocket attack near the U.S. military base in al-Tanf, Syria, which houses the Maghaweir al-Thowra rebel group, and an airstrike by the Russian military in an area held by the Syrian opposition. The U.S. strikes targeted eleven bunkers in Deir ez-Zor used to store weapons, according to the United States Central Command.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/08/23/politics/syria-airstrikes-iranian-backed-groups-biden/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-military-carries-out-strike-syria-iran-linked-targets-2022-08-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-08-24-0-10"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian civil war, Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A spokesperson for the Iranian foreign ministry denies that Iran has any link to targets hit by U.S. in Syria and condemns the strike as "a violation of Syria's sovereignty and territorial integrity".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-denies-any-link-targets-hit-by-us-syria-2022-08-24/>); [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/syria-us-service-member-wounded-military-says>).

<a id="event-2022-08-24-0-12"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed in a shooting between two criminal groups in Tuzantla, Michoacán, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-city-butterflies-097160ae675272ba1ffefec6d90f298e>).

<a id="event-2022-08-24-0-14"></a>

Context: Tigray War.

**Archived source account.** Fighting resumes between the Ethiopian military and the Tigray Defense Forces in the Tigray Region. Both sides blame each other for breaking the ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/aug/24/fighting-in-northern-ethiopia-shatters-months-long-truce-tigray>).

Context: Hydrail.

**Archived source account.** Germany and French rail transport manufacturer Alstom inaugurate the world's first fleet of hydrogen fuel-powered trains in Lower Saxony. The 14 hydrogen trains will replace a fleet of diesel locomotives on 100 km of track in the German state.

<a id="event-2022-08-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Police arrest Kremlin critic Yevgeny Roizman, the former mayor of Yekaterinburg, for "discrediting the Russian army" by criticizing the invasion of Ukraine.

Another victim's widow receives $15 million.

Context: 2022 Angolan general election.

**Archived source account.** Angolans vote to elect their president in a tight race between incumbent leftist candidate João Lourenço and center-right candidate Adalberto Costa Júnior.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/angolans-to-vote-in-tight-race-that-could-affect-pro-russia-ties/ar-AA111mcX?ocid=EMMX>).

Deputy Prime Minister Prawit Wongsuwan will take over the premiership while the case is being heard.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/thai-court-suspends-pm-prayuth-chan-ocha-official-duty-pending-result-term-limit-2022-08-24/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-08-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine campaign.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Reuters reported President Filipe Nyusi’s account that September 6 attacks in Erati and Memba killed six people, abducted three, led to the capture of six attackers, and burned dozens of homes. These are attributed official claims, rather than independently confirmed casualty totals.

Editorial date: 2022-09-06. Checked: 2026-10-21. Complete wording review against the opened report: all enumerated details are attributed to Nyusi. The archival assertion remains unchanged and the separate account makes attribution explicit.

Evidence: [Reuters via IstoÉ Dinheiro](<https://istoedinheiro.com.br/ao-menos-seis-mocambicanos>).

Original source account: Six people are killed and three others are kidnapped as Islamists insurgents raid the districts of Erati and Memba, Mozambique, torching dozens of houses. Six attackers are arrested.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2022-09-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Russia relations.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-09-27-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 annexation referendums in Russian-occupied Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** According to the results released by Russian occupation authorities in Ukraine, the Donetsk People's Republic, the Luhansk People's Republic, as well as occupied parts of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson Oblasts overwhelmingly vote in favor of annexation, with 99.23%, 98.42%, 93.11% and 87.05% of support, respectively. Turnout exceeded 75% in each region and exceeded 97% in Donetsk Oblast. However, the voting has been widely dismissed as a sham referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [RIA Novosti](<https://ria.ru/20220927/referendum-1819941990.html>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-kyiv-moscow-referendums-1780c30715ce49723629d05c5e2f3238>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/first-partial-results-show-over-96-occupied-ukraine-regions-favour-joining-2022-09-27/>).

<a id="event-2022-09-27-5-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/09/27/1125272058/japan-funeral-shinzo-abe>).

### 2022-09-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1114022578](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20September%2028&oldid=1114022578>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-09-28-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian emigration following the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** North Ossetia–Alania which contains the only border crossing between Russia and Georgia-controlled territory, bans all Russian cars that do not have the licence plate of the republic, with the exception of tourists travelling to the region. This comes as those fleeing the draft overwhelm the border.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-region-limits-incoming-cars-amid-queues-georgia-border-escape-draft-2022-09-28/>).

<a id="event-2022-09-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian emigration following the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A mobile draft centre is built at the Torfyanovka checkpoint, the busiest checkpoint on the Finland–Russia border, in order to prevent people who are fit to serve from fleeing the country. However, as of midday, the centre is not yet open.

Source citations (as archived): [The Insider](<https://theins.ru/news/255512>).

<a id="event-2022-09-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Kurdish separatism in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are killed and 58 others are injured as Iran launches missiles and drones upon the Democratic Party of Iranian Kurdistan's offices in Koye, Kurdistan Region, Iraq. Iran accused the group of being involved in the ongoing protests in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/28/iran-kurd-rebels-say-dead-in-iran-strikes-on-iraqi-kurdistan>).

<a id="event-2022-09-28-0-7"></a>

Context: Kurdish separatism in Iran.

**Archived source account.** An Iranian drone is claimed as shot down by US forces in Erbil, Kurdistan Region, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [CENTCOM](<https://www.centcom.mil/MEDIA/STATEMENTS/Statements-View/Article/3173389/statement-regarding-islamic-revolutionary-guard-corps-unprovoked-attack-in-iraq/>).

<a id="event-2022-09-28-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Four Palestinians are killed and 44 others are injured when Israeli soldiers storm a refugee camp in Jenin, West Bank. The brother of the 2022 Tel Aviv shooting's perpetrator is among those killed.

Source citations (as archived): [YNetNews](<https://www.ynetnews.com/article/sjqp7o11mj#autoplay>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/28/israeli-forces-kill-palestinians-jenin-raid>).

<a id="event-2022-09-28-0-11"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and two others are injured when a gunman opens fire against Chinese-Pakistani nationals at a dental clinic in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan. All of the victims were in their 70s and had worked for the clinic for more than 40 years.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-63066745>).

<a id="event-2022-09-28-0-13"></a>

Context: Anglophone crisis.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in Cameroon ban "undeclared meetings and manifestations" in Bamenda, the capital of the Northwest Region, after separatists announced a manifestation to commemorate the declaration of independence of Ambazonia, a breakaway state consisting of the English-speaking regions of Cameroon.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20220929/b08e44d0230743fa9141a86dc3f0a069/c.html>).

<a id="event-2022-09-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Nicaragua.

**Archived source account.** Bettina Muscheidt, the European Union ambassador to Nicaragua, is declared persona non grata, presumably due to her criticism of undemocratic policies of President Daniel Ortega.

Source citations (as archived): [Euractiv](<https://www.euractiv.com/section/global-europe/news/nicaragua-declares-the-eu-ambassador-persona-non-grata/>).

<a id="event-2022-09-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Montenegro–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Montenegro expels six Russian diplomats, whom the country accuses of spying. In response, the Russian embassy in Montenegro announces that its consular section will suspend its services beginning on Friday and "until further notice".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/montenegro-detains-russians-montenegrins-suspicion-spying-report-2022-09-29/>); [Pobjeda](<https://www.pobjeda.me/clanak/ambasada-rusije-zbog-neprijateljskog-cina-obustavljamo-konzularno-odjeljenje>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-09-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in India.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of India strikes down a portion of the Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act that forbade unmarried women from having an abortion, thus legalising the procedure for all women until the 24th week of pregnancy. The ruling also notes that forcing a woman to carry the child could constitute marital rape, which is not, however, recognised as an offence in India.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/29/all-women-have-right-to-safe-and-legal-abortion-india-top-court>).

<a id="event-2022-09-29-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Aung San Suu Kyi, the ousted leader of Myanmar, is sentenced to a further three years' imprisonment for "violating the state's secrets act". She is already serving 20 years on other charges.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/business-myanmar-aung-san-suu-kyi-government-and-politics-34eda95ba2f20c578a545c6742cd9eac>).

<a id="event-2022-09-29-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Catholic Church reveals that it disciplined Carlos Filipe Ximenes Belo, an East Timorese minister and former bishop who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1996, over allegations of sexual abuse of teenage boys committed in the early 1990s.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/vatican-disciplined-nobel-winning-bishop-over-alleged-abuse-minors-2022-09-29/>).

<a id="event-2022-09-29-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda begins the trial of Félicien Kabuga, one of the richest Rwandan businessmen in the 1990s who is implicated in the Rwandan genocide. Kabuga pleads not guilty and does not appear on the first day of the proceedings.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-63068598>).

<a id="event-2022-09-29-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Commission sues Malta in the European Court of Justice, seeking to end the country's "golden passport" scheme, which is the only such scheme still active in the EU. This scheme allows large investors to be granted Maltese citizenship, and by extension, citizenship of the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-09-29/malta-taken-to-eu-s-top-court-over-lucrative-golden-passports>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-09-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Nicaragua.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Nicaragua announced the severance of diplomatic relations with the Netherlands on September 30, according to EFE’s report datelined Managua that day and published October 1.

Editorial date: 2022-09-30. Checked: 2026-10-21. The announcement and original event date are supported. Publication on the following day is not substituted for the announcement date.

Evidence: [EFE via SWI swissinfo.ch](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/nicaragua-rompe-las-relaciones-diplom%C3%A1ticas-con-holanda/47945460>).

Original source account: The Nicaraguan government announced that it had severed diplomatic relations with the Netherlands.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Context: Russian annexation of Southern and Eastern Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin signs accession treaties to annex the occupied Ukrainian territories to Russia. However, the accession treaties must be ratified by both houses of the Russian parliament before becoming effective under Russian law.

## October

### 2022-10-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1265956264](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20October%201&oldid=1265956264>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Donbas / Second Battle of Lyman.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian troops recapture Lyman after weeks of fighting for the city and one day after the annexation of the Donetsk People's Republic to Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/oct/01/russia-ukraine-war-ukrainians-advance-on-lyman-after-putins-annexations-live>).

<a id="event-2022-10-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Donbas / Second Battle of Lyman.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Defence of Russia says that it has withdrawn troops from the town of Lyman due to "a threat of encirclement".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63102220>).

<a id="event-2022-10-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Donbas / Second Battle of Lyman.

**Archived source account.** After the defeat in Lyman, the head of Chechnya, Ramzan Kadyrov, calls on the Russian government to introduce martial law and use low-yield nuclear weapons in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Moskovskij Komsomolets](<https://www.mk.ru/politics/2022/10/01/kadyrov-posle-limana-prizval-ispolzovat-yadernoe-oruzhie.html>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/01/europe/ukraine-russia-lyman-donetsk-intl/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-its-troops-left-lyman-avoid-encirclement-2022-10-01/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2022/10/1/ukraine-blog-3>).

<a id="event-2022-10-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A civilian convoy of seven cars attacked by Russian forces is discovered in Kupiansk Raion in Kharkiv Oblast with 24 people being killed, including a pregnant woman and 13 children, according to local governor Oleh Synyehubov.

Source citations (as archived): [Ukrainska Pravda](<https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2022/10/1/7369956/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-01-0-11"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** An 18-year-old man is killed by Israeli soldiers in East Jerusalem, making him the 100th Palestinian killed in the West Bank this year. It is the deadliest toll of Palestinians killed there by Israeli raids since 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-63073541>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Hurricane Ian increases to 84.

**Archived source account.** Canada formally ends all COVID-19 border measures, including vaccination requirements, pre-arrival testing, and quarantine, allowing all travellers to enter the country unrestricted without needing to submit public health information through the ArriveCAN government mobile app.

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

### 2022-10-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115334119](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20October%203&oldid=1115334119>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

It later landed in the Pacific. The launch comes after a series of balloon launches and placard protests from South Korea and various military exercises involving the US.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-10-03/northern-japan-residents-warned-to-shelter-from-n-korea-missile-l8tcy12e>); [WNYT-TV](<https://wnyt.com/us-news/n-korea-sends-missile-soaring-over-japan-in-escalation/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-63126534>).

Several other cities across Ukraine are also hit in targeted attacks against water supplies and energy facilities, with power outages being reported in 1,162 towns and villages.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-attacks-energy-facility-northern-kyiv-presidential-aide-2022-10-18/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63297239>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Iran agrees to provide Russia with medium-range missiles, surface-to-surface missiles and combat drones for the war in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/18/iran-agrees-to-supply-missiles-as-well-as-drones-to-russia>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-0-7"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed in a grenade attack in Shopian, Jammu and Kashmir, India.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/militants-indian-kashmir-kill-two-migrant-workers-2022-10-18/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-0-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Multiple people are killed and 10 others are abducted after gunmen storm a hospital in Niger State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-abduct-least-10-hospital-workers-nigerias-niger-state-2022-10-18/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Julia.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the October 8 landslide in Las Tejerías, Venezuela, increases to 54.

Source citations (as archived): [La Prensa Latina](<https://www.laprensalatina.com/hope-fading-10-days-into-search-for-missing-in-venezuela-landslide/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed when a helicopter carrying pilgrims crashes in Uttarakhand, India.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://mynorthwest.com/3676733/helicopter-carrying-hindu-pilgrims-crashes-in-northern-india/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and three others are injured when a hot air balloon carrying tourists crashes in Nevşehir, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/travel-middle-east-turkey-accidents-11fd944ab86173365476a470f349aced>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-10-18-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Agriculture announces that more than 47 million chickens and turkeys have died this year of H5N1 bird flu or related culling in the United States, amid the deadliest outbreak of the disease in the country since 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-nears-record-poultry-deaths-bird-flu-virus-type-complicates-fight-2022-10-18/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-10-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Status of Jerusalem, Australia–Israel relations.

**Archived source account.** Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong confirms that Australia will no longer recognise West Jerusalem as the capital of Israel until peace negotiations are finalised.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/oct/18/penny-wong-denies-formal-change-on-australia-recognition-of-west-jerusalem-israel-capital>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the United Kingdom, Visa policy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom announces visa-free entry for ordinary citizens of Colombia, Guyana and Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [El Espectador](<https://www.elespectador.com/mundo/america/reino-unido-retira-su-requisito-de-visas-para-peru-desde-el-9-de-noviembre-noticias-hoy/>); [Demerara Waves](<https://demerarawaves.com/2022/10/18/breaking-guyanese-can-now-travel-to-the-uk-visa-free/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-3-5"></a>

Context: Chechen–Russian conflict, Russia–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** The Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine passes a resolution recognising Chechnya as "temporarily occupied" by Russia, as well as condemning war crimes committed by Russia during the First and Second Chechen Wars.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-lawmakers-brand-chechnya-russian-occupied-dig-kremlin-2022-10-18/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Internet censorship in Russia.

**Archived source account.** A court in Moscow fines Amazon, Inc. four million rubles (US$65,000) for failing to delete content on drug use and for "propagandizing suicide".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/russia-court-fines-amazon-1-million-roubles-failure-delete-illegal-content-2022-10-18/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-18-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and another person is injured in a stabbing in Ludwigshafen, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. The suspect, a 25-year-old Somali man, is shot and injured by police before being arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/germany-527f7d805d2c8cfbbe9bca770692dad6>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-10-18-5-1"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge.

**Archived source account.** A nationwide strike begins in France with workers demanding higher salaries amid increasing inflation in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/next/2022/10/18/france-strike>).

### 2022-10-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1181309710](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20October%2019&oldid=1181309710>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-10-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces begin evacuating thousands of civilians from occupied areas of Kherson Oblast, according to Russian-installed governor Volodymyr Saldo. Ukraine calls on residents to ignore the Russian orders to leave their towns and villages.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63311744>).

<a id="event-2022-10-19-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 Russian martial law.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin introduces martial law, beginning Thursday at midnight, in the recently annexed territories of Ukraine. Additionally, an "intermediate level of preparedness" is introduced in Crimea and the federal subjects bordering Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/b48b555f547ff6a1a59b1cad17d0e269>); [The Insider](<https://theins.ru/news/256185>).

<a id="event-2022-10-19-0-7"></a>

Context: 2022 Haitian crisis, Bahamas–Haiti relations.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of the Bahamas Philip Davis says that he is ready to send troops to Haiti as part of a peacekeeping force if asked to do so by the Caribbean Community.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bahamas-would-send-troops-haiti-if-asked-minister-says-2022-10-18/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-19-0-9"></a>

Context: Internal conflict in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Three staff members and five visitors are killed by two bomb explosions inside Insein Prison in Yangon, Myanmar. Ten others are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/19/at-least-8-killed-in-myanmar-insein-prison-blast-media-reports>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2022-10-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament awards the Sakharov Prize to "the people of Ukraine".

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/european-parliament-awards-this-years-sakharov-prize-to-the-ukrainian-people/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-10-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Belarusian involvement in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Belarus says that it is unable to pay off its debt because of international sanctions imposed due to its role in the Russo-Ukrainian War.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/belarus-says-it-is-unable-pay-off-debt-due-sanctions-2022-10-19/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-19-2-3"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge.

**Archived source account.** Inflation in the United Kingdom rises to 10.1%, the highest recorded level since 1982, amid a cost of living crisis and sharp increases in food prices, according to the Office for National Statistics.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/oct/19/uk-inflation-rises-energy-bills-food-prices-september-cost-of-living-crisis>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-19-3-1"></a>

Context: Central American migrant caravans.

**Archived source account.** Three Venezuelan migrants are killed and five others are injured in a van accident on a highway in Chiapas, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/venezuelan-migrants-killed-mexico-highway-accident-91765817>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-10-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Indonesian Health Ministry announces that 99 children have died this year due to acute kidney injury with the deaths being linked to paracetamol syrups used to treat fevers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-says-74-children-have-died-acute-kidney-injury-this-year-2022-10-19/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-19-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An outbreak of cholera has killed five people in Lebanon, with a total of 169 cases. It is the first outbreak in the country since 1995.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/19/lebanon-warns-deadly-cholera-outbreak-spreading-rapidly>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-19-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Phnom Penh, Cambodia sentences opposition figure Sam Rainsy to life in prison for "attempting to concede territory to a foreign entity". The sentence was delivered in absentia because Rainsy has been living in exile in France since 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2418211/cambodia-court-sentences-exiled-opposition-figure-rainsy-to-life-in-jail>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-10-19-6-2"></a>

Context: Premiership of Liz Truss / October 2022 United Kingdom government crisis.

**Archived source account.** Suella Braverman resigns as Home Secretary of the United Kingdom and is replaced by Grant Shapps.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/oct/19/suella-braverman-departs-as-uk-home-secretary-liz-truss>).

<a id="event-2022-10-19-6-5"></a>

Context: Same-sex marriage in Mexico / Same-sex marriage in Tabasco.

**Archived source account.** The Congress of Tabasco votes to legalize same-sex marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [as](<https://mexico.as.com/actualidad/matrimonio-igualitario-en-tabasco-que-articulos-se-van-a-reformar-y-cuando-entra-en-vigor-n/>).

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in China.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Australian Capital Territory decriminalizes the possession of illicit drugs in small quantities, including cocaine, amphetamines and heroin beginning in October 2023. Those caught with illicit drugs for personal use will be fined or referred to drug rehabilitation programs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/oct/20/act-becomes-first-australian-jurisdiction-to-decriminalise-illicit-drugs-in-small-quantities>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Death of Harry Dunn.

**Archived source account.** Anne Sacoolas, the wife of a US diplomat, pleads guilty at the Old Bailey (via video link from the USA), to causing the death of British teenage motorcyclist Harry Dunn by careless driving.,

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/anne-sacoolas-wife-us-diplomat-pleads-guilty-death/story?id=91791741>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2022/oct/20/anne-sacoolas-admits-causing-death-of-harry-dunn>).

<a id="event-2022-10-20-5-2"></a>

Context: Premiership of Liz Truss / October 2022 United Kingdom government crisis.

**Archived source account.** An investigation is launched into a Commons vote on fracking where several Tory MPs were allegedly bullied, manhandled, and verbally abused. The 40 ruling party MPs who failed to back the government in the vote now face disciplinary action in the form of losing the whip.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/oct/19/crunch-commons-vote-on-fracking-descends-into-farce>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-63322533>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/fracking-tory-mps-trevelyan-vote-b2206624.html>); [The Guardian 2](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/oct/20/dozens-tory-mps-facing-disciplinary-action-fracking-vote>).

Context: Premiership of Liz Truss / October 2022 United Kingdom government crisis.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Liz Truss announces her resignation, to take effect once a replacement has been appointed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/uk-politics-63309400>).

### 2022-10-21

#### Disasters and accidents

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed in an apartment block fire in Hartland, Wisconsin, United States. Local police say that an "active criminal investigation" is underway.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/dead-apartment-fire-wisconsin/story?id=91866811>).

<a id="event-2022-10-21-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are killed and four others are injured in a road accident in Lima, Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://english.news.cn/20221022/48f4cd8101de45539aef7170707a6bd8/c.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-10-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexico reports its first case of the highly pathogenic H5N1 virus in a wild, non-poultry bird in Metepec, State of Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-reports-first-h5n1-bird-flu-case-2022-10-21/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Argentina–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The last five members of an Iranian cargo plane with Venezuelan crew arrive in Caracas after four months in Argentine custody, where a court seized the plane on suspicions of terrorism at the request of a US court.

<a id="event-2022-10-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2022 Pakistani constitutional crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20221021-former-pakistan-pm-khan-barred-from-elections-for-five-years>).

<a id="event-2022-10-21-3-3"></a>

Context: 2022 British Columbia New Democratic Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** David Eby is acclaimed as the leader of the British Columbia New Democratic Party and becomes the next Premier of British Columbia following the disqualification of his sole opponent, climate activist Anjali Appadurai.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/david-eby-become-premier-canadas-british-columbia-province-2022-10-20/>).

### 2022-10-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

<a id="event-2022-10-22-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2022-10-22-1-1"></a>

<a id="event-2022-10-22-2-1"></a>

Context: 20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party.

**Archived source account.** The 20th National Congress of the Communist Party closes in Beijing, China. The party's new 205-member Central Committee, elected by delegates at the end of the week-long congress, did not include outgoing Premier Li Keqiang or former Guangdong party secretary Wang Yang, who had been seen as a potential replacement as premier. The Сongress has been described as strengthening the power of Xi Jinping, who is likely to be re-elected as General Secretary tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-communist-party-congress-closes-cementing-xis-status-core-2022-10-22/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Somali Civil War / 2022 Kismayo hotel attack.

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed and over 40 others injured by an al-Shabaab suicide car bombing and shooting attack at the Tawakal Hotel in Kismayo, Jubaland, Somalia. The three insurgent gunmen are killed during a gunfight with security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/23/death-toll-in-sudan-tribal-clashes-rises-to-220>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Irkutsk military aircraft crash.

**Archived source account.** A Sukhoi Su-30 crashes into a residential building in Irkutsk, Irkutsk Oblast, Russia. Both pilots are killed. No casualties on the ground are reported, but the crash causes a power outage that affects more than 150 houses.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/russian-military-plane-crashes-into-residential-building-irkutsk-regional-2022-10-23/>); [Meduza](<https://meduza.io/news/2022/10/23/v-irkutske-voennyy-samolet-upal-na-dvuhetazhnyy-dom>).

Context: Korean Air Flight 631.

**Archived source account.** A Korean Air Airbus A330-300 overruns the runway of Mactan–Cebu International Airport after making two landing attempts during poor weather. No injuries are reported among the 173 occupants on board, but the fuselage sustains heavy damage and the airport was shut down. An investigation is already underway.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/korean-air-says-jet-overran-runway-philippines-no-injuries-reported-2022-10-23/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Men's T20 World Cup.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** India defeated Pakistan on October 23 in the men’s T20 World Cup, finishing at 160/6 against Pakistan’s 159/8. ICC’s match report and post-match press-conference transcript corroborate the result and both scores.

Editorial date: 2022-10-23. Checked: 2026-10-21. The winner, opponent and exact scores are supported. Original capitalization and prose are retained in the source account.

Evidence: [ICC](<https://www.icc-cricket.com/news/rohit-sharma-india-captain-post-match-press-conference-ind-v-pak-t20-world-cup-2022>); [ICC](<https://www.icc-cricket.com/news/the-king-lives-kohli-masterclass-helps-india-beat-pakistan-in-mcg-thriller>).

Original source account: Indian cricket team wins against pakistan cricket team pakistan-159/8 and India-160/6.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/ukraine-russia-strikes-kyiv-zaporizhzhia-crazy-tactics/32102668.html>).

<a id="event-2022-10-27-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Israel carries out airstrikes near Damascus, Syria, killing four pro-Iranian fighters.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2022/10/27/Four-pro-Iranian-fighters-killed-in-Israeli-strikes-near-Damascus-War-monitor>).

<a id="event-2022-10-27-0-7"></a>

Context: 2022 Haitian crisis, Canada–Haiti relations.

**Archived source account.** Canada sends a delegation to Haiti to assess the security situation and to "consult with stakeholders on options to support Haitian people in resolving the humanitarian and security crises", amid ongoing international talks on sending a peacekeeping force to the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/27/canada-sends-delegation-to-haiti-to-assess-security-crisis>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2022-10-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Decommunization.

**Archived source account.** Polish authorities demolish four communist-era monuments to the Red Army in the respective towns of Głubczyce, Byczyna, Bobolice, and Staszów, citing a 2016 law that prohibits promotion of totalitarian regimes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/av/world-europe-63414842>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/27/poland-removes-four-communist-era-red-army-monuments>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-10-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Acquisition of Twitter by Elon Musk.

**Archived source account.** Entrepreneur Elon Musk acquires Twitter, Inc. in a $44bn deal. Musk fires Twitter's chief executive officer Parag Agrawal, chief financial officer Ned Segal, and the head of legal policy Vijaya Gadde upon taking over.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/b429b624-bf82-4ccd-bf69-b75055403952>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-27-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A firefighting aircraft of the Italian Protezione Civile crashes on Mount Etna in Sicily while fighting a forest fire, killing the two pilots on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Emergency-live.com](<https://www.emergency-live.com/news/tragedy-in-sicily-canadair-crashes-to-the-ground-two-pilots-on-board-die/amp/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-10-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Lebanese maritime border dispute.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli cabinet unanimously votes in favor of approving a US-brokered maritime deal with Lebanon, with Prime Minister Yair Lapid hailing the deal as an "enemy state's formal recognition".

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-approves-lebanon-deal-lapid-hails-recognition-by-enemy-state/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-27-4-3"></a>

Context: China–Netherlands relations.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands announces an investigation regarding the activities of China's two allegedly illegal police stations in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/27/europe/netherlands-china-illegal-police-stations-intl/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-27-5-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The State Duma unanimously gives preliminary approval to a bill strengthening a law against "propaganda of non-traditional sexual relations". The bill will expand the ban on "propaganda" to all ages, and will outlaw media and online resources, including films, books, and theater productions.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russian-lawmakers-vet-bill-lgbtq-propaganda-92182570>).

<a id="event-2022-10-27-5-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Italy.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and five others, including Spanish footballer Pablo Marí, are injured during a mass stabbing at a Carrefour supermarket in Assago, Lombardy, Italy. The perpetrator, a man with mental health problems, who used a knife from a shelf, is arrested at the scene.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63421228>).

<a id="event-2022-10-27-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people, all members of one family, are found dead in and around a house in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, United States. The incident is being investigated as a possible murder-suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/fires-homicide-tulsa-oklahoma-a873c9e0cd6e52968a1ff912d23f6af2>).

### 2022-10-28

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-10-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** US Secretary of State Antony Blinken announces that the United States will provide another $275 million in additional military aid to Ukraine.

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian mobilization.

<a id="event-2022-10-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinian Civil Defence members are killed, and another is injured when Israeli soldiers open fire on a vehicle at a checkpoint in Nablus, West Bank.

<a id="event-2022-10-28-0-8"></a>

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-28-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** At least 42 people are killed by floods and landslides caused by Tropical Storm Nalgae (Paeng) in Mindanao, Philippines.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-10-28-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol denies that his country is sending weapons to Ukraine after Russian President Vladimir Putin made a reference to South Korea during a conference yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/28/south-korea-denies-sending-weapons-to-ukraine-after-putin-remark>).

<a id="event-2022-10-28-2-3"></a>

Context: China–Germany relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/german-authorities-looking-into-reports-illegal-chinese-police-frankfurt-2022-10-28/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Attack on Paul Pelosi.

**Archived source account.** A man searching for United States House Speaker Nancy Pelosi breaks into her residence in San Francisco and attacks her husband Paul Pelosi, resulting in his hospitalization.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/paul-pelosi-assaulted-156ece77186eb11b97260af3c5122f67>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-10-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2022 Lesotho general election.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/africa-cyril-ramaphosa-southern-lesotho-maseru-6cad47224de5b2acc443f6cd478bf5f7>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-10-28-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022–23 Premiership Rugby.

**Archived source account.** The Rugby Football Union confirms that Wasps have been suspended for the remainder of the season and are relegated to the RFU Championship, the second tier of the English rugby union system, next season after the team had entered administration earlier in the month for reaching more than £100 million in debt.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2022/oct/28/wasps-suspended-from-premiership-as-rfu-confirms-relegation>).

### 2022-10-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1125219966](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20October%2029&oldid=1125219966>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-10-29-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia accuses Ukraine of a drone attack on its Black Sea Fleet headquarters in Sevastopol, Crimea. The Russian-installed Governor of Sevastopol Mikhail Razvozhayev says the Russian Navy repelled the attack, which he calls the "most massive" since the invasion began. Russia consequently suspends its participation in the Black Sea Grain Initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/10/29/1132608672/russia-says-it-is-suspending-a-grain-export-deal-with-ukraine>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63437212>).

<a id="event-2022-10-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Nord Stream pipeline sabotage.

**Archived source account.** Russia accuses the United Kingdom's Royal Navy of blowing up the Nord Stream 1 and Nord Stream 2 gas pipelines in the Baltic Sea on September 26. The Russian Defence Ministry says the Navy was also behind recent attacks on Russian Navy facilities in Crimea. The British government denies both accusations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-british-navy-personnel-blew-up-nord-stream-gas-pipelines-2022-10-29/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-29-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian gunman kills an Israeli settler in Kiryat Arba, Hebron, and injures four others, including a Palestinian paramedic, before being killed by security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/5-people-hurt-one-critically-in-shooting-attack-on-west-bank-settlement/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-29-0-9"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / October 2022 Mogadishu bombings.

**Archived source account.** At least 100 people are killed and over 300 others are injured by an al-Shabaab double car bombing in Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/29/two-blasts-target-somalias-education-ministry-police/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-29-1-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Pacific typhoon season / Tropical Storm Nalgae.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from floods and landslides caused by Tropical Storm Nalgae (Paeng) in the Philippines increases to 45 with at least 14 people reported missing.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/29/world/asia/philippines-storm-nalgae.html>).

<a id="event-2022-10-29-1-4"></a>

Context: Seoul Halloween crowd crush.

**Archived source account.** At least 151 people are killed and 82 others injured in a crowd crush during Halloween celebrations in Itaewon, Seoul, South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hankyoreh](<https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/society/society_general/1064836.html>).

<a id="event-2022-10-29-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gas tanker explosion at an amateur football game in Baghdad, Iraq, kills nine people and wounds 10 others.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-explosions-iraq-baghdad-muqtada-al-sadr-334dc3b71b1fdc4f07fcfe596beabfe5>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Essex lorry deaths.

**Archived source account.** A suspect arrested in 2019 for the deaths of 39 Vietnamese illegal immigrants in a lorry in southern England has been formally charged with 39 counts of manslaughter and conspiracy to assist illegal immigration.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2022/oct/29/man-charged-over-lorry-deaths-of-39-vietnamese-nationals-in-essex>).

<a id="event-2022-10-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Mahsa Amini protests.

**Archived source account.** The first trial related to the protests following the death of Mahsa Amini begins in the Islamic Revolutionary Court of Tehran. The five protesters face charges of corruption on earth, which is punishable by death.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2022/10/29/Iran-trial-opens-for-five-people-facing-death-penalty-over-protests>).

<a id="event-2022-10-29-2-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Brazilian general election.

**Archived source account.** Congresswoman and Bolsonaro supporter Carla Zambelli draws a handgun and chases a Lula supporter in São Paulo. Zambelli claimed to have been assaulted by the man, but video footage shows that Zambelli tripped and fell to the ground before chasing him.

Source citations (as archived): [The Brazilian Report](<https://brazilian.report/liveblog/2022/10/29/bolsonaro-congresswoman-carla-zambelli-weapon/>).

### 2022-10-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1119543679](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20October%2030&oldid=1119543679>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 offensive.

**Archived source account.** M23 rebels capture the towns of Kiwanja and Rutshuru in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. In response, the Congolese government expels Rwanda's ambassador, accusing the country of supporting the rebels.

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Five Israeli soldiers are injured during a vehicle-ramming attack at a checkpoint in Jericho, in the occupied West Bank. The perpetrator is shot dead by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2022-10-30/ty-article/four-israelis-wounded-in-suspected-west-bank-car-ramming-attack/00000184-28e6-dd06-a59d-6de731c70000>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-10-30-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Morbi bridge collapse.

**Archived source account.** At least 141 people are killed in a collapse of a bridge over the Machchhu River in Morbi, Gujarat, India. More than 80 people have been rescued.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/morbi-gujarat-bridge-collapse-live-updates-october-30-2022/article66075016.ece>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-asia-india-63452531>).

<a id="event-2022-10-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed during a crowd crush at a Fally Ipupa concert at the Stade des Martyrs in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-10-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia announces sanctions on eleven British Overseas Territories, accusing them of "unfriendly actions" against Moscow. With these sanctions, the United Kingdom and all 14 British Overseas Territories are now on Russia's list of sanctioned territories.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russia-adds-11-remaining-british-overseas-territories-to-sanctions-list/2724751>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Dover firebomb attack.

**Archived source account.** A man throws firebombs at a centre for processing asylum seekers in Dover, Kent, UK, injuring two people before killing himself.

Source citations (as archived): [TheJournal.ie](<https://www.thejournal.ie/uk-asylum-office-firebombed-5907107-Oct2022/>).

<a id="event-2022-10-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in London.

**Archived source account.** Two people are shot and killed in Brixton, London, while a bystander was knocked down and injured by the gunman's vehicle. No arrests have been made.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-63451427>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-10-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Brazilian general election.

**Archived source account.** Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva narrowly wins election to Brazil's presidency with 50.9% of the vote, defeating incumbent Jair Bolsonaro in the second-round run-off.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/6226302/lula-wins-brazil-election-defeats-bolsonaro/>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/brazil-goes-to-the-polls-to-decide-between-jair-bolsonaro-and-lula-da-silva-12733900>).

Context: 2022 Pacific typhoon season / Tropical Storm Nalgae.

## November

### 2022-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1216369822](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%201&oldid=1216369822>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali–Kenyan conflict, Spillover of the Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Kenyan authorities say that an ambulance carrying two paramedics, a patient and a driver has been hijacked with its passengers by al-Shabaab in Mandera County.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-al-shabaab-attackers-abduct-four-kenya-including-paramedics-police-2022-11-02/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Colombia–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Colombian President Gustavo Petro meets with Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro in Caracas to discuss issues relating to the environment and the re-opening of the border between the two nations, among others. This is the first time that the presidents of Colombia and Venezuela have met since they broke off relations in 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/1/colombia-venezuela-presidents-to-meet-as-ties-keep-improving>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-11-01-2-1"></a>

Context: Recognition of same-sex unions in Japan.

**Archived source account.** The city of Tokyo officially starts recognizing same-sex relationships by allowing LGBTQ partners to be treated as married couples for some public services in areas such as housing, medicine and welfare.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20221101-tokyo-starts-recognising-same-sex-relationships>).

<a id="event-2022-11-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a report by The Intercept, leaked documents reveal that the United States Department of Homeland Security and the FBI have conducted extensive efforts to influence big tech platforms such as Twitter, Facebook, Reddit, Discord, Microsoft, and Wikipedia in order to censor online information or posts considered by the U.S. government to be disinformation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Intercept](<https://theintercept.com/2022/10/31/social-media-disinformation-dhs/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Spanish prosecutors drop some of the criminal charges against Brazilian footballer Neymar in relation to fraud and corruption. However, it is announced that the case will continue.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/sport/20221101-neymar-trial-concludes-after-spain-prosecutors-drop-charges>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-11-01-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Brazilian general election.

**Archived source account.** Outgoing Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro refuses to concede the election but also announces that he will authorize a transition of power to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
