<a id="event-2022-11-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Iranian involvement in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Unidentified warplanes launch airstrikes against Iranian-backed militias on the Iraq–Syria border, including near the Al-Qa'im border crossing, reportedly killing at least 25 people. Fuel tankers carrying Iranian gasoline to Lebanon are also hit. A senior U.S. official confirms that the strikes were conducted by an "unidentified party" in the area.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-721849>).

<a id="event-2022-11-08-0-4"></a>

Context: M23 offensive.

**Archived source account.** DRC Air Force Sukhoi Su-25 jets bomb areas held by M23 rebels in North Kivu, including the recently captured town of Bunagana. At least one of the jets violated Rwandan airspace, although Kinshasa says that the incident was a mistake and was not intentional.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20221108-dr-congo-jets-bomb-m23-rebels-in-east>).

<a id="event-2022-11-08-0-6"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and twelve others are injured by a bombing in Anambra State, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/blast-kills-four-others-injured-nigerias-southeast-official-says-2022-11-08/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-08-1-2"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge / 2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis.

**Archived source account.** Grocery inflation reaches a record 14.7% in the United Kingdom in October, with 27% of households saying that they are struggling financially, which is twice as many as last November.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/british-grocery-inflation-hit-record-147-october-kantar-2022-11-08/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-08-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Americans head to the polls to elect members of the next Congress, 39 governors, and numerous other state and local officials.

<a id="event-2022-11-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup controversies.

**Archived source account.** Qatari FIFA World Cup ambassador Khalid Salman is criticised for describing homosexuality as "damage in the mind" in an interview with German broadcaster ZDF. FIFA has not yet responded.

<a id="event-2022-11-09-1-5"></a>

### 2022-11-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1122138939](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2014&oldid=1122138939>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-14-0-2"></a>

Context: Mali War / Operation Newcombe.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom announces that it is withdrawing its troops from Mali citing "political instability" and the controversial relationship between the Assimi Goïta-led military junta and Russia's Wagner Group.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-63627489>).

<a id="event-2022-11-14-0-4"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Iranian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) strikes the headquarters of the Democratic Party of Iranian Kurdistan in Koy Sanjaq, Kurdistan Region, Iraq, with four missiles, killing at least one person. The IRGC says that it "targeted terrorist groups" with missiles and drones.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/14/iran-rockets-hit-kurdish-party-hq-in-iraqs-erbil>).

<a id="event-2022-11-14-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli forces kill a 15-year-old Palestinian girl in the occupied West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Pagina12](<https://www.pagina12.com.ar/497674-la-adolescente-palestina-murio-baleada/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-11-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed and three others are injured after a road accident in Bordj Badji Mokhtar, Algeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/road-accident-algeria-kills-16-including-13-guineans-2022-11-14/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-14-2-2"></a>

Context: France–United Kingdom relations / English Channel migrant crossings.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom and France sign a revised border control agreement to stop migrant boats from crossing the English Channel amid record numbers of migrants making the crossing. The agreement will increase the number of officers patrolling the French coast to 300 and have British police officers work with their French counterparts in control rooms and on beaches.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-63615653>).

<a id="event-2022-11-14-2-5"></a>

Context: Iran–European Union relations / Sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** The European Union adds 30 Iranian entities including news channel Press TV and cloud computing service Abr Arvan to its sanctions blacklist.

Source citations (as archived): [Taz](<https://taz.de/Iranische-Tarnfirmen-in-Deutschland/!5885984/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-14-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazil, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Indonesia, the three countries with the largest tropical forest area, propose a trilateral alliance to collaborate on forest protection.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/14/world/rainforest-alliance-brazil-indonesia-congo-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-11-14-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Istanbul bombing.

**Archived source account.** Turkish interior minister Süleyman Soylu says that 46 people, including the Syrian woman accused of planting the bomb, have been detained. Süleyman also accuses the Kurdistan Workers' Party of being behind the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/14/turkish-police-arrest-suspect-in-istiklal-bombing>).

### 2022-11-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1122975185](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2015&oldid=1122975185>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 missile explosion in Poland.

**Archived source account.** A missile strike kills two people in the village of Przewodów in eastern Poland. President of the United States Joe Biden says that the missile blast in Poland was caused by a Ukrainian air defense missile. U.S. officials had earlier told the Associated Press that preliminary findings suggested that the missile that hit Poland was fired by Ukrainian forces at an incoming Russian missile.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/ukraine-crisis-poland-blast-missiles/poland-blast-caused-by-missile-fired-by-ukrainian-forces-at-incoming-russian-missile-ap-idUSKBN2S60AQ>); [Reuters 2](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/biden-said-ukraine-air-defence-missile-responsible-poland-blast-nato-source-2022-11-16/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 missile explosion in Poland.

**Archived source account.** The Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs says that it was a "Russian-made missile" and summons the Russian ambassador to provide an explanation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-hails-chinas-opposition-nuclear-threats-2022-11-15/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-zelenskyy-kherson-9202c032cf3a5c22761ee71b52ff9d52>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / November 2022 nationwide missile strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian missiles strike several cities across Ukraine, including Kyiv, causing "critical" damage to energy facilities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/15/russia-launches-new-wave-of-missile-strikes-across-ukraine>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / November 2022 Ariel attack.

**Archived source account.** Three Israelis are killed and three others are injured after a 18-year-old Palestinian man carries out a vehicle-ramming attack and mass stabbing in the Ariel settlement in the occupied West Bank. The perpetrator is shot dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/3-seriously-wounded-in-stabbing-at-west-bank-industrial-zone-attacker-shot/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-0-10"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The United States opens an investigation into the death of journalist Shireen Abu Akleh, who was killed in the West Bank in May.

Source citations (as archived): [Télam](<https://www.telam.com.ar/notas/202211/610925-cisjordania-periodista-asesinato-investigacion.html/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-0-13"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War / Foreign involvement in the Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The US Navy says that it stopped an Iranian shipment of 70 tons of missile fuel components and fertilizer to Yemen. The shipment would likely be used by the Houthis, who are Iran's allies.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iran-united-states-dubai-arab-emirates-saudi-arabia-6e8c6bf72b9304c5bfcc3196478b2ecd>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-11-15-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 south eastern Australia floods.

**Archived source account.** Flooding continues in Australia, with over 220 people being rescued from floodwaters in New South Wales in the past 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-11-15/nsw-floods-forbes-evacuation-wyangala-dam-newell-highway/101653738>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least three people are killed and six others are injured after a multi-storey building collapses in Nairobi, Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/building-collapses-in-kenyas-capital-killing-three-people/2022/11/16/5cf6166e-65ba-11ed-b08c-3ce222607059_story.html>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fourteen people are killed after a minibus and a truck collide in Abu Minqar, New Valley Governorate, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-africa-egypt-accidents-north-9546d21eb67a72f04bc1e60509f96629>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-11-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Day of Eight Billion.

**Archived source account.** The world population surpasses eight billion people, according to the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times](<https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/the-world-population-passes-8-billion-today-how-big-will-it-get-mhqgz5vcw>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 G20 Bali summit.

**Archived source account.** The Group of Twenty begins its annual two-day summit in Nusa Dua, Bali, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/g20-summit-latest-biden-xi-meet-2022-11-14/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-11-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Mahsa Amini protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests are held across Iran to mark the third anniversary of the 2019 protests. Protesters blocked streets and a large strike has been reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Iran International](<https://www.iranintl.com/en/202211152390>).

<a id="event-2022-11-15-4-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Republican Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Former President Donald Trump announces he is running for the Republican Party's nomination in the 2024 U.S. presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/15/politics/trump-2024-presidential-bid/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-11-15-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 ATP Tour.

**Archived source account.** At 19 years old, Spanish tennis player Carlos Alcaraz becomes the youngest year-end world No. 1-ranked singles player by the Association of Tennis Professionals after his closest rival, fellow Spaniard Rafael Nadal, failed to advance to the semifinals of the 2022 ATP Finals. Alcaraz breaks Australian player Lleyton Hewitt's record that he achieved in 2001.

Source citations (as archived): [The Courier-Mail](<https://www.couriermail.com.au/sport/tennis/carlos-alcaraz-crushes-lleyton-hewitt-record-to-become-youngest-yearend-world-no-1/news-story/3dca96e695112ec22800095d4f323b35>).

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge / 2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis.

**Archived source account.** Inflation in the United Kingdom reaches a record 11.1%, pressuring the Bank of England to raise interest rates.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-11-16/uk-inflation-jumps-more-than-expected-to-41-year-high-of-11-1?leadSource=uverify%20wall>).

Context: Capital punishment in Kuwait.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait says that it has carried out a mass execution of seven convicted murderers, including three foreign citizens.

### 2022-11-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360660910](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2017&oldid=1360660910>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-17-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 missile explosion in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Germany offers to deploy its Air Force jets to protect Polish airspace in response to Tuesday's missile explosion in Przewodów, Lublin Voivodeship, that killed two people.

Source citations (as archived): [A News](<https://www.anews.com.tr/world/2022/11/16/germany-offers-to-send-combat-jets-to-poland>).

<a id="event-2022-11-17-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / October–November 2022 nationwide missile strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia carries out another wave of cruise missile strikes on Ukraine, with strikes reported in Dnipro, Odesa, Kharkiv, and Zaporizhzhia, where two people were confirmed to have been killed overnight by a missile. In Dnipro and Odesa, critical infrastructure is also targeted.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2022/nov/17/russia-ukraine-war-live-news-blasts-heard-in-crimea-putin-trying-to-freeze-ukraine-into-submission-us-envoy-says>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2022-11-17-1-1"></a>

Context: 23rd Annual Latin Grammy Awards.

**Archived source account.** The 23rd Annual Latin Grammy Awards are held at the Michelob Ultra Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada. Uruguayan singer-songwriter Jorge Drexler was the most awarded artist with six wins.

Source citations (as archived): [Billboard](<https://www.billboard.com/music/latin/latin-grammys-2022-winners-list-1235172910/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-11-17-2-2"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 inflation surge / November 2022 United Kingdom autumn statement.

**Archived source account.** Chancellor of the Exchequer Jeremy Hunt delivers the delayed autumn statement to parliament, announcing measures to stabilize the economy amid a cost of living crisis, including raising the National Living Wage from £9.50 an hour to £10.42 beginning next year, increasing pensions and welfare payments in line with rising inflation, introducing a higher rate windfall tax on the profits of energy firms, introducing a new "temporary tax" on companies that generate electricity, and capping rent increases in the social sector to 7% until 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-63591754>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-11-17-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Jabalia fire.

**Archived source account.** At least 21 people are killed in a fire at a residential building in Jabalia, Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/at-least-21-people-including-7-children-killed-in-residential-home-fire-in-gaza/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-17-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed and 16 more injured by an explosion caused by a gas leak at a residential building in Sulaymaniyah, Kurdistan Region, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/18/gas-cylinder-explosion-in-iraq-kills>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-17-4-1"></a>

Context: France–Mali relations, Mali War.

**Archived source account.** The French foreign ministry announces the temporary suspension of development aid to Mali, citing the controversial relationship between the Assimi Goïta-led military junta and Russia's Wagner Group in the war.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/africa/20221119-france-halts-development-aid-to-mali-over-wagner-russia-paramilitaries>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-11-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 17.

**Archived source account.** A court in the Netherlands sentences two Russians, Igor Strelkov-Girkin and Sergey Dubinsky, and a Ukrainian pro-Russian separatist Leonid Kharchenko to life imprisonment for shooting down the Malaysia Airlines flight over Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine in 2014. The verdict was delivered in absentia of the defendants.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-business-kuala-lumpur-malaysia-netherlands-099084a82b49b77b116878e24fc63a18>).

<a id="event-2022-11-17-5-3"></a>

Context: Myanmar civil war.

**Archived source account.** The State Administration Council of Myanmar grants an amnesty to 5,774 prisoners, including former British ambassador Vicky Bowman and Australian economist Sean Turnell, a former economic policy advisor to jailed state counsellor Aung San Suu Kyi.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20221117-myanmar-s-junta-to-release-700-prisoners-including-a-former-british-ambassador>).

### 2022-11-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256033219](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2019&oldid=1256033219>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Mahsa Amini protests.

**Archived source account.** Iranian security forces open fire on anti-government protesters in Divandarreh, Kurdistan province, killing three people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/19/iran-security-forces-shoot-dead-at-least-three-civilians>).

<a id="event-2022-11-19-0-2"></a>

Context: Mahsa Amini protests.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian military deploys armoured personnel carriers in Mahabad, West Azerbaijan province, amid fears of a massacre in the restive city. The Iran Human Rights group reports heavy gunfire.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-activists-fear-deadly-crackdown-in-kurdish-populated-mahabad/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-11-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least nine people, including four children, are killed and an unknown number of others are missing after a gas explosion occurs at a five-story residential building in Tymovskoye, Sakhalin, Russia, causing a section of the building to collapse.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/explosion-kills-at-lt-9-on-russias-island-of-sakhalin/2022/11/19/6601a692-67e5-11ed-b08c-3ce222607059_story.html>).

<a id="event-2022-11-19-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed over Snohomish County, Washington, United States, as a Cessna 208B disintegrates in mid-air.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/4-fatalities-now-confirmed-in-snohomish-county-plane-crash/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-11-19-2-1"></a>

Context: 2022 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** A representative from the European Union reports that the parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change have agreed to establish a loss and damage fund for countries vulnerable to the effects of climate change on the final day of the conference.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/deal-reached-on-loss-and-damage-fund-at-un-climate-talks-report-3535821>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-11-19-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Malaysian general election.

**Archived source account.** Malaysians head to the polls to elect members of the Dewan Rakyat.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/18/asia/malaysia-15th-general-election-explainer-intl-hnk/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-11-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Asteroid impact prediction, 2022 WJ1.

**Archived source account.** A 1 m near-Earth asteroid is discovered before falling as a harmless bolide over central Ontario, Canada, at 08:27 UTC. It is the sixth asteroid to be discovered before impacting Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://earthsky.org/space/asteroid-hit-canada-mere-hours-after-discovery/>); [EarthSky](<https://earthsky.org/space/asteroid-hit-canada-mere-hours-after-discovery/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-19-4-3"></a>

Context: Social media use by Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** After holding an impromptu online poll, Twitter owner Elon Musk restores the suspended account of former U.S. President Donald Trump. More than 15 million people voted in the poll, although Musk acknowledged many bots may also have voted.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/nov/20/twitter-lifts-donald-trump-ban-after-elon-musks-poll>).

### 2022-11-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1291302298](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2020&oldid=1291302298>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-20-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Russian-controlled Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant in Enerhodar is shelled, with damage occurring to some buildings, systems, and equipment, according to the International Atomic Energy Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-ukraine-shells-zaporizhzhia-nuclear-power-plant-tass-2022-11-20/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-0-6"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict, Syrian civil war / Operation Claw-Sword.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Air Force launches a series of airstrikes against the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) and Syrian Army positions in Northern Syria, and the Kurdistan Workers' Party (PKK) in Iraqi Kurdistan following the Istanbul bombing, which Ankara blames on Kurdish separatists. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that at least 35 people were killed, including 18 SDF fighters and 16 Syrian troops.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/20/turkey-launches-air-raids-in-syria-iraq-over-istanbul-blast>); [SOHR](<https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a8%d8%b6%d8%b1%d8%a8%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%ac%d9%88%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d8%b1%d9%83%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d8%b1%d8%aa%d9%81%d8%a7%d8%b9-%d8%b9%d8%af%d8%af-%d9%82%d8%aa%d9%80-%d9%80%d9%84%d9%89-%d9%82/571734/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Cabo Delgado.

**Archived source account.** A humanitarian aid worker for the French NGO Solidarités International and a few other civilians are killed in an ambush in the Cabo Delgado Province of Mozambique.

Source citations (as archived): [News360](<https://www.news360.es/ireland/2022/11/23/aid-worker-killed-in-ambush-in-mozambique-5/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-20-1-1"></a>

Context: Egypt–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian president Abdel Fattah el-Sisi and Turkish president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan meet for the first time following their opposing involvements in the 2013 Egyptian coup d'état.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/erdogan-sisi-meet-in-qatar-for-the-first-time-amid-strained-ties>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-11-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Colorado Springs nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and 25 others injured in a mass shooting at a gay bar in Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States, during a drag show and a commemoration of the Transgender Day of Remembrance. A suspect is taken into custody shortly afterward.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/20/us/colorado-springs-shooting-gay-nightclub>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and two others are seriously injured after a car hit a group of people in Oldbury, West Midlands, United Kingdom. A suspect has been arrested by West Midlands Police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-birmingham-63702591>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-11-20-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Malaysian general election.

**Archived source account.** The results from yesterday's election indicate that Malaysia will experience a hung parliament in the Dewan Rakyat for the first time in its history.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/11/19/asia/malaysia-election-race-parliament-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-3-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Malaysian general election.

**Archived source account.** Opposition leader Anwar Ibrahim, whose Pakatan Harapan coalition won the most seats, and former prime minister Muhyiddin Yassin of Perikatan Nasional both claim to have the necessary support to establish a new government, but neither have announced the parties involved.

Source citations (as archived): [Free Malaysia Today](<https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/nation/2022/11/20/muhyiddin-hadi-meet-sarawak-premier-abang-johari/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-3-4"></a>

Context: 2022 Kazakh presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Kazakhs head to the polls to elect their president in a snap election. Exit polls suggest that President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev will be re-elected to a seven-year term.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.trtworld.com/asia/polls-open-for-snap-kazakhstan-presidential-election-62714>); [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/kazakhstan-election-tokayev-set-for-landslide-exit-polls/a-63818194>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-3-6"></a>

Context: 2022 Equatorial Guinean general election.

**Archived source account.** Equatorial Guineans head to the polls to elect their president and members of parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.citizen.co.za/news/news-world/news-africa/equatorial-guinea-ruler-seeks-re-election/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-3-8"></a>

Context: 2022 Nepalese general election.

**Archived source account.** Nepalis head to the polls to elect the 275 members of the House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/11/20/Voting-begins-in-Nepal-amid-concerns-over-economic-political-stability>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-11-20-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** The 22nd edition of the FIFA World Cup opens in Qatar, with Ecuador defeating the hosts 2–0 in the opening match at the Al Bayt Stadium in Al Khor. Qatar becomes the first host nation to lose their opening match in World Cup history.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/world-cup-sports-soccer-qatar-middle-east-11a629d964a0c052fd01faa50722a70e>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-4-3"></a>

Context: 109th Grey Cup, 2022 CFL season.

**Archived source account.** The Toronto Argonauts defeat the Winnipeg Blue Bombers 24–23 to secure their 18th Canadian Football League championship.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/sports/football/cfl/blue-bombers-argonauts-2022-cfl-grey-cup-recap-1.6658338>).

<a id="event-2022-11-20-4-5"></a>

Context: 2022 ATP Finals.

**Archived source account.** Novak Djokovic of Serbia defeats Casper Ruud of Norway in two sets, 7–5, 6–3, to win his sixth ATP Finals title, equaling Roger Federer's record. Djokovic becomes the oldest singles champion at 35 years old. He also claims the biggest payday in tennis history, a record $4,740,300 in prize money.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://mb.com.ph/2022/11/21/djokovic-sweeps-past-ruud-to-win-sixth-atp-finals-crown/>).

### 2022-11-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363092671](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2021&oldid=1363092671>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-21-0-2"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Spillover of the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** A rocket attack on the Turkish border town of Karkamış, kills three people, including a child. Interior Minister Süleyman Soylu blames Kurdish militants in Syria and vows a "strong response". Kurdish groups have denied being behind the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/turkey-several-killed-after-rockets-fired-from-syria/a-63829077>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Spillover of the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** A Turkish soldier is killed and seven police officers are injured after the Bab al-Hawa Border Crossing is shelled by suspected Kurdish militants.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/suspected-kurdish-militants-fire-turkish-border-town-93705349>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-0-4"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Spillover of the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan threatens to launch a ground operation in northern Syria and Iraqi Kurdistan in response to the rocket attacks on Turkish territory.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20221121-erdogan-threatens-ground-operation-in-syria-after-deadly-rocket-strike>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-0-6"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed in a bombing in Kabul, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/blast-afghan-capital-kills-two-2022-11-21/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and 22 others are injured after an ambush on a major highway in Central Equatoria, South Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/africa-south-sudan-juba-uganda-6c71beaa51a4b17c764d0bed98ba9089>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-11-21-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 West Java earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A 5.6-magnitude earthquake kills at least 310 people and injures over 2,000 others in West Java, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ](<https://www.rte.ie/news/2022/1125/1338237-indonesia-death-toll/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-1-3"></a>

Context: 2022 Anyang factory fire.

**Archived source account.** At least 38 people are killed and two others are injured by a fire at a factory in Anyang, Henan, China. Local officials report evidence of electric resistance welding violating workplace safety standards as the likely cause of the fire.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/china-factory-fire-that-killed-38-caused-by-illegal-welding-report-3542720>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Piper PA-31 crashes into a residential area in the Belén Rosales, Medellín, Colombia, killing the eight people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [El Tiempo](<https://www.eltiempo.com/colombia/medellin/medellin-accidente-de-avioneta-contra-casa-los-8-ocupantes-murieron-719331>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and 16 others are injured when a vehicle crashes into an Apple Store in Hingham, Massachusetts, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-63705867>).

<a id="event-2022-11-21-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are injured in an explosion at a school in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [OneNews](<https://www.1news.co.nz/2022/11/21/multiple-sydney-students-injured-in-science-experiment-explosion/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-21-2-1"></a>

Context: France–Mali relations, Mali War.

**Archived source account.** The Assimi Goïta-led military junta prohibits the operation of France-supported NGOs in Mali to reciprocate the French government's suspension of development aid for the West African country due to its involvement with Russia's Wagner Group in the war.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/11/22/Mali-bans-French-backed-NGOs-activities-Govt>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-11-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Tel Aviv rules that former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert committed defamation against the family of prime minister-designate Benjamin Netanyahu by claiming that members of Netanyahu's family are mentally ill and orders Olmert to pay $18,000.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-63703231>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-11-21-4-2"></a>

Context: Artemis program / Artemis 1.

**Archived source account.** NASA's Orion spacecraft performs a flyby of the Moon, coming within 130 km of the lunar surface before entering into a lunar orbit.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-63697714>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-11-21-5-2"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup / 2022 FIFA World Cup controversies, Iran at the FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian team chooses not to sing the Iranian national anthem prior to a match against England amid ongoing civil unrest in Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/soccer-iran-players-opt-not-sing-national-anthem-world-cup-2022-11-21/>).

### 2022-11-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1361372653](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2022&oldid=1361372653>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022 missile explosion in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Germany says that it will deploy Patriot surface-to-air missile systems on the Poland–Ukraine border in order to protect Polish airspace. Polish Defense Minister Mariusz Błaszczak says that he has accepted the German proposal.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<https://www.ibtimes.com/germany-deploy-patriot-air-defense-system-along-polands-border-ukraine-3639019>).

<a id="event-2022-11-22-0-6"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency / 2022 Chad attack.

**Archived source account.** Ten Chadian soldiers are killed and many others injured in an attack by Boko Haram in Lac Region, Chad.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/boko-haram-fighters-kill-10-chadian-soldiers-near-nigeria-border-2022-11-22/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-22-0-8"></a>

Context: South Thailand insurgency.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and 30 others injured in a car bombing at a police compound in Narathiwat, Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/22/one-killed-30-injured-in-southern-thailand-car-bombing>).

<a id="event-2022-11-22-0-10"></a>

Context: Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people, including eight Volunteers for the Defense of the Homeland members, are killed in two separate attacks by jihadists in northern Burkina Faso, with one occurring near Markoye, Oudalan.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2022/11/23/14-killed-in-two-burkina-faso-attacks-by-jihadist-groups/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-11-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 37 people are killed after two buses collide head-on in Maiduguri, Nigeria, and caught fire, followed by a third bus that crashed into them.

Source citations (as archived): [Africannews](<https://www.africanews.com/2022/11/23/at-least-37-dead-in-nigerian-bus-crash//>).

<a id="event-2022-11-22-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A helicopter crashes in Charlotte, North Carolina, United States, killing the pilot and a meteorologist, both WBTV news station employees.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/22/us/charlotte-north-carolina-helicopter-crash/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-22-2-2"></a>

Context: Australia–India relations / Australia–India Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement.

**Archived source account.** The Australian parliament ratifies a free trade agreement with India.

Source citations (as archived): [Times Now News](<https://www.timesnownews.com/business-economy/economy/australian-parliament-passes-free-trade-agreement-with-india-article-95677573>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-11-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Chesapeake shooting.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and four others injured during a mass shooting at a Walmart Supercenter in Chesapeake, Virginia, United States. The perpetrator, identified as the supermarket's store manager, kills himself after the shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/22/us/chesapeake-virginia-walmart-shooting/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-11-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** The Saudi Arabia national football team defeats Argentina 2–1 in an upset. With this loss, Argentina fails to equal Italy's record 37-match unbeaten streak in international football.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2022/11/22/1138566357/messi-argentina-saudi-arabia-world-cup-upset-qatar>).

### 2022-11-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363092566](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2023&oldid=1363092566>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / October–November 2022 nationwide missile strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Widespread blackouts are reported in Western Ukraine as Russian forces launch another wave of cruise missile strikes, including in the city of Lviv, which is currently experiencing a power outage. Moldova also reports "massive" power outages, although the country has not been directly hit by missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63729427>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / October–November 2022 nationwide missile strikes on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** At least six people, all civilians, are killed in the latest missile strikes, including three in an apartment block in Vyshhorod, Kyiv Oblast, where 15 other people were injured. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko says that 21 of the 31 missiles targeting Kyiv were intercepted before they reached their targets.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/23/strike-on-ukrainian-hospital-maternity-ward-zaporizhzhia-kills-newborn-baby>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** British Defence Secretary Ben Wallace announces that the United Kingdom will send three Sea King helicopters to the Ukrainian Air Force as part of a new £50 million support package to Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2022/11/23/three-sea-king-helicopters-sent-ukraine-first-time/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / 2022 Jerusalem bombings.

**Archived source account.** A 16-year-old Israeli Canadian teenager and an Ethiopian-Israeli man in his fifties are killed and 22 others are injured in explosions at two bus stops in Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/23/jerusalem-israel-explosion-bus-stop-injured>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-723426>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-11"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / Death of Tiran Fero.

**Archived source account.** An Israeli Druze teen is kidnapped from a Jenin hospital by Jenin Brigades militants and his body held hostage. He died either in the hospital or after the militants unplugged him from his life support.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/body-of-israeli-man-killed-in-west-bank-crash-said-snatched-by-palestinian-gunmen/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-12"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinians are killed and three others injured during a raid by Israeli soldiers at a refugee camp in Nablus.

Source citations (as archived): [Wafa](<https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/132022>); [Wafa](<https://english.wafa.ps/Pages/Details/132043>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-15"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / M23 offensive.

**Archived source account.** The Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda agree to a ceasefire from November 25 and "the immediate withdrawal of M23 rebels from the occupied areas".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.africanews.com/2022/11/23/ceasefire-in-restive-east-dr-congo-as-soon-as-friday//>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-0-17"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict.

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed in a mass shooting at a mosque in Kabul, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20221123/ef8403c903d545d78e112ae2c4c0d4d4/c.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-11-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Düzce earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 68 others are injured by a 6.1 magnitude earthquake in Düzce, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/tr/d%C3%BCzcede-deprem-2-%C3%B6l%C3%BC/a-63854889>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-23-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament designates Russia as a state sponsor of terrorism, citing Russia's military strikes on civilian targets in Ukraine, including critical infrastructure, hospitals, schools, and bomb shelters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/european-lawmakers-declare-russia-state-sponsor-terrorism-2022-11-23/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Kosovo–Serbia relations.

**Archived source account.** Kosovo and Serbia agree an EU-brokered deal to end a dispute over Kosovar license plates in North Kosovo, which triggered protests last year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kosovo-serbia-reach-deal-end-dangerous-dispute-over-car-plates-eu-2022-11-23/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-11-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Proposed second Scottish independence referendum.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United Kingdom unanimously denies the Scottish government the right to hold a second referendum on Scottish independence from the United Kingdom without approval from the British government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/nov/23/scottish-independence-supreme-court-scottish-parliament-second-referendum-indyref2>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-11-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup controversies.

**Archived source account.** FIFA announces that they will fine the Ecuadorian Football Federation after Ecuadorian fans made discriminatory chants about Chileans during the opening game of the World Cup against Qatar at the Al Bayt Stadium.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! Sports](<https://sports.yahoo.com/fifa-fines-ecuador-fan-chants-135732003.html>).

### 2022-11-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360240689](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20November%2024&oldid=1360240689>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-11-24-0-2"></a>

Context: Kurdish–Turkish conflict / Operation Claw-Sword.

**Archived source account.** Syrian Democratic Forces commander-in-chief Mazloum Abdi suspends military operations against the Islamic State in order to focus on preparations for a Turkish ground invasion of northern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Monitor](<https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2022/11/turkeys-strikes-syria-put-us-troops-danger-pentagon-says>).

<a id="event-2022-11-24-0-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed and 35 others are injured when Russian Armed Forces bombard Kherson.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russian-shelling-kills-15-in-kherson-as-ukraine-battles-to-restore-power-3554546>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-11-24-1-1"></a>

Context: Modern immigration to the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Net migration to the United Kingdom reaches a record of 504,000 in 2022, according to the Office for National Statistics. The record increase is primarily due to non-EU migration, the resumption of post-pandemic travel, the arrival of Afghan and Ukrainian refugees, and immigration from Hong Kong.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-63743259>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-11-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Mahsa Amini protests.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Council approves the establishment of a fact-finding mission into the allegations of human rights violations committed by the Iranian government in response to the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.news24.com/news24/world/news/un-rights-council-orders-international-probe-of-iran-crackdown-20221124>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-11-24-3-2"></a>

Context: Philippine drug war / Killings of Kian delos Santos, Carl Arnaiz and Reynaldo de Guzman.

**Archived source account.** A Regional Trial Court in Caloocan, Philippines, sentences a police officer to life imprisonment for torturing and fabricating evidence on drug war victims Carl Arnaiz and Reynaldo de Guzman in 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-court-delivers-rare-conviction-police-officer-drugs-war-violations-2022-11-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-24-3-4"></a>

Context: 2021 Algeria wildfires.

**Archived source account.** A court in Algeria sentences 49 people to death for the lynching of a 38-year-old man during last year's wildfires, after the man turned himself to police on suspicion of arson.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20221124-algerian-court-sentences-49-people-to-death-over-forest-fire-lynching>).

<a id="event-2022-11-24-3-6"></a>

Context: China–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The Government of the United Kingdom orders its departments to remove and refrain from installing closed-circuit television systems manufactured by companies that are under China's national intelligence law at "sensitive" buildings, citing security concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2022/11/25/uk-restricts-chinese-cameras-in-government-buildings-over-security-fears.html>).

<a id="event-2022-11-24-3-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and another is injured as a gunman opens fire at a shopping centre in Krymsk, Krasnodar Krai, Russia. The perpetrator commits suicide after the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Outlook](<https://www.outlookindia.com/international/russia-shooting-3-people-dead-in-krymsk-as-66-year-old-gunman-open-fire-later-kills-himself-news-239931>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-11-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Malaysian general election.

**Archived source account.** Pakatan Harapan and long-time opposition leader Anwar Ibrahim is sworn in as the Prime Minister of Malaysia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/malaysias-former-ruling-bloc-may-back-anwar-pm-race-2022-11-24/>).

<a id="event-2022-11-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Russian gay propaganda law.

**Archived source account.** The lower house of the Russian parliament, the State Duma, passes a bill banning all instances of "LGBT propaganda".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/russias-parliament-passes-law-banning-lgbt-propaganda-among-adults-2022-11-24/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-11-24-5-2"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup / Portugal at the FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** Portuguese footballer Cristiano Ronaldo becomes the first player to score a goal at five FIFA Men's World Cup tournaments after scoring one in Portugal's 3–2 win against Ghana.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/world-cup-womens-soccer-sports-africa-8d7bff6633841639fc46a467e4b648db>).

### 2022-11-25

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The military of Somalia carries out a series of counterterrorism operations in southern Somalia, killing 15 al-Shabaab members who survived a previous operation two days ago, in which 49 fighters were killed. The military also says that they stopped an attack in Qayib, Galmudug, killing dozens of militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20221125/364950062f224438bf22599a28bb06e4/c.html>).

Four people were killed in the attempt.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/prime-minister-coup-thwarted-in-sao-tome-and-principe/2022/11/25/f7fda3b2-6d16-11ed-8619-0b92f0565592_story.html>).

Context: Aracruz school shootings.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 12 others injured in a mass shooting targeting two schools in Aracruz, Espírito Santo, Brazil. The suspect, a 16-year-old boy, is later arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/shootings-education-caribbean-brazil-9829399a1b55a1c4f54b00bcd35d80c1>).

<a id="event-2022-11-25-3-3"></a>

Context: Mount Isa Murders.

**Archived source account.** An Indian Australian citizen, Rajwinder Singh, is arrested in New Delhi as the prime suspect in the murder of Australian woman Toyah Cordingley on a beach in Far North Queensland in October 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/india-sydney-arrests-australia-queensland-786b300cd42e73b726f8ebcfb28545da>).

<a id="event-2022-11-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Taiwanese local elections.

**Archived source account.** Residents of Taiwan head to the polls to elect mayors, city council members and other local leaders in nine cities and 13 counties.

### 2022-11-28

Context: Comoros passport sales scandal.

Context: Aftermath of the 2022 Buffalo shooting.

**Archived source account.** Payton S. Gendron, who shot and killed 10 people and injured three others at a supermarket in Buffalo, New York, United States, in May, pleads guilty to all state charges: first-degree murder, domestic terrorism motivated by hate, and attempted murder as a hate crime.

Source citations (as archived): [PBS NewsHour](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/buffalo-gunman-pleads-guilty-to-murder-terrorism-in-racist-supermarket-massacre>).

Context: Capital punishment in Belarus.

**Archived source account.** Belarusian lawmakers approve a bill which punishes high treason among officials and military personnel with the death penalty. The bill also includes prosecution for "spreading false information discrediting the Armed Forces of Belarus".

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/belarus-approves-death-penalty-high-treason/32165875.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-07-3-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Germany coup d'état plot.

**Archived source account.** German police arrest 25 members of the Reichsbürger movement who are accused of planning a coup d'état.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/german-police-arrest-25-suspects-over-plot-to-overthrow-state/a-64011136>).

<a id="event-2022-12-07-3-7"></a>

Context: Crime in Jamaica.

**Archived source account.** Jamaican prime minister Andrew Holness declares a nationwide state of emergency due to an increase in crime rates in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/07/americas/jamaica-state-of-emergency-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-07-3-9"></a>

Context: La Línea corruption case.

**Archived source account.** Former President of Guatemala Otto Pérez Molina and his vice president, Roxana Baldetti, are sentenced to 16-year prison terms for their involvement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/guatemala-court-convicts-ex-president-perez-ex-vp-graft-case-2022-12-07/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-07-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jemaah Islamiyah member Umar Patek, who was convicted for his role in the 2002 Bali bombings, is released on parole after an Indonesian court reduced his 20-year prison sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2455239/bali-bombmaker-released-on-parole-from-indonesian-prison-official>).

<a id="event-2022-12-07-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Janusz Waluś, the convicted assassin of South African anti-apartheid politician Chris Hani, is released on parole.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20221207-killer-of-s-african-anti-apartheid-hero-hani-freed-on-parole-1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-12-07-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Peruvian self-coup d'état attempt.

**Archived source account.** President Pedro Castillo announces the dissolution of Congress, the imposition of a curfew, the creation of an "emergency" government, and early parliamentary elections hours before facing his third impeachment vote. The impeachment is successful and Castillo is later arrested after leaving the Government Palace in Lima. First Vice President Dina Boluarte is sworn in as President of the Republic after Castillo's arrest.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/perus-president-says-will-dissolve-congress-calls-elections-2022-12-07/>); [La República](<https://larepublica.pe/politica/pedro-castillo/2022/12/07/pedro-castillo-esta-detenido-en-la-region-policial-de-lima-tras-salir-de-palacio-de-gobierno/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2022/12/7/live-news-perus-congress-votes-to-remove-president-castillo>).

### 2022-12-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1295803914](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20December%208&oldid=1295803914>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-12-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces shell the front line in the Donetsk region, killing one civilian and damaging buildings in Toretsk.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-acknowledges-russias-war-ukraine-could-be-long-one-2022-12-07/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-0-4"></a>

Context: Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso.

**Archived source account.** Ten Volunteers for the Defense of the Homeland members are killed during a shooting attack by jihadist insurgents in Boala.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/attack-in-northern-burkina-faso-kills-at-least-10-people-/6868345.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-0-6"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Three Palestinian Islamic Jihad gunmen are killed, and two others are injured during an arrest raid by Israeli soldiers at a refugee camp in Jenin, in the occupied West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/8/israel-kills-three-west-bank-jenin-general-strike-called>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/three-palestinians-killed-in-clash-between-gunmen-and-idf-in-jenin/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-0-8"></a>

Context: 2022 North Kosovo crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Kosovo special forces block the city of Kosovska Mitrovica after the Kosovo Police announced that they will increase their presence in North Kosovo.

Source citations (as archived): [Srbija Danas](<https://www.sd.rs/vesti/kosovo/dramaticni-snimci-sa-kosova-i-metohije-pogledajte-kako-je-kurtijeva-policija-umarsirala-na-sever-2022-12-08>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2022-12-08-1-1"></a>

Context: The Game Awards 2022.

**Archived source account.** At this year's Game Awards, Elden Ring wins Game of the Year while God of War Ragnarök wins the most awards with six.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/video-games/2022/12/08/game-awards>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-12-08-2-1"></a>

Context: Acquisition of Activision Blizzard by Microsoft.

**Archived source account.** The United States Federal Trade Commission announces that they will sue in an attempt to block Microsoft's pending acquisition of Activision Blizzard, citing concerns that the deal would give Microsoft too much control over certain parts of the gaming industry.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2022/12/8/23498224/ftc-microsoft-activision-blizzard-legal-challenge-sues-block>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Egypt joins the BRICS-led New Development Bank after the Egyptian government ratifies its accession into the multilateral development bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Egypt Independent](<https://www.egyptindependent.com/cabinet-approves-draft-resolution-to-establish-the-new-development-bank/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2022-12-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron announces that condoms will be free at pharmacies for all adults between the ages of 18 and 24 years beginning on January 1, as part of an effort to reduce the spread of sexually transmitted diseases in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/condoms-be-free-young-people-france-macron-says-2022-12-08/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-12-08-4-2"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations / Death of Harry Dunn.

**Archived source account.** Judge Bobbie Cheema-Grubb of the High Court of Justice of England and Wales suspends American national Anne Sacoolas' eight-month prison sentence for a 12-month period, during which she is under probation unless she commits another offence, over the death of British man Harry Dunn in a 2019 traffic collision.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2456204/us-diplomats-wife-gets-suspended-sentence-for-fatal-uk-crash>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-4-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations / Viktor Bout–Brittney Griner prisoner exchange.

**Archived source account.** Basketball player Brittney Griner is released in a prisoner swap for arms dealer Viktor Bout.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/brittney-griner-release-russia-prisoner-swap-viktor-bout/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-4-7"></a>

Context: Schengen Area.

**Archived source account.** The European Union accepts Croatia's accession to the Schengen Area, effective January 1.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/croatia-to-join-schengen-visa-free-zone-in-2023/a-64028685>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-4-8"></a>

Context: Schengen Area.

**Archived source account.** Austria announces that it will veto Bulgaria and Romania's accession to the Schengen Area, citing fears of increased illegal immigration.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://timesofmalta.com/articles/view/austria-veto-bulgaria-romania-joining-schengen-area.1000264>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-12-08-5-2"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Iran / Mahsa Amini protests.

**Archived source account.** Iran announces the first known execution of a prisoner arrested in connection with the protests. The man was found guilty of "waging war against God" after being accused of blocking a street and attacking a security forces member with a machete.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/6239633/iran-executes-protests-prisoner/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-5-4"></a>

Context: Wirecard scandal.

**Archived source account.** The trial of three executives of the now insolvent German financial services provider Wirecard, including its former chief executive officer Markus Braun, opens in Munich. Braun and two others have been charged with accounting fraud, breach of trust, commercial gang fraud, and market manipulation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20221208-huge-wirecard-fraud-trial-opens-in-germany>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-5-6"></a>

Context: LGBTQ rights in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives passes the Respect for Marriage Act, which enshrines same-sex marriage and interracial marriage into federal law, in a 258–169–1 vote.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2022/12/08/house-passes-respect-for-marriage-act-same-sex-marriage-bill.html>); [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/2022/12/08/respect-for-marriage-act-house-vote>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-12-08-6-2"></a>

Context: 2017–present Peruvian political crisis / 2022 Peruvian self-coup attempt, December 2022 Peruvian protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests break out across Peru, including the capital Lima, in response to ousting and detainment of former President of Peru Pedro Castillo.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/video/2022/12/09/watch-peruvians-protest-the-removal-of-president-pedro-castillo>).

<a id="event-2022-12-08-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Alberta Sovereignty Within a United Canada Act, which grants the cabinet of the Canadian province of Alberta the ability to nullify national laws, passes the Albertan legislature by a party line vote of 27–7, following significant opposition by the Alberta New Democratic Party and Indigenous chiefs.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/alberta-sovereignty-act-1.6678407>).

### 2022-12-09

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** Ukraine's Energoatom says that Russian soldiers have abducted two senior staff members from the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant. Energoatom says that the two workers were "beaten" before being driven off in an "unknown direction".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-atomic-agency-says-russian-forces-abducted-two-nuclear-plant-staff-2022-12-09/>).

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy accuses Russia of "destroying" the front line city of Bakhmut after weeks of relentless shelling by Russian forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/russia-has-destroyed-bakhmut-donbas-front-lines-difficult-zelensky-1766091>).

<a id="event-2022-12-09-0-7"></a>

Context: 2022 North Kosovo crisis.

<a id="event-2022-12-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed and four others are injured in an explosion at a coal mine in Sawahlunto, West Sumatra, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-c27006cfa8213992600a18a6701059f0>).

<a id="event-2022-12-09-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed after a large explosion occurs during a massive fire at a shopping center in Moscow, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/9/huge-blaze-rages-through-shopping-mall-in-russian>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-12-09-2-3"></a>

Context: United States sanctions / China–United States relations / United States sanctions against China.

**Archived source account.** The United States Office of Foreign Assets Control imposes sanctions on former Chinese Communist Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region Wu Yingjie and People's Police chief for the Himalayas Zhang Hongbo over "serious" human rights abuses in Tibet.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/us-sanctions-2-chinese-officials-over-tibet-human-rights-violations-3594201>).

<a id="event-2022-12-09-2-5"></a>

Context: United States sanctions / Guinea–United States relations.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-12-09-3-1"></a>

Context: Protests against the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A court in Moscow sentences prominent opposition figure Ilya Yashin to eight and a half years in prison on charges related to his criticism of the ongoing war in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russian-man-jailed-8-12-years-ukraine-action-94853266>).

<a id="event-2022-12-09-3-3"></a>

Context: Qatar corruption scandal at the European Parliament.

**Archived source account.** The Belgian Federal Police arrest Greek MEP and European Parliament vice-president Eva Kaili following an investigation into corruption tied to lobbying efforts in support of Qatar. Kaili's political parties, the Panhellenic Socialist Movement and the Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats, have both suspended her membership.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.wionews.com/world/police-arrest-european-parliament-vice-president-eva-kaili-541727>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/09/europe/eva-kaili-european-parliament-greece-expelled-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-09-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed during a gunfight between soldiers and drug smugglers in Mon Pin, Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangkok Post](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2456279/15-dead-after-gunfight-with-drug-smugglers-near-border>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2022-12-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Japanese research team from Yamagata University announces the discovery of 168 new big figures near the Nazca Lines in Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [EFE](<https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/ciencia/2022/12/09/6392ddb5fdddff635e8b4571.html>).

Context: Ironman Triathlon.

**Archived source account.** The Ironman Triathlon cancels the 2023 and 2024 triathlons to be held in Juneau, Alaska, United States, citing economic concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [Juneau Empire](<https://www.juneauempire.com/news/ironman-alaska-canceled/>).

Context: 2022 North Kosovo crisis.

<a id="event-2022-12-11-0-3"></a>

Context: 2022 North Kosovo crisis.

<a id="event-2022-12-12-1-3"></a>

Context: Wieambilla police shootings.

**Archived source account.** Two police officers and a civilian are killed and two other officers are injured when gunmen open fire at a remote property in Wieambilla, Queensland, Australia, where police were investigating a missing person report. The three perpetrators are later killed by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-63943292>); [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-12-12/qld-police-emergency-declaration-wieambilla-unfolding-incident/101763662>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-12-12-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** All members of Belgium's Political Bureau of the Walloon Parliament resign after a scandal concerning excessive public spending by parliamentary clerk Frédéric Janssens. Bureau President Jean-Claude Marcourt, who had been criticized for taking part in a luxury 3-day trip to Dubai for €20,000 using public funds, had previously refused to be the only person to resign if all other members of the Bureau did not resign.

Source citations (as archived): [RTBF](<https://www.rtbf.be/article/scandale-au-parlement-wallon-l-ensemble-du-bureau-politique-du-parlement-wallon-demissionne-y-compris-son-president-11121979>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-12-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Nagorno-Karabakh conflict / 2021–2022 Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis / 2022 Artsakh blockade.

**Archived source account.** The Lachin corridor, the only link between Armenia and the unrecognized Republic of Artsakh, is blocked by a group of Azerbaijani citizens described as environmental activists by state media. The protesters say that they are calling attention to what Azerbaijan says is illegal mining in Nagorno-Karabakh as well as the use of the road to transport the minerals to Armenia. The protesters' action leaves hundreds of Karabakh cars stranded on other sections of the highway.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/armenia-azerbaijan-nagorno-karabakh-road-closed-tensions/32174909.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [Eurasianet](<https://eurasianet.org/blockade-of-nagorno-karabakh-enters-second-day>).

<a id="event-2022-12-13-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven Allied Democratic Forces militants are killed and eight are arrested during a gunfight with Ugandan soldiers in Ntoroko, Uganda. A soldiers is also killed and three civilians injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/rest-of-africa/tunisians-to-vote-on-toothless-parliament-4058028>).

<a id="event-2022-12-17-5-3"></a>

Context: 2022 Fijian general election.

**Archived source account.** Fiji's election office projects that both the ruling FijiFirst and opposition People's Alliance parties will win 26 seats each in the 55-seat parliament, resulting in a deadlock.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/fiji-election-results-show-parliamentary-deadlock/a-64138157>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-12-17-6-1"></a>

Context: 2022 FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** Croatia defeats Morocco 2–1 in the third place play-off. This is Croatia's second third-place finish, and Morocco's best ever result at a World Cup, which is also the best ever result by both an African and Arab team at the tournament.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/17/football/croatia-morocco-third-place-playoff-2022-world-cup-spt-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-17-6-3"></a>

Context: 2022 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** The Minnesota Vikings complete the largest comeback in NFL history against the Indianapolis Colts, winning 39–36 after a 0–33 deficit. The previous largest comeback occurred in January 1993 when the Buffalo Bills won 41–38 against the Houston Oilers after a 35–3 deficit.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/vikings-vs-colts-score-minnesota-completes-largest-comeback-in-nfl-history-clinches-nfc-north/live/?ref=upstract.com>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2022-12-19-1-2"></a>

Context: 2021–2022 global energy crisis / EU natural gas price cap.

**Archived source account.** European Union member states agree to a natural gas price cap in an attempt to limit economic damage from the global energy crisis. The price cap can be triggered beginning on February 15, if for three days, prices on the TTF, which is the European natural gas benchmark, exceed €180 per megawatt-hour (MWh) and are also more than €35/MWh higher than a reference price based on liquefied natural gas price assessments.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/eu-countries-make-final-push-gas-price-cap-deal-this-year-2022-12-19/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-19-1-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Ethiopia–Tigray peace agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20221219-ethiopia-s-largest-bank-says-tigray-services-resume>).

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/jan-6-committee-condemns-trump-central-cause-insurrection/story?id=95552986>).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/12/19/us/harvey-weinstein-trial-deliberations-los-angeles-monday/index.html>).

**Archived source account.** Russian forces shell the city of Kherson, killing at least ten civilians and injuring 58 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Express](<https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/1713555/ukraine-live-Vladimir-putin-vows-to-end-war-russia-kremlin-zelensky-updates>).

<a id="event-2022-12-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2022 Paris shooting.

**Archived source account.** Kurds riot near the Place de la République in Paris, France, damaging shops and setting fires. The Paris Police Prefecture reports 11 arrests and at least 30 minor injuries in relation to the violence. The riot followed a peaceful protest in response to yesterday's mass shooting at a Kurdish cultural center that killed three people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/frances-kurds-gather-protest-after-paris-killings-2022-12-24/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-12-24-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Kemerovo nursing home fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire at an unregistered nursing home in Kemerovo, Russia, kills 22 people and injures six others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-unregistered-russian-home-elderly-kills-11-tass-2022-12-23/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-24-1-3"></a>

Context: Boksburg explosion.

**Archived source account.** A fuel tanker explodes in Boksburg, Gauteng, South Africa, killing 15 people, injuring 27 others, and damaging a nearby hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/12/24/nine-killed-in-fuel-tanker-explosion-near-johannesburg-official>).

<a id="event-2022-12-24-1-5"></a>

Context: 2022 Galicia bus crash.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and two others are rescued after a bus falls off a bridge into the Lérez river in Galicia, Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/dec/25/spain-bus-plunges-off-bridge-lerez-river-galicia>).

<a id="event-2022-12-24-1-7"></a>

Context: December 2022 North American winter storm.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 36 others are injured in a bus crash on Highway 97C in British Columbia, Canada. The crash was attributed to "icy roads" following the winter storm.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/us-bomb-cyclone-at-least-50-dead-as-north-america-gripped-by-devastating-winter-storm-12774427>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-12-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the assassination of Shinzo Abe.

**Archived source account.** The Nara District Public Prosecutors Office in Nara Prefecture, Japan, says that the accused assassin of former prime minister Shinzo Abe is competent to stand trial for the killing. Prosecutors say that Tetsuya Yamagami "does not suffer from any mental illness that could greatly affect his ability to judge right from wrong". According to sources, prosecutors plan to indict Yamagami on murder charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Yomiuri](<https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/crime-courts/20221224-79396/>).

**Archived source account.** The Taliban issues a decree banning female employees from all non-governmental organizations in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/taliban-orders-ngos-to-ban-female-employees-from-coming-to-work/ar-AA15DkBc>).

<a id="event-2022-12-24-2-5"></a>

Context: Wallasey pub shooting.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and four others are injured during a mass shooting at a pub in Wallasey, Merseyside, England.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-64090038>).

<a id="event-2022-12-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2022 Fijian general election.

**Archived source account.** Sitiveni Rabuka is confirmed as the new prime minister. Rabuka will hold the office again more than two decades after first leading the country as prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.voanews.com/a/rabuka-confirmed-as-fiji-prime-minister-after-close-election-/6889980.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Pierce County substation attack.

**Archived source account.** An attack on an electrical substation in Pierce County, Washington, United States, cuts off power to 14,000 people. The perpetrators and motive of the attack are unknown.

### 2022-12-27
