Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of the Svatove-Kreminna line.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian forces claim that they are closing in on the city of Kreminna in Luhansk Oblast. According to governor Serhiy Haidai, Russian fighters in some parts of the city were forced to retreat to neighboring Rubizhne.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/dec/27/ukraine-says-its-forces-are-close-to-recapturing-key-eastern-city-of-kreminna>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-12-27-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022 Northern Mindanao floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from monsoon floods in the Philippines has increased to 32, with 24 others still missing. Eighteen of the deaths occurred in Northern Mindanao.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/floods-weather-storms-disaster-planning-and-response-philippines-a86c9907fa2e79d12a95aaab67774668>).

<a id="event-2022-12-27-1-3"></a>

Context: 2022 Omdurman bus crash.

**Archived source account.** Sixteen people are killed when a bus collides with a dump truck on the outskirts of Omdurman, Khartoum, Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/least-16-killed-bus-crash-sudan-2022-12-27/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2022-12-27-2-2"></a>

Context: International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian oil price cap.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin issues a decree to prohibit the exports of Russian oil and petroleum products to countries and organizations that adhere to the US$60-per-barrel price cap that Australia, the European Union, and the G7 member states agreed upon earlier this month. The decree will be in effect from February 1 to July 1.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russia-to-ban-oil-exports-to-countries-using-price-cap-from-february-news-agency-afp-3642999>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-12-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Gretchen Whitmer kidnapping plot.

**Archived source account.** A federal judge in Michigan, United States, sentences a man to 16 years in prison for plotting to kidnap Michigan governor Gretchen Whitmer in 2020. The man was also convicted of conspiring to use a weapon of mass destruction.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/27/politics/adam-fox-sentenced-whitmer-kidnapping-plot/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Title 42 expulsion.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States rules 5–4 to maintain Title 42 of the U.S. Code, allowing the government to remove persons who have recently been in a country where an infectious disease was present.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20221227-us-supreme-court-keeps-in-effect-health-policy-used-to-block-migrants>).

<a id="event-2022-12-27-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korean president Yoon Suk-yeol pardons former president Lee Myung-bak as part of a mass pardon aimed at "national unity". Lee had been serving a 17-year sentence for corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/12/27/south-koreas-jailed-ex-president-lee-gets-presidential-pardon>).

<a id="event-2022-12-27-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Taiwanese government announces that it would extend the required duration for conscription from four months to one year, citing the increasing threat of China using military force to pursue Chinese unification. The reform, which will apply to men born after January 1, 2005, will take effect in 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/taiwan-extends-mandatory-military-service-from-four-months-to-one-year/hqj369xtp>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2022-12-27-4-1"></a>

Context: 2022–23 NBA season.

**Archived source account.** Slovenian point guard Luka Dončić of the Dallas Mavericks scores the first 60-point triple-double in the National Basketball Association, the premier men's professional basketball league in the world, after recording 60 points, 21 rebounds, and 10 assists in the Mavericks' 126–121 overtime win against the New York Knicks in Dallas.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/basketball/64107654>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2022-12-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2022 University of Idaho killings.

**Archived source account.** In Pennsylvania, United States, the alleged perpetrator of a mass stabbing of four University of Idaho students, 28-year-old Bryan Christopher Kohberger, is arrested by police in the Pocono Mountains.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2022/12/30/us/university-of-idaho-student-killings-investigation/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-30-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in Myanmar delivers its final verdict on ousted leader Aung San Suu Kyi's cases, sentencing her to seven years in prison, with an overall sentence of 33 years' imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/30/asia/myanmar-aung-san-suu-kyi-court-verdict-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2022-12-30-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A judge in Bolivia orders opposition figure Luis Fernando Camacho to be remanded in detention for four months on "terrorism charges", as opposition parties call for a national strike.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/bolivia-santa-cruz-la-paz-legal-proceedings-crime-85ee1c3f6e60830d2edc3a1261fdac60>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-12-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Venezuelan presidential crisis.

**Archived source account.** The National Opposition Assembly votes to terminate Juan Guaidó's interim government and opposition leadership, with Guaidó's disputed acting presidency expected to end on January 4.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2022/12/30/world/americas/venezuela-opposition-juan-guaido.html>).

### 2022-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1131584920](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2022%20December%2031&oldid=1131584920>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2022-12-31-0-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Makiivka military quarters shelling.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Russian mobilized soldiers are claimed by Ukraine to be killed and injured as a result of an Ukrainian missile attack on a vocational school building serving as military barracks. Russian authorities acknowledge several casualties, but suggest lower figures.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-shells-donetsks-makiivka-hitting-military-quarters-officials-2023-01-01/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64142650>).

<a id="event-2022-12-31-0-4"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Colombian government reaches a bilateral ceasefire agreement with the major armed groups involved in the conflict, including the National Liberation Army, FARC dissidents, and the Clan del Golfo. The ceasefire will be in effect from January 1 to at least June 30.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/colombia-agrees-on-ceasefire-with-eln-guerrillas-farc-dissidents-and-drug-gangs-president-1.1672558767605>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2022-12-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and nine others are injured by a landslide in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/landslide-kills-least-8-people-eastern-congo-2022-12-31/>).

<a id="event-2022-12-31-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese Navy and United Nations forces rescue a capsizing boat of 232 migrants in the Mediterranean Sea. Two people perish in the overnight incident.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/lebanese-troops-rescue-migrants-vessel-2-killed-96018708>).

<a id="event-2022-12-31-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed and 47 others are injured after a bus crashed and flipped in Nayarit, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-automotive-accidents-caribbean-ff23c4c428dcb94c3a959de1bb4b436c>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2022-12-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Death and funeral of Pope Benedict XVI.

**Archived source account.** Pope emeritus Benedict XVI, who served from 2005 until his resignation in 2013, dies at the age of 95, with the funeral scheduled for January 5.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64107731>).
